jobs.title: Head of Engineering, SyncOS
jobs.text:
Asia's leading robotics solutions provider, automating enterprise supply chains since 2017. We build syncOS — the industry-first no-code platform that lets manufacturers and warehouse operators integrate, reprogram, and scale automation systems without halting production or calling in specialists. Our autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) run 24/7 for global brands like Ford, Coca-Cola, and Kimberly-Clark — transforming production lines in hours, not weeks.
We started as roboticists ourselves. We know the pain of fragmented, proprietary systems that refuse to talk to each other. syncOS is our answer — and we believe it's what the industry has been waiting for. We are a young, passionate team chasing one big mission.
WHAT DOES SUCCESS LOOK LIKE FOR THIS ROLE
3 months:
Deep understanding of syncOS, the fleet it orchestrates, and how it runs in live customer environments
Release and deployment process owned end-to-end - every build clearly certified, every deployment owned and reversible
Established as the single technical point of contact for the delivery organisation
Team assessed, and the lead structure for scaling in place
6 months:
Site deployment reliability consistently at target across live customers — repeatable and process-driven
Interface contracts between syncOS and the fleet published and enforced; teams build to a clear spec
Manager layer running well, with depth behind every critical capability
Product discipline visible: platform work and custom work clearly separated, scoped, and priced
12 months:
SyncOS reliability is a competitive strength customers choose us for
A reusable integration catalog with owners and regression tests - each new integration cheaper and faster than the last
SyncOS engineering scales cleanly into new sites and geographies. A self-sufficient organisation with the bench strength to grow beyond you
Key Responsibilities:
Single technical owner of our software platform – SyncOS.
Lead the teams building fleet management, integrations, and the platform core, and own the discipline that gets our software running reliably at customer sites, at scale, across geographies.
The platform, end to end - You own syncOS engineering - fleet management, integrator and dashboard, integration modules, and the platform core and the technical definition of what syncOS is as a product.
Reliability and release quality - You own how software gets from a merged change to running dependably at a customer site: release gating, staged rollout, post-deploy verification, versioned and reversible deployments, and the observability that catches issues before customers do. Site deployment quality is a core measure of your success.
DevOps and site delivery of software - The syncOS DevOps function reports to you. Your team owns updates going onto customer sites as a controlled, repeatable release process.
Architecture and interfaces - You own the interface contracts and data models between syncOS and the integrations - published, enforced, and stable.
The team - You lead and grow the syncOS engineering organization through a layer of team leads: hiring, structure, mentorship, and building an org where no critical capability rests on a single person.
Product-mode engineering - You bring the discipline that keeps a platform a platform - a clear spec, a reusable integration catalog with owners and tests, and the judgment to keep bespoke, one-off work from fragmenting the product.
You will partner closely with:
Product: on what syncOS should do and for whom - you own how it's built and whether it's ready to ship.
Commissioning & Customer Success: who take your certified releases to customer sites - you are their single technical point of contact.
Quality: who independently certify releases - you build to the bar and ship what passes it.
Robotics Engineering: on the interface between the platform and the fleet.

jobs.title: Engineering Director, Storage
jobs.text:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.
At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.
A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.
Roblox's infrastructure supports over 100M DAUs and recently supported a world record 45M players at the same time. The scale is real.
As Director of Engineering, you will own the technical strategy, design, delivery, and operation of Roblox's storage systems. The challenge is scale, efficiency, reliability, and innovation all at once. We are mostly on-prem but also in the cloud — yes, we're actually building a lot of this ourselves, and yes, we know how hard that is. We've got the scale and the talent to do it.
You've spent your career deep in storage: databases, caches, queues, object storage. You understand that reliability is the most important feature of any system. You care deeply about the success of the internal and external customers who depend on these systems. You're excited to shepherd a fast-growing platform from the nearly 1 exabyte we have today to a multi-exabyte deployment that will power some of the most interesting AI workloads in the industry.
You will
Own the technical strategy, architecture, and roadmap for Roblox's storage systems, including distributed databases, caches, queues, object storage, and encryption infrastructure
Ensure our storage platform scales by orders of magnitude while remaining reliable and efficient
Partner closely with Data Platform, Infrastructure, and product engineering teams to align storage capabilities with Roblox's technical and business needs
Build, grow, and retain a world-class storage engineering team — and develop the next generation of technical leaders within it
Drive operational excellence: define and hold the bar on reliability, on-call practices, and incident response
Own your systems end-to-end, including participation in on-call rotation for critical incidents
You have
Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field
10+ years of experience in storage, infrastructure, or distributed systems roles, including hands-on experience building and operating custom database systems - not just deploying off-the-shelf solutions - plus depth in at least several of: caching systems, object storage, message queues, or data streaming
5+ years in engineering leadership, managing teams through ambiguity to deliver critical, production-scale systems
A track record of building reliable, high-availability systems at significant scale (millions of users, petabyte-scale data, or equivalent)
Strong operational instincts — you raise the bar on reliability and execution, not just vision
Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional partners and earn trust across engineering, product, and leadership
Comfort with ambiguity and a bias toward learning: you go deep on tech stacks that are new to you and bring others along
For roles that are based at our headquarters in San Mateo, CA: The starting base pay for this position is as shown below. The actual base pay is dependent upon a variety of job-related factors such as professional background, training, work experience, location, business needs and market demand. Therefore, in some circumstances, the actual salary could fall outside of this expected range. This pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. All full-time employees are also eligible for equity compensation and for benefits as described on this page.
Annual Salary Range
$399,420—$457,970 USD
Roles that are based in an office are onsite Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday, with optional presence on Monday and Friday (unless otherwise noted).
Roblox provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. Roblox also provides reasonable accommodations to candidates with qualifying disabilities or religious beliefs during the recruiting process.
For US based roles only, please note the Company may not be able to employ candidates for this role who have United States work authorization related to certain U.S. visa categories, or support future H-1B sponsorship at this time.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering, AI Takeoff Team
jobs.text:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human
Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.
This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.
Director of Engineering, AI takeoff team
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human
Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.
This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.
Job Description
The AI Takeoff Team at Okta is the tip of the spear, creating a rapid, high-bandwidth feedback loop from our customers to product and engineering. We are customer-first by design: working directly with customers to understand real-world problems, rapidly build and validate solutions, and accelerate the capabilities that ultimately become part of the Okta platform.
We move at startup speed, operate with intensity, obsess about customer outcomes, and own our numbers — from pipeline generation to sales, adoption and retention. You’ll operate like an engineering leader at a startup within a larger enterprise: moving quickly, staying close to customers, and delivering with urgency while bringing the broader Okta organization with you.
In this context, we are seeking a driven, customer-focused engineering leader to accelerate our roadmap delivery. This is a career-defining role for the right leader looking to directly impact the growth trajectory of the industry leader in identity and AI security.
Responsibilities
Work closely with our top customers and AI Forward Deployed Engineering to rapidly translate customer needs into differentiated AI capabilities and deliver them to production.
Partner closely with broader Okta Engineering, Product and Design to ensure capabilities are production-ready and meet Okta standards for security, reliability, scalability and quality.
Build, grow and mentor a small, highly focused team of AI Takeoff engineers operating with high autonomy and urgency.
Serve as a senior technical SME in customer engagements, technical evaluations and complex sales processes.
Lead complex customer escalations with a bias toward rapidly identifying root causes and delivering durable solutions.
Own the technical strategy, architecture, and execution for the AI Takeoff engineering roadmap, balancing customer urgency with long-term scalability and production quality.
Qualifications
8+ years building and shipping identity, security, infrastructure or developer-focused products in a high-growth organization.
Proven engineering leadership and team management experience, including hiring, developing and motivating high-performing teams.
Strong executive communication and influencing skills, with a track record of driving outcomes across organizational boundaries and bringing cross-functional teams together.
Proven experience working directly with enterprise customers and translating customer problems into technical solutions.
Deep identity domain expertise — you know, or can quickly get up to speed on, the latest identity protocols, standards, architectures and patterns.
Experience operating in high-ambiguity, high-velocity environments where priorities evolve quickly and execution matters.
Strong product and customer orientation, with the ability to balance customer urgency, technical quality and long-term scalability.
Experience with AI/agentic systems, AI security or emerging identity patterns is a strong plus.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering
jobs.text:
Drive delivery and operational excellence.
Millennium is seeking a Director of Engineering. As the operational leader for the Engineering Business Unit, the Director of Engineering holds end-to-end accountability for delivery execution, unit economics, and operational scaling. Partnering directly with the VP of Strategic Solutions in a balanced commercial/operational dynamic, this role owns the business unit’s operational and financial performance—driving gross margin, EBITDA, cost structure, resource allocation, and talent development. While the commercial organization focuses on revenue growth and market strategy, the Director of Engineering ensures that delivery operations excel in precision, efficiency, client retention, and long-term profitability.
What You’ll Do
Own gross margin and EBITDA performance for the Engineering Business Unit
Own annual budget, forecasting, and staffing plans for the unit, translating project-level staffing input from the Head of Strategic Engineering and Engineering Manager(s) into a unit-wide plan.
Own cost structures and delivery economics, working with the VP where these connect to client-facing rate cards.
Design and monitor the unit's departmental KPIs — backlog strength, on-time delivery, unit cost per fiber-kilometer (KFM), margin by project — reported through NetSuite/Domo, with the Head of Strategic Engineering responsible for producing the underlying measures.
Own backlog, workload forecasting, and resource allocation across projects, with the Head of Strategic Engineering responsible for day-to-day backlog and workload monitoring, and Engineering Manager(s) consulted.
Own client retention — relationship health and proactive response to client needs — with the Head of Strategic Engineering responsible for day-to-day relationship management.
Own tool and technology evaluation and recommendation for the unit, incorporating Engineering Manager(s) input as it matures.
Own monthly reporting to management on status, performance, and metrics, with the Head of Strategic Engineering and Engineering Manager(s) responsible for generating the underlying reports.
Own succession planning and leadership development pipeline, including senior engineer training and technical development.
Partner with the VP on strategic planning and provide input on client retention risk that touches sales-facing accounts.
What You Bring
10+ years in telecom, fiber/broadband infrastructure, or a comparable capital-project environment, including direct accountability for a unit's margin, budget, and cost structure.
Direct experience coordinating OSP engineering, design, and permitting workflows with major national carriers (e.g., AT&T, Verizon, T-Mobile).
Demonstrated experience owning KPI design and monthly management reporting for an operating unit.
Fluency with ERP/BI tools (NetSuite, Domo, or equivalent) and comfort presenting financial and delivery performance to executive and Board audiences.
Experience building and developing a leadership bench (director- and manager-level) and running succession planning.
Comfort operating as a peer to a commercially-focused VP without overlapping accountability
Why Join Millennium?
Millennium helps our clients to build broadband networks to connect communities across America. But we’re more than that – we offer our clients enterprise resources to plan out their builds, supplement their funding, manage their materials, and get the equipment they need to get networks up and running.
A collaborative work environment where you can influence the overall success of the company through your efforts and expertise. The growth mode we operate in provides tremendous opportunities for your career path and personal development.
Apply Today!

Req ID FEQ327R163
Director, Field Engineering Emerging Enterprises & Startups
About the Role
As a Director, Field Engineering, you will lead a multi-team Field Engineering organization and own strategy, talent, operating model, and execution for a significant business area. You will scale customer and business impact through other leaders while influencing broader go-to-market, partner, Product, Engineering, and company priorities.
This role typically oversees a leadership team of approximately 3–5 leaders or an equivalent multi-team scope. Depending on the assignment, you may lead a broad business unit, multiple segments or countries, a major portfolio, or another strategically significant area.
The Impact You Will Have
Build and lead a strong leadership team that attracts, develops, and retains exceptional Field Engineering talent.
Own an end-to-end strategy across talent, customer coverage, technical priorities, operating model, execution, and business impact.
Translate customer, market, competitive, and technical trends into clear priorities and 6–12+ month plans.
Scale impact beyond individual teams through leaders, cross-functional GTM initiatives, partner ecosystems, and repeatable operating mechanisms.
Build trusted relationships with senior customer stakeholders, including VP-level and equivalent audiences, and guide complex programs, escalations, and transformation roadmaps.
Establish operating norms and inspection cadences across the organization that create visibility, accountability, predictable execution, and fast course correction.
Shape resourcing and organizational design to support growth, customer outcomes, technical quality, and long-term business value.
Upgrade hiring rigor, talent practices, leadership development, performance management, and succession planning across the organization.
Influence broader Sales, Professional Services, Marketing, Partners, Product, Engineering, Support, and executive priorities through a clear point of view and strong cross-functional relationships.
Partner with GTM Strategy & Operations and other functions to create scalable tools, programs, dashboards, and mechanisms; use AI to drive one-to-many organizational impact.
Act as a recognized resource on data, AI, cloud, customer transformation, and evolving market trends.
Embed Databricks Culture Principles into hiring, development, recognition, decision-making, and daily operations while maintaining a high bar for performance and customer impact.

Extensive experience leading technical customer-facing organizations in enterprise software, cloud, data, AI, analytics, technical consulting, or a related environment.
Proven success leading through managers and building a high-performing leadership team.
Track record of recruiting exceptional talent, developing leaders, addressing complex performance situations, and evolving organizational structure for scale.
Strong strategic and business judgment, with the ability to connect customer and market insight to organizational priorities and measurable business outcomes
Experience designing and running operating models across multiple teams, portfolios, segments, geographies, or countries.

Strong technical credibility across data platforms, analytics, AI, cloud architecture, governance, security, networking, and enterprise adoption, with the judgment to pressure-test complex approaches.
An AI-first, builder mindset demonstrated through experimentation, adoption, and scalable application of AI to customer outcomes and organizational effectiveness.

Experience leading multi-team technical customer-facing organizations and managing through other leaders.

Experience with Databricks or comparable data and AI platforms.
Experience leading across multiple business units, countries, customer segments, or Field Engineering practices.

jobs.title: Director of AI Engineering
jobs.text:
Location: Remote - United States only.
About the role:
Ottimate is building the AI-native future of accounts payable. Our platform processes millions of invoices across hundreds of enterprise customers, powered by a suite of ML models and agentic workflows. As Director of AI Engineering, you will own the full AI and ML layer of our product — from invoice understanding and vendor intelligence to our conversational AP Copilot and the next generation of autonomous AP agents.
This is a hands-on leadership role. You will spend at least half your time writing code, architecting systems, and driving technical decisions alongside your team. You will also set the AI roadmap, partner cross-functionally with Product, Data, and Platform Engineering, and manage a distributed team of 8–10 engineers across Data and ML.
We are looking for a senior technical manager or director — ideally someone who has thrived at a smaller company and is ready for a career step up into broader ownership. If you are energized by shipping real AI products, working with noisy real-world financial data, and building the systems that will define how enterprises automate AP, this role is for you.
Responsibilities
Technical Leadership
Architect and ship production AI/ML systems — you write code, not just review it
Own the AI roadmap end-to-end: prioritization, trade-offs, delivery
Set technical standards for model quality, evals, observability, and reliability
Drive adoption of agentic coding tools to multiply team velocity
Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or equivalent — measure and improve PR throughput
Partner with Platform Engineering on infrastructure, data pipelines, and APIs
People & Cross-Functional
Manage a distributed team of 8–10 engineers across Data and ML disciplines
Hire, develop, and retain engineers at all levels; build a high-trust remote culture
Partner with Product on roadmap sequencing and scope trade-offs
Work directly with customer-facing teams to close feedback loops on model quality
Communicate AI capabilities and limitations clearly to non-technical stakeholders
Model & Systems Ownership
Own model performance metrics and drive continuous improvement pipelines
Build and maintain evals frameworks — regression suites, human review, A/B testing
Oversee training data collection, curation, and labeling operations
Manage the full ML lifecycle: experimentation, deployment, monitoring, iteration
Define and enforce quality bars for agentic workflows entering production

jobs.title: VP, Legal Counsel – Data Privacy, Digital & Technology
jobs.text:
PIMCO is a global leader in active fixed income with deep expertise across public and private markets. We invest our clients’ capital across a range of fixed income and credit opportunities, leveraging our decades of experience navigating complex debt markets. Our flexible capital base and deep relationships with issuers have helped us become one of the world’s largest providers of traditional and nontraditional solutions for companies that need financing and investors who seek strong risk-adjusted returns.
Since 1971, our people have shaped our organization through a high-performance inclusive culture, in which we celebrate diverse thinking. We invest in our people and strive to imprint our CORE values of Collaboration, Openness, Responsibility and Excellence. We believe each of us is here to help others succeed and this has led to PIMCO being recognized as an innovator, industry thought leader and trusted advisor to our clients.
Position Overview
PIMCO is seeking a Vice President, Legal Counsel with deep expertise in data privacy, digital and technology regulation to join our EMEA Legal team.
In this role, you will provide specialist legal guidance on a broad range of data, privacy, digital and technology matters across the EMEA region. You will partner closely with Legal, IT, Compliance, Risk and business stakeholders to ensure PIMCO’s growing operations meet evolving regulatory requirements.
This is a strategic position requiring strong subjectmatter expertise, commercial judgment, and the ability to influence legal and operational strategy in an increasingly digital environment.
Responsibilities
Data Privacy & GDPR Compliance
Advise on GDPR and EU/UK privacy requirements across all EMEA business activities.
Guide teams on lawful data processing, data subject rights, crossborder transfers and data breach reporting.
Support responses to data subject access requests and ensure alignment with internal privacy policies.
Technology, Outsourcing & Vendor Arrangements
Advise on Data/IT/Tech outsourcing and thirdparty risk requirements.
Negotiate and review cloud, IT and technology vendor agreements, including data protection and security terms.
AI, Digital Innovation & Emerging Technologies
Provide legal guidance on AI frameworks, including EU AI Act implications.
Support the safe deployment of AIdriven tools and digital capabilities across the firm.
Digital & Technology Regulatory Requirements
Monitor and interpret emerging EU/UK regulations relating to data, digital services, fintech, operational resilience and cybersecurity.
Advise on implementation programmes and ensure PIMCO’s global practices align with local regulatory expectations.
Business & Technology Change Projects
Partner with project teams on IT upgrades, digital transformation, operational changes and AI rollouts.
Identify and address legal and regulatory considerations across privacy, digital, cybersecurity and outsourcing domains.
Cybersecurity & Incident Response
Advise on cybersecurity legal obligations and internal policies.
Support breach response, regulatory notifications, client communications and incident remediation.
Lead on legal aspects of fraudulent incidents (e.g., website or email impersonation scams).
EMEA Regional Coverage
Act as the regional expert on data, digital and technology laws.
Manage external counsel relationships and contribute to global initiatives by bringing an EMEA perspective.
Required Qualifications
Qualified Lawyer with strong academic credentials (UK or relevant EMEA jurisdiction).
3+ years PQE in data protection, technology law, IT/cybersecurity or related fields, including substantial GDPR work.
Deep expertise in EU/UK privacy frameworks (GDPR, Data Protection Act, e-Privacy, international transfers).
Strong understanding of AI, cybersecurity and technology regulations, including the EU AI Act.
Excellent drafting and negotiation skills, especially for DPAs, outsourcing agreements and IT vendor contracts.
Strong analytical capability to navigate complex and emerging digital regulatory issues.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to distil complex requirements for business and technical teams and present to senior audiences.
Clientservice mindset, proactive, responsive and able to work independently within a collaborative legal team.
Preferred Experience
Experience within financial services or asset management (inhouse or advisory) is highly desirable.
Prior inhouse legal counsel experience.
Exposure to multijurisdictional regulatory implementations or crossborder projects.
Why Join PIMCO
Data and technology innovation are increasingly central to financial services. This role offers the opportunity to support PIMCO’s expanding business, shape digital transformation initiatives, and contribute to the firm’s reputation for operational excellence.
Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Statement
PIMCO recruits and hires qualified candidates without regard to race, national origin, ancestry, religion (including religious dress and grooming practices), sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender (including gender identity and expression), age, military or veteran status, disability (physical or mental), any factor prohibited by law, and as such affirms in policy and practice to support and promote the concept of equal employment opportunity and affirmative action, in accordance with all applicable federal, state, provincial and municipal laws. The company also prohibits discrimination on other basis such as medical condition, or marital status under applicable laws.
Applicants with Disabilities
PIMCO is an Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. We provide reasonable accommodation for qualified individuals with disabilities, including veterans, in job application procedures. If you have any difficulty using our online system due to a disability and you would like to request an accommodation, you may contact us at 949-720-7744 and leave a message. This is a dedicated line designed exclusively to assist job seekers with disabilities to apply online. Only messages left for this purpose will be considered. A response to your request may take up to two business days.

jobs.title: VP Product Manager, Credit Technology
jobs.text:
We are a leading global asset management firm with over 3,000 employees across 20 offices in 15 countries; we help millions of investors around the world pursue their financial goals.
We hire critical thinkers. People who thrive in a collaborative culture like ours where we solve real problems while building the future of finance.
You
Are excited to be part of a vibrant engineering community that values diversity, hard work, and continuous learning.
Love solving complex real-world business problems.
Recognize that cross-functional collaboration is a core component of success for the team.
Believe there are multiple ways to solve most technical problems and are willing to debate the trade-offs.
Have become a stronger engineer by making mistakes and learning from them.
Are a doer, someone who wants to grow their career and gain experience across technologies and business functions.
We
Continuously invest in a high-performance and inclusive culture, in which a diversity of backgrounds, experiences and viewpoints are celebrated and valued.
Encourage career mobility, so you can benefit from learning different functions and technologies, and we gain the benefits of your experience across teams.
Run technology pro bono programs that help the non-profit community and give our engineering community opportunities to volunteer and participate.
Offer education reimbursements and ongoing training in technology, communication, and diversity & inclusion.
Embrace knowledge sharing through lunch-and-learns, demos, and technical forums.
Consider our people to be our greatest asset—we will help you learn what PIMCO Technology has to offer so you can participate in activities that benefit your career while delivering impactful technology solutions.
We are seeking a senior, business-oriented Vice President, Product Manager to lead multi-year product strategy and execution for Credit Technology platforms that support investment research, analytics, and trading workflows. This leader will partner closely with credit analysts, portfolio managers, traders, credit analytics teams, engineers, data teams, and senior stakeholders to deliver scalable technology solutions that improve workflow efficiency, enhance data accessibility, and strengthen decision-making across the credit lifecycle. The role also provides senior leadership across governance, roadmap prioritization, resourcing, operating model maturity, and post-release accountability to ensure product outcomes are adopted, measured, and continuously improved.
Key Responsibilities
Own the multi-year product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Credit Technology platforms supporting research, analytics, trading, and portfolio management workflows.
Serve as a senior product partner to credit analysts, portfolio managers, traders, credit analytics teams, engineering leads, and technology leadership.
Translate complex credit business needs into clear product priorities, requirements, business cases, and delivery plans for engineering and data teams.
Lead roadmap prioritization across competing stakeholder needs, balancing business value, regulatory and operational risk, technical feasibility, scalability, and time-to-market.
Lead cross-functional governance and decision forums to align stakeholders on priorities, scope, dependencies, risks, tradeoffs, and measurable outcomes.
Drive delivery of tools, dashboards, data products, workflow applications, analytics capabilities, and AI-enabled solutions that improve credit decision-making and operating efficiency.
Establish product success measures, adoption metrics, data quality indicators, and performance dashboards to evaluate impact and guide investment decisions.
Oversee testing, validation, rollout, change management, and user adoption for complex business logic and mission-critical credit applications.
Partner with engineering leadership on platform architecture, system design trade-offs, API strategy, data integration, and long-term modernization opportunities.
Partner with engineering leadership on capacity planning, sequencing, dependency management, and resourcing decisions across the Credit Technology portfolio.
Own post-release accountability by monitoring adoption, operational health, product stability, user feedback, and continuous improvement opportunities after rollout.
Communicate product strategy, delivery progress, risks, and recommendations to senior business and technology stakeholders in an executive-ready format.
Coach and mentor junior product managers, analysts, and cross-functional contributors while scaling consistent product practices, governance, prioritization discipline, and operating model maturity within Credit Technology.
Required Qualifications
8+ years of product management, technology strategy, business analysis, or related experience within financial services, asset management, capital markets, or enterprise technology.
Demonstrated experience leading product strategy and roadmap execution for complex platforms, data products, workflow tools, analytics applications, or trading and investment technology solutions.
Strong understanding of fixed income, credit markets, investment research, portfolio management, trading workflows, or related asset management processes.
Proven ability to partner with senior investment professionals, business stakeholders, engineers, data teams, and technology leaders to define and deliver high-impact solutions.
Experience gathering and refining complex requirements, structuring business cases, prioritizing roadmaps, and translating ambiguous needs into actionable product deliverables.
Strong analytical and technical fluency, including familiarity with data models, relational databases, APIs, dashboards, reporting tools, and modern software delivery practices.
Excellent communication, stakeholder management, executive presentation, and influence skills in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Mathematics, Economics, Finance, Financial Engineering, Business, or a related technical or quantitative field.
Preferred Qualifications
PhD, MBA, CFA, or advanced degree in a quantitative, technical, or finance-related field preferred.
Experience with credit investment platforms, trading systems, portfolio analytics, research management tools, risk analytics, or investment data platforms.
Hands-on familiarity with SQL, Python, Power BI, or similar data analysis and visualization tools.
Experience delivering AI-enabled, data science, or automation capabilities for investment, research, trading, or operational workflows.
Experience operating in a highly regulated financial services environment with strong attention to controls, resiliency, auditability, and data quality.

jobs.title: Senior Director of Engineering, AI Agents
jobs.text:
At Podium, we bring AI Employees to local businesses that turn every conversation into revenue. Trusted by 60,000+ businesses across Auto, Home Services, and Aesthetics, Podium captures and converts leads 24/7, driving both new business and repeat customers.
In under 24 months, we crossed $100M in AI Agent ARR, scaling 300% year-over-year. During this time, we’ve deployed 10,000 AI employees to empower real business outcomes for our customers. Podium is building what we believe will be the most impactful AI employee ecosystem for local business.
Podium has been recognized as the Best AI Implementation by Inc. Magazine, highlighted by OpenAI for building revenue-driving AI Agents, and awarded the #1 AI Agent for Business Operations by G2.
Our growth is fueled by hiring exceptional people, holding them to high standards, and creating opportunities for them to grow and make an impact. Our operating principles guide daily behavior and ensure we hire people who will thrive at Podium. If you're hungry for growth, aligned to our operating principles, and ready to get to work, you won't find a better place to learn and accelerate your career.
About the Role:
Podium built the AI Employee local businesses now depend on to answer every lead, book every appointment, and win the moments that used to slip through the cracks. It's not a chatbot bolted onto a CRM — it's an autonomous teammate that qualifies leads, holds real conversations, and closes the loop from first message to booked revenue, 24/7.
We're looking for a Senior Director of Engineering to take ownership of our AI Agents product and turn it from a fast-growing platform into the industry-defining agent infrastructure for local business. This is a hands-on leadership role — equal parts zero-to-one builder and scale-up operator. You'll architect and ship the systems that let our agents reason, act, and get better over time, while building the team and the org-level muscle to run these systems reliably at massive scale, across thousands of customer-facing workflows and business verticals.
What you will be doing:
Owning the technical architecture and roadmap for Podium's AI agent platform — the orchestration layer, tool-use frameworks, memory, and reasoning systems that power customer-facing agents across every industry vertical we serve
Leading and growing a team of engineers building and operating production agent systems, setting the technical bar and staying hands-on in design, code, and incident response where it matters most
Building and maturing our evaluation infrastructure — the offline and online eval harnesses, quality metrics, and feedback loops that let us ship agent improvements with confidence instead of guesswork
Driving the "0 to 1" build-out of new agent capabilities and workflows, then the "1 to scale" work of hardening those systems for reliability, latency, and cost as usage grows into the tens of millions of conversations
Partnering closely with Product to translate business outcomes (response time, conversion, show rate, revenue recovered) into agent capabilities and prioritized technical bets
Partnering with Infrastructure/Platform teams to ensure agent systems are observable, cost-efficient, and resilient at scale — this includes model routing, latency budgets, fallback behavior, and guardrails
Working directly with customers and customer-facing teams (Sales, CS, Support) to understand where agents succeed or fail in the field, and feeding that signal back into the roadmap
Establishing best practices for prompt/context engineering, agent testing, safety and guardrails, and responsible deployment of autonomous systems in live customer environments
Representing AI Agents engineering in leadership conversations — setting a clear technical narrative, calling out risk early, and making sound build-vs-buy and model-vs-vendor tradeoffs
What you should have:
10+ years of software engineering experience, including significant time in engineering leadership roles (Director, Head of Engineering, or equivalent scope as a hands-on lead)
Direct experience building and operating production LLM-powered or agentic systems — not just prototypes, but systems serving real users at real volume with real reliability requirements
Deep fluency in applied AI architecture: orchestration frameworks, tool-calling/function-calling patterns, RAG and context management, and the tradeoffs between latency, cost, and quality
A track record of building and scaling evaluation systems for non-deterministic software — you know how to measure agent quality, catch regressions, and make shipping decisions without waiting for perfect certainty
Experience leading both "0 to 1" builds and "1 to scale" hardening — you've stood up something from nothing and you've also kept something running under real production load
Strong instincts for working cross-functionally with Product, Infrastructure, and customer-facing teams, and the communication skills to align technical decisions with business outcomes
Genuine, hands-on fluency with modern AI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or similar) as part of how you and your team build
What we hope you have:
Experience building agent systems specifically for customer-facing, revenue-critical workflows (sales, support, scheduling, or similar)
Familiarity with voice AI, conversational AI, or real-time multimodal systems
Experience operating in a high-growth SaaS or vertical software company, ideally one serving SMB customers
A point of view on the frontier of agentic AI — what's changing fast, what's overhyped, and where the real leverage is for a company like Podium
Why you'll love working here:
Podium is the best place to work to:
Join the leaders in AI agents — you'll be building on top of a product already trusted by 60,000+ businesses to run their AI Employee, with a real mandate and real usage to learn from
Unlock career-defining growth — this role owns a product area at the center of Podium's future, with the scope and visibility that comes with it
Build with world-class talent — join a team of engineers who ship fast, use AI tooling seriously, and care as much about outcomes as elegance
Make a real impact on local business — the agents you build directly help local businesses respond faster, convert more leads, and grow revenue without adding headcount
Podium is an equal opportunity employer. Podium provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, genetic information, marital status or veteran status.

jobs.title: Head of Enterprise Solutions Engineering & Delivery
jobs.text:
Head of Enterprise Solutions Engineering & Delivery
Location: Saudi Arabia / Riyadh
Employment Type: Full-time
Company: nakhla.ai
Reports to: CEO
About nakhla.ai
nakhla.ai builds enterprise-grade, AI-enabled software solutions that help organizations automate operations, integrate business systems, and deploy intelligent agents securely at scale.
Our platform combines enterprise applications, intelligent automation, system integrations, workflow orchestration, and AI capabilities to deliver measurable business outcomes for organizations.
Role Overview
We are seeking a highly experienced, hands-on Head of Enterprise Solutions Engineering & Delivery to lead the design, implementation, deployment, and ongoing delivery of enterprise technology solutions.
This role combines solution architecture, customer implementation, platform engineering, technical program management, operational reliability, security, quality assurance, and delivery leadership.
The successful candidate will own the customer delivery lifecycle, starting with technical discovery and solution design and continuing through configuration, integration, testing, deployment, production readiness, and post-launch stabilization.
This is not a traditional project management or advisory position. The candidate must be technically strong, commercially aware, customer-facing, and capable of making practical architecture and delivery decisions.
Key Responsibilities
Enterprise Solution Architecture
Lead technical discovery sessions with enterprise customers and key stakeholders.
Understand customer business processes, operational requirements, existing systems, security constraints, and success criteria.
Translate business requirements into scalable technical architectures and implementation plans.
Design solutions involving enterprise applications, APIs, AI agents, workflow automation, identity management, data migration, and third-party integrations.
Define system boundaries, data flows, integration patterns, security controls, and deployment models.
Ensure customer requirements align with nakhla.ai’s long-term product and platform strategy.
Challenge unnecessary customization and identify opportunities to create reusable product capabilities.
Produce solution architecture documents, technical specifications, implementation blueprints, and acceptance criteria.
Customer Implementation and Delivery
Own enterprise implementation projects from initial kickoff through production launch.
Develop delivery plans, milestones, dependencies, resource requirements, and risk mitigation strategies.
Coordinate internal engineering teams, external partners, and customer stakeholders.
Manage project scope, priorities, timelines, risks, and customer expectations.
Configure enterprise applications, workflows, roles, permissions, approval processes, and business rules.
Oversee data migration, validation, reconciliation, and production transition activities.
Lead user acceptance testing, customer training, deployment readiness, and go-live planning.
Ensure implementation decisions, configurations, and technical dependencies are documented clearly.
Manage post-launch stabilization and transition customers into ongoing support and operations.
Platform Engineering and Integrations
Contribute directly to backend services, system integrations, APIs, and platform components when required.
Design and implement secure integrations with customer applications, financial systems, productivity platforms, identity providers, databases, and external services.
Work with APIs, webhooks, message queues, event-driven architectures, authentication protocols, service accounts, and secure credential management.
Support the architecture of multi-tenant enterprise systems and customer data isolation.
Contribute to platform capabilities related to authentication, authorization, usage tracking, billing, auditability, and observability.
Review technical designs and code to ensure maintainability, scalability, reliability, and security.
Establish reusable integration patterns, technical standards, implementation templates, and engineering best practices.
Enterprise Applications and Business Processes
Lead discovery, configuration, customization, migration, and integration activities for enterprise business systems.
Map customer processes across finance, procurement, sales, inventory, operations, human resources, and other business functions.
Configure workflows, approval processes, roles, permissions, reports, and operational controls.
Ensure data integrity, completeness, and reconciliation during migration from existing systems.
Identify where standard platform functionality should be used instead of unnecessary custom development.
Work closely with finance, operations, technology, and executive stakeholders to validate business logic and controls.
Ensure implemented solutions support customer governance, accountability, and operational requirements.
AI and Intelligent Automation
Collaborate with AI engineers to integrate intelligent agents and automation into enterprise processes.
Define safe and auditable agent actions, permissions, tools, approval requirements, and escalation paths.
Design human-in-the-loop workflows for sensitive, regulated, or high-impact operations.
Ensure AI-enabled capabilities comply with customer security, privacy, governance, and operational requirements.
Support the integration of AI agents with enterprise applications, databases, documents, APIs, and communication systems.
Evaluate AI use cases based on business value, operational feasibility, technical complexity, implementation risk, and scalability.
Establish monitoring, evaluation, testing, and quality controls for production AI systems.
Ensure AI capabilities remain explainable, traceable, controlled, and aligned with customer policies.
Security, Infrastructure, and Reliability
Define and enforce deployment, infrastructure, security, and operational standards.
Support cloud architecture, Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD pipelines, environment management, and release processes.
Establish appropriate separation between development, testing, staging, and production environments.
Implement or oversee monitoring, logging, tracing, alerting, backups, and disaster recovery procedures.
Ensure secure secrets management, credential rotation, network controls, encryption, and access governance.
Contribute to incident response, root cause analysis, corrective actions, and production reliability improvements.
Ensure customer environments meet agreed security, availability, performance, and data protection requirements.
Support enterprise security reviews, technical due diligence, risk assessments, and compliance readiness activities.
Maintain operational documentation, recovery procedures, escalation paths, and production support standards.
Quality Assurance
Define quality standards, release gates, and acceptance criteria.
Establish automated testing practices for APIs, integrations, permissions, workflows, data processing, and critical user journeys.
Ensure testing covers customer data isolation, role-based access, authentication, authorization, billing, data integrity, and intelligent agent behavior.
Coordinate functional, integration, regression, security, performance, and user acceptance testing.
Prevent production releases without appropriate validation, documentation, rollback plans, monitoring, and approvals.
Track defects, production incidents, recurring failures, and quality trends across implementations.
Ensure lessons from customer deployments are incorporated into platform and delivery improvements.
Delivery Operations and Team Leadership
Build repeatable delivery processes, implementation methodologies, templates, checklists, and operational playbooks.
Define ownership, accountability, and handoff points across sales, product, engineering, implementation, and support.
Improve implementation speed, delivery predictability, solution quality, and customer satisfaction.
Mentor engineers, implementation specialists, solution architects, and technical project team members.
Support the hiring and development of the future solutions engineering and delivery organization.
Identify delivery bottlenecks and recommend organizational, operational, or technical improvements.
Provide clear reporting on project status, risks, dependencies, resource needs, and delivery performance.
Participate in customer proposals, technical presentations, solution demonstrations, commercial discussions, and statements of work.
Ensure delivery commitments are realistic, measurable, and aligned with available capabilities and resources.

Coordinate functional, integration, regression, security, performance, and user acceptance testing.
Prevent production releases without appropriate validation, documentation, rollback plans, monitoring, and approvals.
Track defects, production incidents, recurring failures, and quality trends across implementations.
Ensure lessons from customer deployments are incorporated into platform and delivery improvements.

blocks.text: Delivery Operations and Team Leadership

items: Build repeatable delivery processes, implementation methodologies, templates, checklists, and operational playbooks.
Define ownership, accountability, and handoff points across sales, product, engineering, implementation, and support.
Improve implementation speed, delivery predictability, solution quality, and customer satisfaction.
Mentor engineers, implementation specialists, solution architects, and technical project team members.
Support the hiring and development of the future solutions engineering and delivery organization.
Identify delivery bottlenecks and recommend organizational, operational, or technical improvements.
Provide clear reporting on project status, risks, dependencies, resource needs, and delivery performance.
Participate in customer proposals, technical presentations, solution demonstrations, commercial discussions, and statements of work.
Ensure delivery commitments are realistic, measurable, and aligned with available capabilities and resources.

Job Type: Full-Time

About Fulfillment IQ (FIQ):
Fulfillment IQ is a supply chain engineering and transformation company that helps brands, retailers, and 3PLs design, build, and scale high-performance logistics operations.
We work at the intersection of strategy, operations, and technology, where we solve complex, real-world problems across warehouse design, automation, order management, transportation, and end-to-end supply chain execution.
Our teams combine deep domain expertise with strong technical capability, delivering outcomes through consulting, systems implementation, and proprietary platforms that accelerate time-to-value and reduce delivery risk.
If you enjoy working in complex environments, partnering closely with clients, and seeing your work make a tangible impact on how global commerce moves, this is the place where your skills and judgment truly come to life.
Role Overview:
The Director of Sales, Technology Delivery is responsible for originating and closing API integration, software engineering, and systems implementation engagements.
This role requires strong technical commercial fluency and the ability to sell engineering outcomes while maintaining alignment with architectural feasibility and delivery capacity.
Key Responsibilities:
Build and manage a qualified pipeline of enterprise technology delivery opportunities from prospecting through close across 3PLs, retailers, and enterprise clients.
Lead early discovery around business objectives, user needs, existing systems, technical constraints, delivery priorities, and investment rationale.
Own pricing, proposal development, and negotiation.
Partner closely with FIQ’s architecture, product, engineering, delivery, consulting, and executive teams to shape pursuits, validate solution fit, and present a credible delivery path to clients.

Identify cross-sell opportunities across consulting and implementation.
Maintain ongoing client relationships.

A strong record of achieving revenue targets through the sale of technology delivery, custom software, digital transformation, modernization, or related technical services.

Work That Matters

jobs.title: Director of Engineering
jobs.text:
From empowering entrepreneurs to build successful businesses, to supporting their clients to arrange 'me time' moments, we're in the business of elevating people - helping them to thrive and feel fantastic. Lifting others up can be hard, heavy work, and we passionately believe that the sense of purpose and personal satisfaction this brings are worth it.
What started in Poland is now an international, cloud-based marketplace that's scaling rapidly. We bring independent business owners together with their customers on a product that connects creative communities and opens up worlds of opportunities.
For our providers, our products offer services for getting booked, paid, and building a loyal client base. For their clients, we're where they can find their favourite spots, discover new businesses and book appointments in an instant.
Working in a rapidly growing, ever-changing scale-up comes with its own set of opportunities and challenges. If you prefer a stable environment, with clear processes and structures then, we've got to be honest, you won't always find that here. However, if you enjoy inventively solving problems with others, helping create clarity when things get confusing, and prioritising your own path within ambiguity, then the chances are that you'll love the opportunities available to grow your career at Booksy.
The people you'll like to work with and things you'll enjoy impacting:
As a Director of Engineering reporting to the Chief Technology Officer in our Provider Domain, your purpose will be to own the technical strategy and delivery for the systems hundreds of thousands of independent businesses run on every day. You will:
Own end-to-end delivery across 4–5 cross-functional teams, leading through Engineering Managers and Staff+ Engineers in a deliberately flat structure with no layers in between.
Set the engineering standard for the domain — building the frameworks for architecture decisions, technical proposals and how teams work.
Lead our AI transformation of the engineering lifecycle, and define the measures that prove it worked.
Partner with Product to turn commercial strategy into engineering strategy, and back it with experimentation and data.
Build a team of exceptional density, coaching leaders who can operate autonomously.

jobs.title: Head of Engineering Delivery
jobs.text:
Summary of the position :
The Head of Engineering – Delivery, will be directly responsible for leading PMC’s India based delivery teams providing it’s software services & projects in to global customers.
The role requires strong technical leadership skills and able to navigate the complex project scenarios to drive best outcomes for PMC & customers. The role also emphasize on the deep technical knowhow, such as software development (across multiple programming stacks) and hold on SDLC using Cloud , Automation, DevOps & AI & ML practices.
This role will be primarily responsible for ensuring high quality & timeliness delivery of services for the Engineering team in India with focus on execution, governance of delivery and a continuous collaboration across all levels.
Leading a talented team of delivery managers, delivery leads and project managers you will ensure that through proactive planning, the team are set up to deliver current and future customer requirements across the range of Engineering propositions – Design & Architecture, Development, Test and Automation.
Key accountabilities:
As a leader you will be primary focused on
As Delivery leader, you are a hands-on, have strong technical foundation in SDLC and last 5+years as people leader able to manage directly and through others.
As a technically astute leader, your recognized subject matter expertise allows you regularly dive deep into key projects & services your teams provide.
Your focus is to provide strong technical and on-floor leadership & coaching to a talented team of project and dedicated service leaders, ensuring they are set up for success to deliver customer and team needs (total team size > 200-400).
As a Delivery leader, you shall be an Engineering face for PMC customers to drive higher standards of Agile Delivery , DevOps , Automation , AI/ML , Cloud and cutting edge technology conversations.
You will drive delivery performance and work closely with engineering excellence and operations team across all PMC’s Engineering Customers, working with your leadership team to ensure effective service set-up & transition, project governance & assurance, and customer satisfaction.
Be responsible to develop a strong high performance culture with engineers on the floor that focuses on sense of collective and individual ownership, high quality outcome and continuous learning
Contribute to and implement the strategic plan for engineering such as future proposition, technical initiative & learning in alignment with the company’s vision, objectives and future customer base.
Lead and drive a culture of innovation and collaboration across Engineering teams and wider PMC business units.
Lead on and act as the escalation for the resolution of customer specific service delivery issues in a timely way overseeing the design and implementation of specific ‘get well’ plans. Act as the senior ‘escalation’ for major service issues and customer champion for critical services.
Serve as a liaison between the engineering teams and senior management, providing regular updates on progress, challenges, and achievements to Engineering Director on our teams and our people.
Your role will collaborate with
Work with operations/resourcing & service design/pre-sales to ensure all new customer engagements are planned and successfully delivered.
Work with engineering excellence to ensure strong drive of the Continual Services Improvement Plan (CSIP) across the dedicated teams, covering contract understanding/compliance, service standards (productivity & quality) and customer Satisfaction reporting
You will also support in the driving of incremental new business and in the management of customer commercial performance.
Work with engineering excellence to drive best practices, enforce governance models, quality, standards, measurements (KPIs), ISO Compliance across engineering deliveries.
Work in partnership with the resourcing and planning team to effectively schedule and utilise the engineering talent for strong delivery performance. Work with the resource management team to map resources effectively to support optimal team performance and productivity.
Work with engineering governance to undertake periodic reviews to ensure that all processes drive strong efficiency and best practice, working with your leadership team to implement recommendations for improvement.
Work with senior stakeholders at BU level to effectively drive the change , communicate issues & implement improvement plan.
Work with Sales & Marketing teams by supporting them as required during internal & external customer meeting.
Skills and Experience| Essential:
You’ve at-least 15+ years of IT experience across various trends & cycles of Software Development and methodologies.
At least last 5+ years of experience in managing Software Delivery teams at scale of various application stacks & technologies.
You are obsessed with results, and effectively communicate objectives and how success will be measured to your teams and other stakeholders.
An inspirational leader and role model, with strong experience leading large & multiskilled engineering teams.
Proven experience and ability to provide a steer on how to apply engineering mindset to large number of delivery workstreams.
Experience in building and scaling service delivery teams (circa 200 to 400 member teams).
Passion for innovation and staying current with industry trends and emerging technologies.
Extensive experience in managing complex IT solutions delivery to the highest standard.
Commercially aware, with a good understanding of contractual requirements and obligations.
Experience in setting, improving and attaining service standards.
Customer credible and able to engage with customer stakeholders at all levels.

jobs.title: Head of Engineering - AI and Data Science
jobs.text:
About Euromonitor
Euromonitor International leads the world in data analytics and research into markets, industries, economies and consumers. We provide truly global insight and data on thousands of products and services; we are the first destination for organisations seeking growth. With our guidance, our clients can make bold, strategic decisions with confidence.
Overview of the role
Passport, Euromonitor's flagship platform, has just been rebuilt from the ground up. It is the largest technology investment in the company's history, and AI now sits at the core of the system.
Euromonitor is establishing an AI and Data Science team in India to lead this work. The remit is a framework driven, platform centric approach to engineering AI and Data Science capability into Passport and other customer offerings, including new products built on AI and agentic flows.
Based in Bengaluru and reporting to the VP & Global Head of Engineering, this is a leadership role for the function in India. It suits a technology leader with a strong software engineering background and proven expertise applying AI and Data Science through platforms and frameworks. That expertise should translate into delivering stronger products and business opportunities that are AI driven. The role also calls for a track record of building and scaling teams from the ground up, experience working across a geographically diverse, global organisation, and the ability to quickly understand emerging technologies and incorporate them into products that amplify business outcomes.
What you’ll do
Platform Strategy
Collaborate with other Heads of Data Science across Euromonitor to define a unified, platform centric strategy, roadmap and governance model for AI and Data Science across Passport and other customer offerings.
Set the operating model, governance and standards for the platform.
Own the platform roadmap for agentic AI products that turn Euromonitor's data into new customer experiences.
Advise executive leadership on where to invest in AI and analytics capability.
Agentic AI and Data Science Competency
Agentic AI product offerings that use Euromonitor's data to enhance customer experience, unlock new revenue streams and create new offerings.
AI driven search and discovery, including RAG based retrieval, that surfaces relevant insights across structured and unstructured data.
Recommendation engines and natural language processing that power discovery and personalisation across Passport and other products.
Evaluation mechanisms that measure the accuracy, relevance and quality of AI and agentic outputs, to keep search, discovery and agentic offerings reliable at scale.
Workflow optimisation through agentic automation, reducing manual effort and improving speed across Passport and other products.
Creation of reusable AI & data science assets, features and agentic components that can be applied across Passport and other products.
Applied understanding of Machine Learning models and techniques, expressed through mechanisms such as ranking, personalisation and recommendation that strengthen search, discovery and agentic capability.
Efficient, cost-effective deployment of agentic AI systems and product features in production, at speed and scale, with governance, AI Ops, monitoring, quality controls and Responsible AI practices.
Partnership with Engineering, Architecture and Data Platform teams to build production ready AI platforms and AI Ops pipelines on Euromonitor's cloud native architecture.
Integration of AI and analytics capability into Euromonitor's products, in partnership with Product, Engineering, Data Platform, Research and Commercial teams.
Leadership
Hire, coach and develop Euromonitor's AI and Data Science team in India.
Build a pipeline of future technical leaders within the team.
Lead with a metrics driven approach, using data to track outcomes and guide decisions across the team.
Lead with transparency and a collaborative approach, building trust across the team and with stakeholders.
Set the working culture and norms for the team from its first hires.

jobs.title: Technical Chief of Staff - Office of the CTO & CSO
jobs.text:
Quandela stands as a global leader in quantum computing, driven by groundbreaking technology and a strategic vision for scaling quantum solutions. The company’s unique ability to offer both hardware and software solutions, along with its commitment to build energy efficient datacenters and scalability, positions it to play a key role in the next wave of innovation, and in many strategic and sovereign industrial sectors.
Join Us at the Forefront of Quantum Computing Innovation !
We are looking for a Technical Chief of Staff to the CTO and Chief Scientific Officer (CSO) to join the Office of the CTO & CSO and support the execution of Quandela’s technical and scientific strategy.
Working at the core of the company’s technical leadership, you will help structure priorities, coordinate strategic initiatives across research, product and engineering teams, and ensure alignment between long-term scientific objectives and operational execution.
This role is designed as a force multiplier for the CTO and CSO, enabling them to focus on scientific and technical leadership while ensuring that key initiatives, internal coordination and decision processes run smoothly.
As part of the Office of the CTO & CSO, the role provides direct exposure to the executive leadership team (COMEX) and involvement in shaping some of the company’s most strategic technical and scientific decisions.
The position operates at the intersection of research, engineering and product development, helping maintain clarity, alignment and execution discipline as the organization scales.
Impact in the First 12 Months
In this role, you will play a key part in strengthening the execution and coordination of Quandela’s technical and scientific strategy. During your first year, you are expected to:
Build alignment across research, product and engineering
Develop a strong understanding of Quandela’s scientific and technical roadmap.
Improve coordination mechanisms between research teams, product leadership and engineering.
Bring structure and visibility to key technical initiatives
Implement clear tracking and governance for major technical and scientific programs.
Ensure leadership has visibility on milestones, dependencies and risks.
Strengthen the Office of the CTO & CSO
Contribute to structuring the operating model of the Office of the CTO & CSO, including leadership rhythms and technical reviews.
Support preparation and follow-up of key leadership discussions and decision processes.
Accelerate cross-team execution
Help resolve cross-team challenges impacting critical technical initiatives.
Improve communication flows and coordination between research, product and engineering teams.
Support the scaling of the technical organization
Assist the CTO/CPO and CSO in structuring processes and initiatives that allow the organization to scale while maintaining scientific and technical excellence.
Key Responsibilities
Strategic Support to Technical Leadership
Support the CTO/CPO and CSO in structuring and driving Quandela’s technical and scientific priorities.
Prepare strategic materials, technical briefings and leadership reviews.
Help synthesize complex technical topics to facilitate decision-making at the leadership level.
Office of the CTO & CSO Operations
Contribute to the functioning of the Office of the CTO & CSO by structuring leadership processes and coordination mechanisms.
Support preparation and follow-up of technical leadership meetings, reviews and strategic discussions.
Help maintain alignment across research, engineering and product leadership.
Program Governance & Coordination
Track progress on key technical and scientific initiatives across the organization.
Ensure visibility on milestones, dependencies and risks.
Facilitate coordination between teams and support resolution of cross-team blockers.
Organizational Effectiveness (P1)
Improve internal processes supporting technical and research operations.
Structure communication flows between research teams and product and engineering teams
Ensure structuration of the teams
Help maintain alignment between scientific exploration and product development priorities.
Strategic Projects
Lead or coordinate high-impact cross-functional initiatives on behalf of the CTO/CPO and CSO.
Provide analytical and operational support on complex organizational or technical topics.
