jobs.title: Director - IT Software Engineering
jobs.text:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.
What is the role?
The enterprise software landscape is undergoing a structural shift. AI-assisted development has dropped the cost and time required to build custom internal tools by more than half. Retool's 2026 State of Internal Software report found that 35% of enterprises have already replaced SaaS tools with purpose-built software, and 78% plan to build more in the year ahead. The calculus has changed: what previously required a six-figure vendor contract and a year-long implementation is now a small engineering team and a few focused sprints.
Elastic is at the beginning of this journey. We operate the Elastic Stack — Elasticsearch, Kibana, Elastic ML, and a growing set of AI-native capabilities — at production scale for thousands of customers. And we are increasingly building on our own platform internally: replacing expensive SaaS tools with Elastic-native systems that are faster, more intelligent, and owned entirely by us.
We are looking for a Director, IT Engineering to join our Information Technology team to lead this effort. This is not a passive IT management role or a SaaS administration leadership position. It is a high-impact engineering leadership role where you will manage a small, agile team of engineers who look at $500,000 annual SaaS contracts, ask: 'Could we build a better version of this on Elasticsearch in twelve weeks?' — and execute.
This is a rare opportunity to lead original product engineering inside an IT organization, working with a platform that most engineers only get to use as a customer — and to build systems that directly shape how a public company operates.
What You Will Be Doing:
Lead strategic build-vs-buy engineering
Work with IT leadership, Finance, and Engineering to evaluate Elastic's internal SaaS portfolio and identify where custom-built systems — backed by Elasticsearch, Kibana, and Elastic's AI capabilities — deliver better value than continued vendor contracts.
Own the architectural oversight, build plan, and overall delivery of the highest-priority replacements.
Lead a high-performing engineering team
Build, mentor, and lead a small, focused team of software engineers executing on internal tool replacements and Elastic-native platforms.
Manage delivery roadmaps, unblock your team, and balance engineering rigor with rapid execution speed.
Design & build Elastic-native internal Platforms: Guide your team in designing and delivering systems across five primary focus areas:
Platform productivity tools: Internal developer portals, knowledge search layers, engineering onboarding systems, and workspace tooling that unifies disparate SaaS tools into a single Elasticsearch-backed search and intelligence layer.
FinOps and AI cost governance: A consolidated cost visibility and anomaly detection system across Elastic's AI providers (Anthropic, OpenAI Codex, GitHub Copilot, Google Gemini) and cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure), replacing commercial FinOps SaaS with an Elastic ML-powered alternative.
IT service management: Evaluating and building replacements for commercially purchased SaaS products including incident management, knowledge base search, internal developer portal, and SIEM-correlated security workflows, using Elastic Observability and Elastic Security as the backbone.
Enterprise efficiency systems: Custom tooling that reduces manual process overhead across IT, Finance, HR, Legal and Operations, using the LLM Gateway, RAG pipelines, and Elasticsearch as the data and intelligence layer.
New use cases : New use cases that traditionally SaaS paid services did not address and can now be built with AI native architecture.
Set the engineering standard
Establish and own the architectural standards, design patterns, and engineering practices for all IT platform engineering work.
Define how internal systems are built — data models, API design, observability, cost governance, security posture — and serve as the engineering authority for your team.
Collaborate across the company
Partner closely with Elastic's IT infrastructure team, the Security organization (Elastic Security is your SIEM backbone), the Platform Engineering team, and Finance.
Engage with tool owners across the company to understand requirements, challenge assumptions about what needs to be bought versus built, and ensure that the systems your team builds actually get used.
Dogfood and validate Elastic's own products
Run Elastic's own technology in the most demanding possible context: as the engineering leader responsible for the internal systems that the company depends on every day.
Every system your team builds is a reference architecture. Ensure that insights generated about what works and what doesn't feed directly into Elastic's product and go-to-market strategy.
What You Bring
Required experience
12+ years of software engineering experience, including experience managing or leading direct engineering reports or small engineering teams.
Hands-on familiarity and technical capability with Elasticsearch — data modeling, query design, aggregations, performance tuning, and production operations.
Proven track record of guiding full-stack engineering delivery end-to-end, from Logstash ingest pipelines to Kibana dashboards to React frontends.
Proven track record of building, shipping, and managing commercial software or platform systems — not just maintaining existing ones.
Architectural judgment: the ability to scope a problem correctly, choose the right components, and make executive calls on when to build versus integrate versus buy.
Strong written communication to author architecture decision records, engineering standards documents, executive proposals, and build-vs-buy analyses.
Valued experience
Experience leading teams that build on the Elastic Stack beyond basic logging — Elastic ML, ELSER semantic search, vector search, Kibana Canvas, Watcher, or Elastic Security.
Experience with FinOps practices: cloud cost management, LLM API cost attribution, or building cost visibility tooling.
Familiarity with Information Technology managed systems — understanding the core domain problems solved by platforms like Salesforce or ServiceNow.
Experience working in a hypergrowth or post-IPO technology company where engineering rigor and business speed have to coexist.
Experience with LLM integration patterns: RAG pipelines, prompt engineering for enterprise use cases, LLM gateway design, or AI-powered workflow automation.
Contributions to internal developer experience, platform engineering, or engineering productivity tooling.
What This Role Is Not
Not a SaaS administrator or vendor manager: This is an engineering execution role, not a role for managing third-party vendor contracts, Salesforce admins, or ServiceNow developers.
Not a pure infrastructure or DevOps role: Your team uses cloud infrastructure, but the primary deliverable is production-grade software systems, not infrastructure configuration.
Not a hands-off hands-free manager: While you will manage a small team, you are expected to stay deep in the architecture, review code, and set technical directions hands-on.
Not a role for rigid processes: Projects begin with open-ended questions ('Could we build this?') and require you and your team to define and ship the answer.
Compensation for this role is in the form of base salary. This role does not have a variable compensation component.
The typical starting salary range for new hires in this role is listed below. In select locations (including Seattle WA, Los Angeles CA, the San Francisco Bay Area CA, and the New York City Metro Area), an alternate range may apply as specified below.
These ranges represent the lowest to highest salary we reasonably and in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, and the ranges may be modified in the future.
An employee's position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, performance, and business or organizational needs.
Elastic believes that employees should have the opportunity to share in the value that we create together for our shareholders. Therefore, in addition to cash compensation, this role is currently eligible to participate in Elastic's stock program. Our total rewards package also includes a company-matched 401k with dollar-for-dollar matching up to 6% of eligible earnings, along with a range of other benefits offered with a holistic emphasis on employee well-being.
The typical starting salary range for this role is:
$199,700—$315,900 USD
The typical starting salary range for this role in the select locations listed above is:
$239,800—$379,300 USD
Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People
As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.
We strive to have parity of benefits across regions and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.
Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary
Health coverage for you and your family in many locations
Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles
Generous number of vacation days each year
Increase your impact - We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service
Up to 40 hours each year to use toward volunteer projects you love
Embracing parenthood with minimum of 16 weeks of parental leave
Different people approach problems differently. We need that. Elastic is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating an inclusive culture that celebrates different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law, ordinance or regulation.
We welcome individuals with disabilities and strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all individuals. To request an accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please email candidate_accessibility@elastic.co. We will reply to your request within 24 business hours of submission.
Applicants have rights under Federal Employment Laws, view posters linked below: Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA) Poster; Pay Transparency Nondiscrimination Provision Poster; Employee Polygraph Protection Act (EPPA) Poster and Know Your Rights (Poster)

If you are located in or are a national of one of the listed countries or regions, an export license may be required as a condition of your employment in this role. Not a SaaS administrator or vendor manager: This is an engineering execution role, not a role for managing third-party vendor contracts, Salesforce admins, or ServiceNow developers.
Not a pure infrastructure or DevOps role: Your team uses cloud infrastructure, but the primary deliverable is production-grade software systems, not infrastructure configuration.
Not a hands-off hands-free manager: While you will manage a small team, you are expected to stay deep in the architecture, review code, and set technical directions hands-on.
Not a role for rigid processes: Projects begin with open-ended questions ('Could we build this?') and require you and your team to define and ship the answer.

jobs.text:
S'more about the team
The Operations Data and Decisions Tribe at HelloFresh is responsible for driving operations planning by creating high quality, reusable data assets, data science models, and algorithmic solutions. Additionally, the tribe. This team has a direct impact on the customer experience and is constantly optimising for various Business KPIs. They build in-house products using modern technologies to handle a massive scale of transactions (>8.5 million active customers) and continuously improve the SDLC for fast flow and continuous delivery.
As a Director of Operations Planning Engineering, you will lead engineering teams (Data Science, Data Engineering, Software Engineering, & Analytics) and Staff Engineers across the mid-term planning domain, supporting their technical decision-making processes. Your responsibilities will include spearheading initiatives that traverse multiple teams and domains, such as those focused on network planning, demand planning, and production planning. Drawing upon your comprehensive understanding of the domain, you will own the planning architecture strategy and drive the long-term vision for how our planning systems should be integrated and scaled.
Lettuce share what this role will be responsible for
Lead an engineering squad comprising 10-15 engineers, managing Engineering Managers and Staff Engineers across Warsaw, Berlin, & USA.
Own the GenAI transformation — define and drive a concrete roadmap for becoming a genuinely AI-native engineering organisation: from AI-assisted development and automated incident response, to agentic workflows and LLM-powered tooling embedded in day-to-day operations.
Own the availability and reliability of HelloFresh's planning infrastructure — drive SRE practices, incident management, SLOs/SLIs, and on-call maturity across high-throughput systems serving multiple markets.
Set technical direction across Python, GoLang, PostgreSQL, Kafka, React, and React Native services on AWS, ensuring systems.
Partner with Product, Operations, Marketing, and Procurement providers to align engineering priorities with business outcomes.
Manage, coach, and develop Engineering Managers & Engineers — holding them accountable for team health, delivery, and engineering standards.
Navigate organisational change with maturity, keeping teams focused and motivated through evolving priorities.
Sound a-peeling? Here's what we're looking for
AI proficiency and advocacy. Hands-on familiarity with AI technologies and a demonstrable track record of championing their adoption — whether through AI-assisted development workflows, LLM-powered tooling, or driving team-wide GenAI-native ways of working.
Deep Technical Expertise. Mastery of a broad range of technical skills relevant to Operations Planning — including planning systems, data science modeling, data engineering, database systems, distributed computing, and backend development frameworks. Hands-on familiarity with full stack application development.
Systems Thinking. The ability to understand complex systems holistically, recognising how components interact and impact each other, and leveraging this to design scalable, resilient solutions in a high-throughput environment where downtime means direct revenue loss.
Proven Leadership at Scale. 10+ years in software engineering with 4+ years managing Engineering Managers — not just individual contributors. Demonstrated ability to lead distributed teams across multiple offices, building trust and maintaining high engineering standards without daily co-location.
Operational Excellence Mindset. Strong grounding in SRE practices — SLOs/SLIs, incident management, on-call culture, and observability tooling (Grafana or similar). Experience owning payments infrastructure in regulated, multi-market environments is a strong plus.
Cross-Functional Collaboration. Exceptional ability to work across engineering disciplines, Product, business stakeholders, and external service providers — fostering alignment towards common goals and translating business outcomes into engineering priorities.
Effective Communication Across Disciplines. Strong ability to articulate complex technical concepts clearly to diverse audiences, from engineers to senior business stakeholders.
Low ego, high ownership, and a bias toward clarity over complexity.
Let’s cut to the cheese, this is why you'll love it here
Shape the future of food: Play a key role in transforming how millions of people eat as we grow into a global food solutions company.
Drive transformational change: Your decisions will have a direct and immediate impact, helping to shape strategy, scale teams, and redefine leadership in a rapidly evolving business.
Build a global brand: Create deeper, more sustainable connections with our customers, putting them at the heart of every decision.
Compensation & Financial Wellbeing: Enjoy amazing discounts: 75% off weekly HelloFresh/Chefs Plate meal kits plus 50% off weekly Factor meal boxes.
Health & Wellbeing: Benefit from health and dental coverage from day one, a Health Spending Account, unlimited Headspace access, and 25% off GoodLife fitness memberships.
Flexibility & Work-Life: Receive generous vacation and PTO offerings. Benefit from a parental leave top-up program designed to support expectant parents.
Career & Development: Grow with dedicated L&D initiatives and career support, aligning with our "Learning Never Stops" value.
Flexible Hybrid Approach
At HelloFresh, we know that flexible work arrangements are essential in enabling you to do your best work, while balancing your personal and life needs. Offering remote work flexibility, along with the opportunity to interact and collaborate in the office are all a part of creating a great employee experience.
To meet these needs, we are pleased to provide Flexible Hybrid work. Flexible Hybrid is a people-first approach that is based on choice, trust, personalization, and empowers teams to choose when and how often they work from the office and work from home, in addition to team days and company days. This means a minimum of 2 days in office per week, with most teams in office between 2-3 days a week.

HelloFresh Canada uses AI-integrated technology to help us process and evaluate applications more efficiently. This includes tools that screen and assess candidate qualifications based on the requirements for this role. While these tools assist our workflow, all final selection decisions are made by our hiring team.

jobs.title: VP of Engineering
jobs.text:
Well, hello there 👋
Castify (Creators of Screencastify) is a leading technology company dedicated to improving communication and learning outcomes with video. We have established ourselves as a leader in the K-12 education sector in the United States and we are critical in helping scale a teacher and improve student outcomes. We are also actively expanding into new and exciting markets outside of K-12 including bringing our tested solution into companies and organizations. Castify is used by over 15M people today and is seeking a VP of Engineering to join our Squad!
About this role
What started as the simplest and most reliable screen recorder in the world, with millions of users, is now a multi-product, AI-first platform. Our near future is full of ambitious new goals, features, and products that will enable us to further improve how we provide service to our users and accelerate growth. ​
We prioritize fast iteration without compromising quality while maintaining attention to detail that creates the kind of seamless, high-quality experiences we’re known for. We’re looking for an experienced, strategic VP of Engineering to lead and scale our engineering organization as we continue building innovative products that impact millions of users worldwide.
This role will partner with Product and GTM teams to define and execute our technical vision, strengthen engineering operations, and help shape the future of video communication and AI-powered learning experiences.
What you'll do:
Lead a high-performing Engineering organization across multiple product areas and platforms.
Champion the adoption of AI-powered engineering tools and workflows to accelerate team velocity and output quality.
Partner with Product leadership to define technical strategy, roadmap priorities, and execution plans.
Drive engineering excellence by establishing scalable systems, development standards, and operational best practices.
Oversee the architecture, development, testing, deployment, and reliability of our products and infrastructure.
Shape and evolve our AI-first product strategy by enabling experimentation, rapid iteration, and scalable implementation.
Guide technical decision-making across frontend, backend, infrastructure, data, and platform initiatives.
Ensure strong execution across teams by removing blockers, clarifying priorities, and aligning engineering efforts to business outcomes.
Foster a strong engineering culture grounded in ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement.

jobs.text:
Why We Stand Out
Seeking a career-defining opportunity where your leadership, strategic vision, and client expertise are recognized and rewarded? Kaufman Rossin might be just the place for you.
As one of the top accounting firms in the country, our foundation is “people first.” In the words of James Kaufman, “we prioritize our people, their development, and their well-being. Our values are translated into action every day.”
Kaufman Rossin is a privately owned, independent public accounting firm, which means we are not beholden to outside investors or private equity influence. This independence allows us to prioritize long-term client relationships, maintain objectivity in our advisory approach, and make strategic decisions that benefit our people and clients, not external stakeholders. Our structure fosters agility, entrepreneurial thinking, and a collaborative culture where leadership is accessible, and innovation is encouraged.
Celebrated as the Best Place to Work in South Florida over a dozen times, Kaufman Rossin has grown to over 700 employees, with offices spanning the tri-county area, including sister entities Kaufman Rossin Wealth and Kaufman Rossin Alternative Investment Services.
Think you have what it takes?
How You’ll Contribute
Kaufman Rossin is seeking a VP of Platform Engineering to join our growing Information Technology team. In this role, you will lead the strategy, delivery, and governance of KR’s Platform Engineering function, including AI application development, Salesforce CRM, Azure and AWS cloud infrastructure, Microsoft 365, automation and application integration, M Files document management, and our global delivery team in Bengaluru.
Platform Engineering Leadership & Strategy
Define the technical roadmap for cloud platforms, DevOps, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, and AI assisted engineering tools
Build, develop, and retain a high performing global engineering team across South Florida and Bengaluru
Manage the Platform Engineering budget, including headcount, cloud costs, tools, and vendor contracts
Lead transformational initiatives while fostering professional development, accountability, and strong performance AI Applications (Internal & Client-Facing)
AI Applications
Establish the AI use case roadmap, model selection strategy, and governance framework
Oversee the development of Azure based AI applications, including retrieval augmented generation, document intelligence, conversational agents, and client solutions
Ensure responsible AI practices through content filtering, data isolation, audit logging, and appropriate governance controls
Salesforce CRM
Provide strategic oversight of Sales Cloud, Marketing Cloud, Service Cloud, and Experience Cloud
Partner with Marketing leadership to support campaign management, client engagement, and relationship strategies
Ensure Salesforce solutions align with business objectives, integration standards, and user needs
Azure and AWS Cloud Infrastructure
Lead cloud infrastructure strategy across Azure and AWS, including architecture, governance, security, and cost management
Oversee the migration from AWS to Azure and the transition from Citrix to Azure Virtual Desktop
Provide leadership across the Microsoft technology ecosystem, including Microsoft 365, Azure DevOps, Entra ID, Purview, and Sentinel
Automation and Application Integration
Lead KR’s automation capabilities across Automation Anywhere, UiPath, Power Automate, Workato, and MuleSoft
Define build, buy, and platform strategies that improve efficiency, scalability, and return on investment
Establish standards for application integration, automation governance, and solution delivery
M Files Document Management
Lead the technical implementation and ongoing development of M Files, including architecture, configuration, and integration with Salesforce and Azure
Ensure the platform supports the document management, audit, security, and compliance requirements of a CPA firm
Vendor and Stakeholder Management
Manage strategic relationships with Microsoft, Salesforce, AI providers, automation platforms, and other technology partners
Lead vendor evaluations, requests for proposals, proof of concept assessments, and technology recommendations
Collaborate closely with Infrastructure, Security, Data Insights, PMO, Operations, and business leaders
Communicate complex technical strategies clearly to executive, client, business, and technical audiences

jobs.title: VP of Engineering
jobs.text:
Join our team as a VP of Engineering and help virtualize biological experiments to accelerate discovery!
About Turbine
Turbine is building Virtual Assays - AI-powered predictive models that can run biological experiments in silico. We're combining deep learning with a systematic approach to biology to enable faster, cheaper, more extensive testing. Our team is small, focused, and composed of researchers and engineers who care deeply about getting biology right.
About This Role
We're looking for a VP of Engineering to own technical leadership across Turbine's engineering organization.
You'll build and lead the teams developing our Virtual Lab platform -the infrastructure and systems that power our Virtual Assay capabilities - while ensuring alignment, operational excellence, and scalability across the entire engineering function.
This is a hands-on leadership role where you'll drive technical strategy, maintain system reliability, establish infrastructure discipline, and partner closely with Product and AI to translate our scientific vision into robust, compliant, scalable systems.
You are a Turbiner if these personality traits apply to you:
You have self-awareness and strong intention on personal growth
You seek out feedback and learn from mistakes and apply what you learned
You take responsibility and focus on the outcomes over tasks
You focus on shared success and are open to challenging others respectfully to get the best possible outcome
You are in it for the long haul and have passion for our mission
Key Responsibilities
Build and lead engineering teams working on the Virtual Lab platform; ensure they are healthy, motivated, and staffed appropriately to deliver current products and anticipate future technical needs
Ensure Virtual Lab remains stable, performant, and operational at all times—owning reliability, incident response, and continuous improvement
Establish and maintain engineering standards, best practices, and technical alignment across the entire company to prevent silos and technical debt
Partner with Product to collect, analyze, and interpret system and user analytics; provide data-driven insights that inform product decisions and prioritization
Own scalability of architecture, ensuring our systems can grow with our data and user needs without accumulating technical debt
Lead compliance and security initiatives—understanding regulatory requirements and ensuring engineering practices and security posture remain current and robust
Build systems and processes to prevent infrastructure debris—manage unused resources, derelict deployments, and abandoned services to maintain cost efficiency and operational clarity
Mentor and develop engineering talent; create a culture of learning, ownership, and high standards

jobs.title: Head of Engineering
jobs.text:
About LeafLink
LeafLink is the largest unified B2B cannabis platform, providing licensed cannabis businesses a suite of tools to manage their business more effectively, sell or order from their favorite brands and accelerate growth. We are one platform, one solution and we’re defining the way thousands of cannabis brands, distributors, and retailers streamline their operations. With thousands of brands and retailers across 30+ markets in North America, we are setting the industry standard for how cannabis businesses grow together. LeafLink processes more than $5 billion in wholesale cannabis orders annually.
Our team, backed by funding from leading VC's, including Founders Fund, Thrive Capital, Nosara Capital, and Lerer Hippeau is poised to define the cannabis supply chain through technology. LeafLink was named one of Inc. 5000’s ‘Top 5000 Fastest-Growing Private Companies’; one of Fast Company's 'Top 10 Most Innovative Companies in Enterprise for 2020', joining the ranks of Amazon, Slack, and VMWare; one of Built In NYC's 'Best Places to Work in 2021'; 2024 Fast Company’s Best WorkPlaces for Innovators for Banking, Finance, and Fintech category; 2024 Green Market Report Award for Best Fintech in cannabis - and we're just getting started!
The Role
LeafLink is seeking a Head of Engineering to lead our entire engineering organization. This role owns the technical vision, architecture, and health of every engineering function and is accountable for how well our teams turn strategy into shipped, reliable software. You'll report directly into executive leadership, partner closely with Product, and represent engineering at the leadership table.
As Head of Engineering, you are the senior-most technical leader responsible for building the org itself: hiring and developing engineering managers, setting standards for how we plan and execute, and making the calls on architecture, tooling, and headcount that determine whether we can keep moving fast without breaking things. You'll work with modern technologies and concepts such as containerized and serverless design patterns, Python, Kubernetes, AWS-managed and self-hosted services, third-party integrations, and event-driven and distributed architectures. This is a rare opportunity to shape not just a roadmap, but the operating model of an engineering org at a pivotal size, big enough to need real structure, small enough that one leader can still touch everything that matters.
Ideal candidates possess a strategic mind for solving unique challenges with fitting solutions, and a track record of building high-performing teams and the managers who run them. They should be personable, decisive, flexible, and communicative, with a strong desire to implement change, grow the org thoughtfully, and bring a genuine passion for their craft. This role comes with the opportunity to define engineering leadership at a fast-paced, dynamic, and quickly growing company.
What You'll Be Doing
Translate company, product, and technology objectives and goals into a 1 - 3-year engineering plan, operating model, organizational structure, and execution roadmap. Lead rebuild versus refactor decisions related to platform enhancement and integration across all of our platforms
Create the right engineering organizational structure and lead the engineering team. Recruit, develop, and retain top engineering talent and set the bar for how the engineering team operates day to day
Set engineering-wide standards for planning, estimation, and delivery, and hold teams accountable to them without turning process into bureaucracy
Establish engineering metrics, operating rhythms, and governance that provide executive visibility into execution. Own and manage the technical architecture, infrastructure, security and technical debt speed and long-term stability.
Improve engineering velocity while reducing technical debt and operational risk.
Partner with product and business stakeholders to translate customer requirements into engineering priorities, ensuring engineering capacity, sequencing, and constraints are represented in roadmap decisions and the team delivers features that have measurable customer impact and move adoption., ensuring
Manage the engineering budget: headcount planning, vendor and tooling spend, and cloud cost, with a clear view of TCO
Establish company-wide engineering practices for code quality, testing, CI/CD, and on-call/incident response as the team scales past the size where informal norms hold
Own SOC 2 and broader security/compliance posture across engineering, partnering with IT and any external auditors
Create long-term sustainable mechanisms such as feedback loops, retros, postmortems, and eng-wide metrics for continuous improvement across performance, scale, delivery and org health.
Build and protect engineering culture as headcount grows: the norms around ownership, blameless problem-solving, and technical excellence that are easy to lose past 80 people
Champion agentic AI, LLM-powered code generation, and multi-agent orchestration to reimagine how services are built and operated at scale, compressing delivery timelines and raising engineering velocity.
What You'll Bring to the Team
12+ years of experience in software engineering, with 7+ years leading engineering managers (not just ICs)

blocks.text: About LeafLink

LeafLink is the largest unified B2B cannabis platform, providing licensed cannabis businesses a suite of tools to manage their business more effectively, sell or order from their favorite brands and accelerate growth. We are one platform, one solution and we’re defining the way thousands of cannabis brands, distributors, and retailers streamline their operations. With thousands of brands and retailers across 30+ markets in North America, we are setting the industry standard for how cannabis businesses grow together. LeafLink processes more than $5 billion in wholesale cannabis orders annually.

Our team, backed by funding from leading VC's, including Founders Fund, Thrive Capital, Nosara Capital, and Lerer Hippeau is poised to define the cannabis supply chain through technology. LeafLink was named one of Inc. 5000’s ‘Top 5000 Fastest-Growing Private Companies’; one of Fast Company's 'Top 10 Most Innovative Companies in Enterprise for 2020', joining the ranks of Amazon, Slack, and VMWare; one of Built In NYC's 'Best Places to Work in 2021'; 2024 Fast Company’s Best WorkPlaces for Innovators for Banking, Finance, and Fintech category; 2024 Green Market Report Award for Best Fintech in cannabis - and we're just getting started!
The Role

LeafLink is seeking a Head of Engineering to lead our entire engineering organization. This role owns the technical vision, architecture, and health of every engineering function and is accountable for how well our teams turn strategy into shipped, reliable software. You'll report directly into executive leadership, partner closely with Product, and represent engineering at the leadership table.

As Head of Engineering, you are the senior-most technical leader responsible for building the org itself: hiring and developing engineering managers, setting standards for how we plan and execute, and making the calls on architecture, tooling, and headcount that determine whether we can keep moving fast without breaking things. You'll work with modern technologies and concepts such as containerized and serverless design patterns, Python, Kubernetes, AWS-managed and self-hosted services, third-party integrations, and event-driven and distributed architectures. This is a rare opportunity to shape not just a roadmap, but the operating model of an engineering org at a pivotal size, big enough to need real structure, small enough that one leader can still touch everything that matters.

Ideal candidates possess a strategic mind for solving unique challenges with fitting solutions, and a track record of building high-performing teams and the managers who run them. They should be personable, decisive, flexible, and communicative, with a strong desire to implement change, grow the org thoughtfully, and bring a genuine passion for their craft. This role comes with the opportunity to define engineering leadership at a fast-paced, dynamic, and quickly growing company.

items: Translate company, product, and technology objectives and goals into a 1 - 3-year engineering plan, operating model, organizational structure, and execution roadmap. Lead rebuild versus refactor decisions related to platform enhancement and integration across all of our platforms

Create the right engineering organizational structure and lead the engineering team. Recruit, develop, and retain top engineering talent and set the bar for how the engineering team operates day to day
Set engineering-wide standards for planning, estimation, and delivery, and hold teams accountable to them without turning process into bureaucracy

Establish engineering metrics, operating rhythms, and governance that provide executive visibility into execution. Own and manage the technical architecture, infrastructure, security and technical debt speed and long-term stability.
Improve engineering velocity while reducing technical debt and operational risk.

Establish company-wide engineering practices for code quality, testing, CI/CD, and on-call/incident response as the team scales past the size where informal norms hold
Own SOC 2 and broader security/compliance posture across engineering, partnering with IT and any external auditors
Create long-term sustainable mechanisms such as feedback loops, retros, postmortems, and eng-wide metrics for continuous improvement across performance, scale, delivery and org health.
Build and protect engineering culture as headcount grows: the norms around ownership, blameless problem-solving, and technical excellence that are easy to lose past 80 people

Champion agentic AI, LLM-powered code generation, and multi-agent orchestration to reimagine how services are built and operated at scale, compressing delivery timelines and raising engineering velocity.

jobs.title: Director, Engineering
jobs.text:
At Dragos, the mission is personal. The systems we protect deliver the water you drink, power your home, and keep the hospitals your community depends on running. Those critical infrastructure systems that power our civilization around the world are under attack every day by adversaries. When those systems fail, people are immediately at risk. We are the global leader in xOT cybersecurity, combining technology, threat intelligence, and expert services. The people here chose this work because they understand what is at stake. Here, you will find a remote-first mission-driven team across North America, Europe, the Middle East, and APAC built on authenticity, transparency, and trust. If safeguarding the systems that protect your family, friends, and community is the kind of work that matters to you, you are in the right place.
Dragos is looking for an experienced Director of Engineering to lead a multi-team engineering organization building and sustaining our OT cybersecurity products, most notably the Dragos Platform. This role reports to the VP of Engineering, leads a minimum of four engineering managers, and is accountable for an overall organization of 35 to 50 people.
You will own a set of discipline-based engineering communities, such as frontend, backend, data, AI, etc. each led by a manager with a team of engineers in that discipline. Engineers from these communities staff cross-functional product teams that are led day to day by a tech lead and a product manager, with your managers serving in an advisory and coaching capacity. Success in this role means your managers and engineers raise the technical bar everywhere they are deployed, and that you drive department-wide improvements alongside your engineering and product director peers.
Responsibilities:
Lead, coach, and develop a team of engineering managers, each accountable for a discipline-based engineering community. Own their performance, growth, and effectiveness as people leaders.
Provide substantive technical guidance to your managers and their teams on software design and architecture, code quality practices, testing strategy, and review discipline. Stay close enough to the work to add real value in a design or code review.
Set the standard for AI-assisted engineering. Evaluate and roll out AI development tooling, define practices for its effective and responsible use, and coach your managers on where it accelerates delivery and where human judgment and review remain essential.
Own and drive key initiatives across the engineering department, working alongside your director peers on engineering standards, delivery practices, tooling, onboarding, and reduction of technical debt.
Partner closely with product directors to staff and support cross-functional product teams, balancing engineering capacity against roadmap commitments and resolving competing priorities at the lowest possible level.
Coach the tech leads and engineers in your organization so that product teams they support consistently deliver reliable, secure, and maintainable software.
Be accountable for the long-term health of the services and codebases your organization owns, including operational readiness and support for deployed product.
Build influential working relationships across engineering, product, and the wider business. Resolve the majority of disagreements yourself, and escalate the remainder promptly with clear context.
Own technical hiring for your organization: shape roles, run interview panels, and raise the bar on selection and onboarding.
Requirements:
8+ years leading software engineering teams, including 3+ years managing managers
Experience leading an engineering organization of 20 or more people across multiple teams
Strong technical background as a practicing software engineer and working fluency across technical architectures, including frontend, data, networking, backend, etc.
Demonstrated fluency with AI development tooling, including coding assistants, agentic workflows, and AI-assisted review and test generation, plus a clear point of view on how to adopt it across a team
Cybersecurity experience at a product company shipping commercial software to external customers
Excellent written and verbal communication, with the range to move between executive updates, peer negotiation, and detailed technical review
Experience supporting agile, cross-functional teams that pair engineering with product management
Experience with performance evaluation, promotion recommendations, and performance improvement processes
Nice to have:
Experience with OT or ICS environments, threat detection, or asset visibility products
Experience integrating engineering teams following an acquisition
Compensation:
Salary: $260,000
Competitive Equity Package
Comprehensive Benefits Plan

jobs.title: Director of Engineering, Organizations & Cells
jobs.text:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.
The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.
*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.
Overview of the Role
GitLab.com is being rebuilt as a horizontally scalable cluster. Two primitives make that possible: Organizations, the tenant boundary that makes a customer's data a single addressable, portable unit, and Cells, independent GitLab instances that host those Organizations and can be provisioned on demand across clouds and regions.
The target is a 100x increase in headroom for GitLab.com, delivered without customers ever seeing a cell. Same domain, same URLs, same product — a substrate underneath that scales by adding capacity rather than by negotiating with a single database.
The boundary we are building is worth more than the scale it unlocks. An isolated Organization can guarantee where its data lives and what travels with it. That turns data residency, regional control, in-region AI and search compute, and enforceable tenant-level policy into product capabilities rather than deployment exceptions. It is the foundation for a class of enterprise and regulated-market offerings that a shared-instance architecture cannot support.
We are hiring a Director of Engineering in India to lead this charter. You will build and run the engineering organization that takes Cells from first production migrations to the default way GitLab.com operates.
What you will do
Delivery of the Cells and Organizations roadmap — cell provisioning and lifecycle, the routing and topology layer, organization data migration tooling, and feature parity across the platform.
Migration execution. Cohort-based movement of customer Organizations onto cells with zero data loss, verified rollback, and no downtime outside the tenant in flight.
A multi-cloud, multi-region cell footprint and the architectural decisions that govern what stays cell-local and what crosses boundaries.
The engineering organization. Hire, level, and develop managers and senior ICs across several teams. Set the technical bar and the operating cadence.
Cross-functional leadership. This charter touches nearly every product group at GitLab. You will drive commitments and sequencing with peer engineering leaders, Product, Infrastructure, and Security — much of it asynchronously, across time zones, in public issues and merge requests.
How success is measured
Customer Organizations running on cells in production, migrated cleanly and on schedule.
Availability and latency improvements attributable to isolation and load distribution.
Infrastructure cost per unit of capacity trending down as the footprint grows.
Throughput and retention of the teams you build.
What you will bring
Engineering leadership at director scale
Experience leading multiple teams through managers (roughly 25–60 engineers), including hiring and developing managers.
A track record of shipping multi-quarter infrastructure programs with hard external dependencies — the kind where the hardest problem is sequencing across ten teams, not writing the code.
Comfort operating as a peer to VPs and staff-plus engineers: you can hold an architectural position on technical merit and change it when the evidence changes.
Strong written communication. GitLab is remote and asynchronous by default; influence here is exercised in documents.
Distributed systems depth
You have built and operated large-scale distributed systems in production — multi-tenant SaaS, sharded or cell-based architectures, control planes, or data platforms at comparable scale.
Working fluency in relational database scaling (partitioning, sharding, replication), data migration at scale, and request routing.
Real operational experience: incident command, capacity planning, and designing for blast-radius containment.
Cloud infrastructure at depth on at least one major provider, ideally more than one.
AI-native engineering
You understand what agentic access patterns do to a platform's read volume, concurrency, and authorization model, and you design for that rather than retrofitting it.
You use AI tooling in your own engineering practice and have raised the bar for it across a team.
How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees
Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
Flexible Paid Time Off
Team Member Resource Groups
Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
Growth and Development Fund
Parental Leave
Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.
Country Hiring Guidelines: GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.
Privacy Policy: Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us.
GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also GitLab’s EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know during the recruiting process.

jobs.title: Director, Site Reliability Engineering
jobs.text:
At Klaviyo, we value the unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives each Klaviyo (we call ourselves Klaviyos) brings to our workplace each and every day. We believe everyone deserves a fair shot at success and appreciate the experiences each person brings beyond the traditional job requirements. If you’re a close but not exact match with the description, we hope you’ll still consider applying. Want to learn more about life at Klaviyo? Visit klaviyo.com/careers to see how we empower creators to own their own destiny.
At Klaviyo, we empower creators to own their destiny. Our SaaS platform provides businesses of all sizes with powerful, easy-to-use marketing automation tools, making first-party data accessible and actionable like never before. We are a team of ambitious, bold peers who are insatiably curious and meticulous in our craft. As we scale globally, we are seeking a foundational leader to build and lead our Site Reliability functions from our new strategic hub in Dublin.
About the Team
The SRE team is the bedrock of trust for the 200,000+ businesses that rely on Klaviyo to power their growth. This team is responsible for the secure reliability, scalability, and performance of our entire platform: from our core data processing pipelines to our cutting-edge AI services. As a foundational leader in our new Dublin office, you will build this team from the ground up, establishing a center of excellence for platform integrity and playing a pivotal role in Klaviyo’s European expansion. You will be the ultimate custodian of the trust our customers place in us every day.
How You'll Make a Difference
Architect and Lead: Define the vision, strategy, and roadmap for a unified SRE organization. You will build and mentor a world-class, multi-disciplinary team of engineers in Dublin, fostering a culture of operational excellence, proactive problem-solving, and blameless learning.
Champion Reliability: Drive a "reliable by design" philosophy across all of engineering. Partner with product and platform teams to embed reliability principles into the entire software development lifecycle, from initial design to production deployment.
Own Platform Integrity: Take ownership of the availability, latency, performance efficiency, change management, monitoring, emergency response, and capacity planning for Klaviyo’s global platform.
Drive Automation: Build the "paved road" for Klaviyo engineers by developing automated, self-service tooling and infrastructure that enables teams to "move fast, no shortcuts".
Lead Through Incidents: Command reliability incidents, guiding teams to rapid resolution while fostering a culture of blameless post-mortems that drive meaningful, systemic improvements.

You are a proven engineering leader with a track record of building and scaling high-performing, geographically distributed teams in a fast-paced SaaS environment.
You are intellectually curious and a continuous learner, with a deep understanding of modern reliability principles.
You are a "Driver" who is biased toward action. You don’t wait for problems to find you; you proactively identify risks and rally teams to solve them.
You are a cross-functional influencer and an exceptional communicator, capable of articulating complex technical concepts to diverse audiences, from engineers to executives to enterprise customers.
You are a player-coach who can dive deep into technical details with your team while also developing and articulating a long-term strategic vision.
You are passionate about building a strong, inclusive team culture and have experience integrating new teams with existing ones across different time zones and cultures.
You thrive in an environment of high ambiguity and rapid change, embodying a "1% done" mindset and seeing opportunity in every challenge.

12+ years of experience in software engineering, with at least 5+ years in a leadership role managing SRE teams.
Proven experience building and scaling engineering teams, ideally with experience establishing a new team or office.
Deep, hands-on experience with cloud-native production systems at scale (AWS preferred).
Strong technical background in distributed systems, observability, container orchestration (Kubernetes), infrastructure as code (Terraform), and CI/CD principles.
Experience managing geographically distributed teams and fostering a strong, unified culture across multiple time zones.
You’ve already experimented with AI in work or personal projects, and you’re excited to dive in and learn fast. You’re hungry to responsibly explore new AI tools and workflows, finding ways to make your work smarter and more efficient.

jobs.title: Head of Technology
jobs.text:
Linah Group is seeking a Head of Technology to define and drive the company's technology strategy, lead digital transformation across all business sectors under the Group while enabling each business unit to innovate within its own market and manage a cross-functional IT organization spanning helpdesk support, software development, and enterprise systems (ERP).
This role will oversee Linah Group portfolio spanning Head office, agriculture sector, manufacturing sector, retail, and hospitality (the 5-star Sultan Gardens Resort in Sharm El Sheikh) and other subsidiaries.
Group-Wide Technology Leadership
Define and drive the overarching technology strategy and roadmap for Linah Group, ensuring alignment with business objectives across all sectors
Provide technology leadership and governance across Manufacturing, Head Office, Agriculture, and Hospitality, ensuring consistency in standards, security, and infrastructure while respecting each sector's specific needs
Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing technology organization, including sector-level technology leads for each business unit
Oversee IT infrastructure, cybersecurity, data governance, and enterprise systems across all four sectors
Manage the Group-wide technology budget, ensuring optimal allocation of resources and timely reinvestment in upgrades across sectors
Establish technology policies, standards, and best practices to ensure consistency, security, and scalability across the Group
Act as a key advisor to the executive leadership team and Board on technology strategy, risk, and investment decisions
Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement across all technology functions within the Group
Manufacturing
Ensure continuous technological upkeep and upgrade of production systems, ERP, and plant automation
Identify and implement technologies that improve manufacturing efficiency, quality, and safety
Head Office
Oversee core corporate IT systems, networks, and enterprise software supporting all business functions
Ensure Head Office systems remain current, secure, and integrated with sector-level platforms
Agriculture
Ensure continuous technological upkeep and upgrade of farming operations, including smart farming and agri-tech solutions
Evaluate and implement emerging agri-technology (IoT sensors, precision farming, automation) to improve yield and efficiency
Hospitality (5-Star Hotel)
Ensure continuous technological upkeep and upgrade of guest-facing and back-of-house systems, including property management systems and service platforms
Drive technology initiatives that enhance guest experience and operational efficiency in line with 5-star service standards

jobs.title: Director of RF Hardware Systems Engineering
jobs.text:
About Eridan
At Eridan we believe in the power of collaboration and communication to achieve our mission: connect the planet to empower a sustainable, shared future. That mission is possible with our patented transmitter which decreases the cost and power required to roll out 5G by 10x when deployed globally. This is all facilitated through our offices: our Sunnyvale headquarters has big windows (even in the lab!), is walking distance to downtown and the Caltrain, and fits the entire team in the cafeteria for our frequent company parties. Learn more about our mission here.
Director of RF Hardware Systems Engineering
About this Job
The Director of RF Hardware Systems Engineering is a senior technical leadership role that owns the systems engineering function across Eridan’s radio product lines. The role sits at the intersection of systems architecture, hardware integration, and cross-functional execution, and is responsible for ensuring that engineering outputs hold together as coherent, specification-compliant systems — not just collections of subsystems.
This role serves as the internal owner of system-level specifications and integration integrity. Requirements arrive from Solutions Engineering and Deployments; this role translates them into rigorous engineering deliverables and drives alignment across hardware, firmware, and software. The Director of RF Hardware Systems Engineering is the person who is accountable when a system does — or does not — perform as intended.
The role will initially focus on Eridan’s compact and high power radio unit product lines, with scope expected to expand as additional platforms come online. Leading an RF hardware systems engineering team is a core part of the mandate from the outset.
As a Director of RF Hardware Systems Engineering, You Will
Systems Engineering Ownership
Own end-to-end systems hardware engineering across active radio product lines: requirements definition, architecture, integration, and verification
Maintain and enforce system-level specifications, ensuring fidelity from requirements intake through product qualification
Drive resolution of cross-subsystem technical issues and represent systems integrity in design reviews and milestone gate decisions
Establish systems engineering processes and documentation standards appropriate for a scaling hardware startup
Oversee board-level integration and PCB development, ensuring robust RF/high-speed layout practices and design-for-manufacturability standards
Requirements Intake and Specification Ownership
Serve as the primary engineering interface for requirements arriving from Solutions Engineering and Deployments — translating operational needs into precise, actionable system specifications
Ensure that engineering priorities and trade-off decisions are grounded in validated requirements
Partner with the VP of Engineering as well as Product and Operations leadership to align specification work with program milestones and planning commitments
Team Building and Leadership
Manage and develop a team of hardware engineers aligned to active product lines
Structure the team for growth as additional product lines come online, in partnership with the VP of Engineering
Mentor developing engineers and help build the systems engineering discipline across the organization
Cross-Functional Execution
Work closely with hardware, software, and test engineering teams to align integration milestones and system-level validation plans
Coordinate with Test and Operations on qualification activities and readiness criteria
Contribute to engineering program planning and resource discussions with cross-functional leadership
Qualities of a Successful Candidate
8+ years of experience in RF hardware systems engineering or a closely related technical discipline, with at least 3 years in a people management role
B.S. or M.S. in Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related technical field
Deep expertise in RF, wireless, or telecommunications hardware systems — experience at the radio unit, subsystem, or component level in any generation (4G, 5G, satellite, defense RF, or similar)
Demonstrated ability to own system-level specifications and drive integration in complex hardware/software co-development environments
Proven track record of translating operational or customer requirements into rigorous engineering deliverables
Strong communication and influencing skills across technical and cross-functional audiences
Experience transitioning technology from R&D to high volume production
Nice to Have
Experience with 5G radio hardware (O-RAN, small cell, macro radio)
Familiarity with all levels of radio unit design, including power distribution, digital motherboards, RF circuitry, mechanical design, and manufacturing considerations
Experience scaling a systems engineering function at a startup or growth-stage hardware company
Perks of working at Eridan
Work on new technology that will make a significant impact on global infrastructure
Ability to learn, develop, and advance within a flexible environment
Collaborate with smart, passionate, and helpful co-workers
Celebrate progress company-wide
Pre-IPO equity
401K with automatic match
Health, Vision and Dental insurance
Salary Range
Given our anticipated growth, we are open to hiring individuals with varying levels of experience to fill this role. Salary will be commensurate with job-related skills, experience and other relevant factors. The base salary range for the primary location of this role is between $180,000 and $210,000 plus stock options and benefits.
Eridan is an equal opportunity employer. We value and celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status.

jobs.title: Senior Director of Machine Learning Engineering
jobs.text:
The CVO Tribe
CVO owns two of HelloFresh's largest economic levers: benefit optimization and pricing. The tribe uses machine learning, personalization, and lifetime-value prediction to replace manual, rules-based decisioning with data-driven systems.
The engineering org is globally distributed across Berlin, Warsaw, NYC, Boulder, and Toronto, and includes Frontend, Backend, Data, and ML Engineering, working closely with embedded Data Scientists. The work spans a genuinely mixed engineering profile: ML-heavy systems for benefit recommendation, personalization, and customer lifetime-value forecasting, alongside backend and distributed-systems work powering pricing infrastructure and subscription products at scale.
As Senior Director, based in Berlin, you'll lead this full spectrum, setting technical strategy across ML, backend, and data disciplines and across time zones, without relying on daily co-location.
What you'll do
Lead an organization of 25-30 engineers, data scientists, and ML practitioners across Berlin, Warsaw, NYC, Boulder, and Toronto, through a layer of Engineering Managers and Staff Engineers reporting into you.
Own ML strategy for benefit recommendation, personalization, and customer lifetime-value forecasting, as well as backend and distributed-systems strategy for pricing and subscription infrastructure.
Drive the transformation of ways of working toward fully GenAI-native, cross-functional product teams, building on teams that already ship the majority of their code with AI assistance.
Own reliability and operational excellence across both ML and backend systems: observability from model output through to customer-facing delivery, SLOs/SLIs, incident management, and MLOps practices such as retraining, rollback, and experiment tracking.
Partner with Product, Data Science, Marketing, Finance, and adjacent engineering teams to align engineering priorities with business outcomes.
Manage and develop Engineering Managers and Data Science Leads across disciplines and geographies, holding them accountable for team health, delivery, and engineering standards.
What you'll bring
Range across ML and backend engineering. You don't need to be hands-on expert in both, but you need credibility in each: enough ML depth to set direction on production ML systems and partner effectively with Data Science, enough distributed-systems depth to be a trusted partner on pricing infrastructure and subscription products.
Proven leadership of globally distributed teams across multiple countries and time zones, without daily co-location. Comfortable with regular travel and bridging US and European hours.
Deep ML engineering expertise, including feature engineering, training/serving infrastructure, experimentation, and MLOps. Causal inference or uplift modeling experience is a plus.
Distributed systems and backend depth, including scaling backend services and data pipelines in revenue-sensitive, high-throughput environments. Subscription or billing experience is a plus.
AI-native leadership, with a track record of building or scaling AI-native engineering practices, not just adopting AI tools.
Commercial and pricing domain fluency, or strong aptitude to build it quickly, including benefit optimization, lifetime-value forecasting, and pricing elasticity.
Proven leadership at scale: 12+ years in software/ML engineering, with 5+ years managing Engineering Managers across more than one technical discipline and geography.
Operational excellence mindset, with strong grounding in SRE and MLOps practices for systems with direct financial impact.
Strong cross-functional communication, translating ML, data, and backend concepts into business terms and vice versa.
Low ego, high ownership, and a bias toward clarity over complexity.
What we offer
Global collaboration across HelloTech's hubs in Berlin, Warsaw, NYC, Boulder, and Toronto.
High-leverage, technically diverse work spanning ML, backend, data, and product engineering, with a direct line to business outcomes.
A genuinely AI-native environment with a mandate to scale that approach further.
Technical and engineering leadership in an autonomous, product-led setup, with end-to-end ownership from problem definition to production.
Enjoy a discount on HelloFresh meal kits, delivered straight to your door.
Build for the long-term with our company pension scheme (not available for interns/working students).
Benefit from discounted memberships with Urban Sports Club and John Reed, yoga classes, and access to Headspace and Spill.
Balance your work and life with flexible hours, Work From Home/Abroad options, and a home office setup budget.
Receive childcare support (not available for interns/working students).
Get a monthly allowance for the Deutschlandticket to support sustainable commuting.
Embrace "Learning Never Stops" with access to internal trainings and a central L&D budget (remove for interns).
Work from a modern, comfortable office in Berlin-Kreuzberg and enjoy social events like team outings, Friday beers, and company runs.
Above all, we are looking for individuals who will make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences, so even if you don't tick every box but think you'd thrive in this role, we'd really like to hear from you.

jobs.title: Director, Field Engineering (CPG & Retail)
jobs.text:
REQ ID: FEQ427R375
Mission:
As the Director of Field Engineering, you will be responsible for partnering with our enterprise Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) and Retail customers to democratize Data and AI within their organizations, leveraging Databricks solutions and expertise to address their most critical business challenges.
Reporting to the Tech GM of Field Engineering for Retail & Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG), the Director, Field Engineering will lead a team of pre-sales Managers and Solutions Architects focused on acquiring new customers and expanding strategic relationships across the Retail and CPG industry. You will work closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and executive stakeholders to drive strategy and execution against our ambitious growth goals.
You will foster a culture of psychological safety while developing and scaling a high-performing team with expertise in enterprise software, data engineering, analytics, AI/ML, and cloud technologies. Your experience partnering with Sales will help drive complex enterprise opportunities while coaching managers and field engineering teams to deliver exceptional customer outcomes. You will guide your team through strategic engagements, communicate complex technical solutions in terms of business value, support enterprise sales cycles, and build trusted relationships with senior business and technology leaders across the Retail and CPG industry.
The impact you will have:
Hire and manage first-line Managers and a growing team of technical pre-sales
Solutions Architects.
Build a collaborative culture within a rapid-growth team. Embody and promote
Databricks' customer-obsessed, truth-seeking, diverse culture, and first principles
mindset.
Develop trusted, long-term executive relationships with customers while maintaining a
deep understanding of the Retail and CPG industry, including key business trends,
competitive dynamics, and digital transformation priorities.
Help customers accelerate their Data and AI strategies across areas such as customer
experience, merchandising, supply chain, demand forecasting, marketing, and
operations.
Promote a solution- and value-based Field Engineering organization.
Display an understanding of customer business priorities and revenue opportunities
across the assigned region and industry.
Serve as a thought leader for Databricks and within the Retail, CPG, Data, and AI
ecosystem.
What we look for:
At least 3 years of second-line leadership experience managing teams of 30+
individuals, with 10+ years of overall leadership experience.
Proven success leading high-growth enterprise software pre-sales organizations
within Retail, CPG, cloud, data, analytics, or AI.
Experience partnering with Retail and/or CPG customers on large-scale data,
analytics, AI, or digital transformation initiatives.
Ability to elevate executive engagement, with a track record of driving large strategic
transactions and expanding high-growth enterprise accounts.
Proven leadership ability to influence, develop, and empower teams to achieve
ambitious business objectives through collaboration.
Drive operational rigor to manage a high-growth business, establishing the right
operating cadence while ensuring visibility into customer priorities, escalations, and
product feedback.
Proven track record of delivering transformational customer outcomes and
measurable business value.
Track record of building strong customer relationships and cross-functional
partnerships across Sales, Engineering, Product, Marketing, and Customer Success.
Experience positioning technical solutions within complex enterprise environments
and helping customers realize long-term value and platform adoption with Databricks.
Strong operational leadership with experience implementing scalable processes that
improve the effectiveness and productivity of technical field organizations.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or
equivalent practical experience.

Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.

We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.
