jobs.title: Director, Engineering - Okta Integration Network
jobs.text:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human
Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.
This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.
The Director, Engineering Opportunity
You will lead the engineering charter for the Okta Integration Network, driving the evolution of a platform that powers 8,000+ integrations across the Okta ecosystem. This role oversees distributed teams in the US and India and is accountable for delivering secure, scalable, standards‑based integration capabilities.
You will shape the roadmap for cross‑app identity security, expand the OIN catalog and strengthen enterprise‑grade extensibility. The role expects acquaintance in IAM standards like OAuth, OIDC, SAML, SCIM, and governance workflows, along with strong architectural judgment in building distributed systems, APIs, SDKs, and developer‑focused integration frameworks.
You will partner closely with product, security, and AI teams to secure emerging agent‑driven interactions and deliver high‑reliability services with strong operational rigor. Success requires exceptional cross‑geo leadership, the ability to drive multi‑quarter programs, influence standards, and cultivate a high‑performance engineering culture while ensuring the OIN remains the industry’s most trusted and comprehensive identity integration network.
What you’ll be doing
Lead, recruit, and mentor multiple teams of engineers, architects and engineering managers, fostering a culture of innovation, accountability, and psychological safety.
Partner closely with senior leaders in Product Management and Design to define a compelling product vision and execute a multi-year roadmap.
Own and manage the operational rhythm of your organization, establishing metrics and processes to ensure engineering excellence and predictable delivery.
Represent your teams and strategy in senior leadership forums and company-wide reviews, translating technical progress into data-driven narratives.
Partner with finance teams to manage budget cycles and control costs for your groups.
Build strong relationships with other engineering leaders and stakeholders across the organization to ensure alignment and drive complex, cross-functional projects to completion.
Driving strategic adoption of AI tooling and automation within engineering processes to unlock velocity improvements
What you’ll bring to the role
12+ years of experience in software development, with a proven track record of leading high-performing engineering organizations, including experience managing other managers.
Experience with public cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP) and container orchestration technologies like Kubernetes is highly desirable.
Demonstrated success in collaborating with product and design counterparts to build and execute a long-term, customer-focused roadmap.
Exceptional coaching and mentoring skills, with a passion for developing engineering talent at all levels.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to operate effectively in a large, globally distributed organization
Additional requirements:
U.S. Citizen as defined in 42 U.S. Code § 9102; a natural person who is a lawful permanent resident as defined in 8 U.S.C. 1101(a)(20) or who is a protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3). U.S. nationals (i.e. includes citizens and non-citizens born in outlying possessions such as American Samoa and Swains Island), green card holders, refugees, and asylees. Working on a U.S. visa does NOT qualify as a U.S. person.
Okta is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
Okta is rethinking the traditional work environment, providing our employees with the flexibility to be their most creative and successful versions of themselves, no matter where they are located. The Director, Engineering Opportunity

You will lead the engineering charter for the Okta Integration Network, driving the evolution of a platform that powers 8,000+ integrations across the Okta ecosystem. This role oversees distributed teams in the US and India and is accountable for delivering secure, scalable, standards‑based integration capabilities.

You will shape the roadmap for cross‑app identity security, expand the OIN catalog and strengthen enterprise‑grade extensibility. The role expects acquaintance in IAM standards like OAuth, OIDC, SAML, SCIM, and governance workflows, along with strong architectural judgment in building distributed systems, APIs, SDKs, and developer‑focused integration frameworks.

You will partner closely with product, security, and AI teams to secure emerging agent‑driven interactions and deliver high‑reliability services with strong operational rigor. Success requires exceptional cross‑geo leadership, the ability to drive multi‑quarter programs, influence standards, and cultivate a high‑performance engineering culture while ensuring the OIN remains the industry’s most trusted and comprehensive identity integration network.

items: Lead, recruit, and mentor multiple teams of engineers, architects and engineering managers, fostering a culture of innovation, accountability, and psychological safety.

Driving strategic adoption of AI tooling and automation within engineering processes to unlock velocity improvements

jobs.title: Associate Director, Maintenance and Reliability Engineering
jobs.text:
Associate Director, Reliability (MRE)
As the Associate Director, Reliability (MRE), you will oversee the team of reliability engineers, the reliability planner/scheduler, CMMS systems, Quality Engineering, and industrial SMEs in refrigeration, kitchen equipment, and other critical utilities. You'll also take direct ownership of all life-cycle maintenance projects across US sites — including utility expansion/modification, new equipment installation (in coordination with engineering), and refrigeration system projects. You'll lead hands-on, engaging, motivating, and coaching your team members directly. Partnering with M&RE senior leadership, you'll define, develop, and deliver the facilities maintenance roadmap and set the standard for operational efficiency at your fulfillment center.
You will…
• Oversee MRE-related projects, including facilities maintenance across electrical, refrigeration, building, and grounds
• Asset Performance: Implement Reliability-Centered Maintenance (RCM), root cause analysis (RCA), and failure mode and effects analysis (FMEA) to reduce downtime.
• Motivate, engage, coach, and inspire a team of specialists — building a positive team dynamic that encourages feedback and drives change from within
• Manage outside vendors and facilitate planned and unplanned Life cycle repairs/replacements
• Ensure maintenance regulations are followed
• Maintain a current list of contractors to ensure emergency repairs are handled promptly
• Identify problems and brainstorm improvement ideas for the fulfillment center/s
You are…
• Customer Centric: You're passionate about delivering on commitments to your customers
• Bold: You have passion and grit; you're not afraid to give feedback to your team and your manager
• Agile: You roll with the punches, adapt quickly to change, and deliver results in a fast-paced, autonomous environment
• Decisive: You know when making a decision is as important as the time it takes to make it
• Problem-solver: You know there's no one-size-fits-all approach; you think outside the box and enjoy deep-diving issues to find solutions
You have…
• 10+ years' experience managing facilities maintenance/operations and reliability within the Food/Beverage/Perishables/Distribution industry
• Bachelor's degree is preferred, in Mechanical, Electrical, or another related engineering field
• Interested in spending most of your time on the shop floor, working directly with all levels of staff
• High level of integrity and ethics with excellent follow-through
• Excitement for working in a start-up environment with high ambiguity and change
• Effective communication skills across employees, direct reports, cross-functional teams, and senior leadership
• Well-versed in OSHA regulations and compliance; OSHA certification a plus
• Exposure to mechanical, electrical, automation, and refrigeration systems
• Ability to read and interpret blueprints, manuals, and schematics
• Comfortable working in cold environments (some areas as low as 0°F)
• Flexibility to work weekends, holidays, and/or nights
You’ll get…
Competitive hourly rate, 401K company match that vests immediately upon participation, & team bonus opportunities
Generous PTO and flexible attendance policy
Comprehensive health and wellness benefits with options at $0 monthly, effective first day of employment
Up to 85% discount on subscriptions to HelloFresh meal plans (HelloFresh, Green Chef, Everyplate, and Factor_)
Access to Employee Resource Groups that are open to all employees, including those pertaining to BIPOC, women, veterans, parents, and LGBTQ+
Inclusive, collaborative, and dynamic work environment within a fast-paced, mission-driven company that is disrupting the traditional food supply chain
This job description is intended to provide a general overview of the responsibilities. However, the Company reserves the right to adjust, modify, or reassign work tasks and responsibilities as needed to meet changing business needs, operational requirements, or other factors.

jobs.title: Head of Data(Data Engineering + Machine Learning)
jobs.text:
About Easyship:
Easyship is a leading global shipping software and API platform trusted by 100,000+ eCommerce merchants to compare couriers, automate fulfilment, and simplify cross-border shipping, taxes and duties. A top-rated Shopify Certified Technology Provider, eBay preferred fulfilment partner, and Amazon preferred multi-channel integrator, Easyship is the G2 category leader (April 2026), offering 550+ courier services worldwide. We believe in accelerating borderless commerce through innovative solutions, and we're proud that brands of all sizes from small business to enterprise trust Easyship for all their shipping needs.
Who We’re Looking For:
We are looking for a Head of Data to join our leadership team and define the future of data at Easyship, from strategy and infrastructure to AI innovation and business enablement. This role is pivotal in transforming how we use data to make decisions, innovate, and scale. You'll lead the charge in unlocking the value of data across the business, driving operational efficiency, product intelligence, and long-term strategic advantage.
What you additionally need to know:
This is a full-time, onsite role based in our Bengaluru (MG Road) office. The role follows UK collaboration hours (11:00AM–8:00PM IST) to support seamless cross-regional execution.
What would be you be responsible for:
Owning and defining our company-wide Data & AI strategy, ensuring it's tightly aligned with Easyship’s business goals.
Leading and scaling a high-performing data team across analytics, data engineering, and (eventually) data science.
Championing AI and machine learning initiatives, supporting the company’s evolution toward a smarter, more automated product.
Collaborating with leaders across Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Operations to ensure data is accessible, actionable, and impactful.
Guiding architectural decisions, including analytics platforms, infrastructure, and tooling — even if not hands-on day-to-day.
Ensuring data quality, governance, and compliance, fostering trust in the data we use to make critical decisions.
Prioritising based on ROI, helping the company focus on initiatives that move the needle.
Enabling self-serve analytics, giving stakeholders the tools and knowledge to answer their own questions.
Driving a culture of experimentation, insight, and continuous improvement.
You Might Be a Good Fit If…
You have 7+ years of experience as a Head of Data or senior data leadership role.
You are a strategic thinker who understands how data drives business growth and operational excellence.
You have excellent organizational, verbal, and written communication skills, capable of aligning leadership and technical teams around a shared vision.
You have a deep understanding of AI/ML concepts and application, with a proven ability to deliver PoCs and pilots.
You have experience scaling and managing data teams, including hiring, mentorship, and team development.
You are familiar with modern data architecture and pipelines; bonus points if you've worked with GCP and tools like BigQuery, Looker, or DBT.
You possess resourcefulness, resilience, self-motivation, and the ability to thrive in an entrepreneurial, team-based environment, balancing long-term vision with short-term delivery needs.
You have a "Data-First" approach and strong analytical skills, using ROI assessment methodologies to prioritize initiatives.
You are skilled in influencing and collaborating with distributed global teams, willing to roll up your sleeves when needed and unblock teams to move quickly.
If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we’d still love to hear from you.
What we bring to the table as an employer:
Generous remuneration and stock units
Comprehensive health coverage
We reimburse gym and wellness expenses so you can invest in your health
Zomato digital meal credits and pantry full of wholesome snacks to keep you fueled through the workday
The freedom to‘Work from Anywhere’ for 4 weeks in a year
Generous vacation policy, plus duvet days and mental health days to truly recharge
How we value inclusion in our recruitment practices:
Easyship is an equal opportunity employer. We make all employment decisions—recruiting, hiring, pay, benefits, training, promotion, leave, and separation—based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, age, disability, national or ethnic origin, veteran or military status, citizenship, or any other characteristic protected by law.
How did the story of Easyship start? Find out below.

jobs.text:
At AlixPartners, we solve the most complex and critical challenges by moving quickly from analysis to action when it really matters; creating value that has a lasting impact on companies, their people, and the communities they serve. By understanding, respecting, and honouring the needs of our employees, clients, and communities, AlixPartners actively promotes an inclusive environment. We strongly believe in the value that diversity brings to our experiences and are committed to the perpetual enhancements of initiatives, policies, and practices. We hold ourselves accountable by providing the space for authenticity, growth, and equity for everyone.
AlixPartners has embraced a hybrid work model to provide flexibility and support our employees’ work-life integration. Our hybrid model combines a mix of in-person (at client site or AlixPartners office) and remote working. Travel is part of this position, but the frequency may vary based on client, team, and individual circumstances.
What you’ll do
Our Technology Advisory team provides independent, senior-level expertise that enables executives to drive value from Technology and enhancing business performance. We leverage extensive expertise to deliver rapid and sustainable impact across:
Digital and Technology strategy development, operating model, capability and governance design.
Technology and Product strategy and innovation, assisting our clients with the strategy and execution.
Defining and planning target architectures and roadmaps aligned to business objectives and plans including Data, Application/Integration and Technical/ Infrastructure architecture
Technology cost reduction, outsourcing and end to end Transformation.
Platform/systems/infrastructure assessments, re-platforming, rationalization and consolidation activities.
Technology due diligence, carve-out, and merger integration planning and execution.
IT crisis management, interim leadership roles, and project turnaround.
Central to our expertise is the technology strategy, organisation, applications and infrastructure which underpins any successful end-to-end transformation. We are looking for someone who has experience in Enterprise Architecture and how to define and design target state solutions, transition strategies and roadmaps, capability needs and the associated risks. This should ideally be coupled with prior consulting experience.
At AlixPartners, you will work closely with our clients to address strategic, operational, and technological challenges. Your skill in bridging the gap between technology and business will be crucial for delivering measurable results and driving business value.

Preferably you will have a mix of consulting and industry experience, with an ability to deliver small projects and/or working across multiple workstreams of larger projects.
Previous practical experience as an Enterprise Architect, with proven experience in designing enterprise-wide technology solutions working with business and technology teams
A good understanding of software delivery, infrastructure, operations and governance.
Experience conducting rapid digital diagnostics and maturity assessments to assess technological capabilities and identifying maturity gaps.
Ability to define pragmatic steps and roadmaps to drive business value.
Experience of architecting target states and complex solutions in a variety of environments, using different methodologies, frameworks, tools and software
You demonstrate a keen personal interest in Technology and remain up to date in the latest trends, tools and impacts of Technology on industry.
You are passionate about driving IT effectiveness and enabling clients to achieve their business objectives.
Excellent communication and presentation capabilities, comfortable speaking to senior non-technical clients.
Outstanding analytical and critical thinking skills along with strong financial literacy.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
Willingness to work outside of normal business hours, and in particular as unique projects/needs arise.
Ability to work full time in an office and remote environment; physically able to sit/stand at a computer and work in front of a computer screen for significant portions of the workday
Must become familiar with, and promote and abide by, our Core Values as defined by the AlixPartners’ Code of Conduct and foster an inclusive environment with people at all levels of an organisation.

The benefit type and level differ per location.

About V2
V2 is an AI-native consultancy of 100+ people helping enterprises move from AI ambition to production. We hold Anthropic Select partner status alongside AWS and Databricks partnerships, and we build with Claude at the core of everything we deliver: agentic AI, Claude Code, AI-native software delivery (AI-DLC) and enterprise platform modernisation. We are scaling across ANZ and APJ, with Singapore as the beachhead for regional expansion.
About the Role
We are looking for a Director, who is deeply technical with strong lived experience across software engineering, cloud-native architecture, AI systems, and AWS ecosystems. You are also very comfortable in pre-sales and have a deep understanding of professional services.
This is a leadership role responsible for helping customers modernise platforms, accelerate software delivery, and operationalise AI at enterprise scale.
You will lead technical strategy sessions, shape complex solution architectures, and oversee the successful delivery of customer engagements. You are equally comfortable discussing software engineering patterns, cloud architecture, platform modernisation, GenAI applications, and enterprise delivery models with technical teams and C-level stakeholders.
As a Director, you are both a technical and people leader, with credibility across the engineering community, customer executive stakeholders, and the AWS partner ecosystem. You bring a strong balance of pre-sales, delivery leadership, commercial acumen, and thought leadership, helping customers move from strategy to production outcomes.
You will have broad expertise across:
Software Engineering, AI & GenAI, Cloud-Native Architecture, AWS, Platform Engineering, DevOps, Modern Application Development, AI Engineering, Security, and Enterprise Transformation.
What You'll Own
Advising customers on software, platform, cloud, and AI strategy
Leading solution architecture and technical design workshops
Designing and overseeing delivery of enterprise-scale software and AI solutions
Acting as a trusted technical advisor across AWS, software engineering, and AI transformation
Leading the successful delivery of engagements and mentoring teams on those engagements
Driving technical pre-sales, solution shaping, and opportunity qualification
Scoping complex programs of work and providing realistic estimations, delivery models, and commercial guidance
Building strong relationships across the AWS partner ecosystem and customer stakeholders
Collaborating with marketing and practice leads to produce external-facing thought leadership, accelerators, blogs, demos, and technical collateral
Acting as a public-facing technology leader, speaking at conferences, meetups, podcasts, and customer events
Helping attract, interview, and mentor future technical talent into the business
Contributing to the development of internal engineering standards, reusable accelerators, AI capabilities, and delivery IP
Requirements
Leadership & Commercial
Proven experience leading large-scale enterprise software, cloud, and AI transformation programs
Strong leadership & mentorship capability with experience guiding high-performing technical teams
Demonstrated success in technical pre-sales, solution shaping, and enterprise customer engagement
Experience scoping, estimating, and structuring complex Statements of Work (SOWs) and delivery programs
Strong executive communication skills with the ability to influence stakeholders from engineering teams through to C-level executives
Technical Expertise
Demonstrable expertise designing and implementing modern software engineering and cloud-native architectures
Deep hands-on experience across AWS services and ecosystem, including modern application architecture and cloud platform design
Strong understanding of AI engineering and Generative AI, including enterprise adoption patterns, LLM-based systems, agentic workflows, APIs, RAG, MCP, orchestration, and production AI considerations
Proven ability to architect and implement scalable, secure, enterprise-grade solutions
Strong background in software engineering practices, including CI/CD, DevOps, testing strategies, platform engineering, observability, and secure-by-design approaches
Experience modernising enterprise platforms and legacy systems through cloud migration and software transformation
Understanding of security, governance, compliance, and operational excellence in enterprise environments
Growth & Industry Presence
Strong professional network across the software, AI, and AWS ecosystem
A track record of contributing to thought leadership, customer engagement, blogs, presentations, conferences, or community events
Continuous learner mindset with a commitment to certifications, emerging technologies, and industry trends
Apply Now:
If you’re passionate about leading AI-powered full stack projects, building scalable applications, and shaping the future of AI consulting, APPLY NOW and join V2 AI!

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer
jobs.text:
Job Purpose
Building world-class products like Cardano, Midnight and RealFi requires not just brilliant engineers, but a living ecosystem where standards, habits and ways of working compound over time. The CTO is the person who builds that ecosystem.
Working at the intersection of strategy and code, the CTO partners with the CEO to define the engineering direction, align the CPO and COO to keep the roadmap sound and moving at pace, and work with IO Labs to bring the most promising ideas from research into reality. They shape how IOG builds in an AI-first world, embedding an agentic programming philosophy that makes AI a genuine force multiplier across every team. And they grow the people who make all of this possible, through a Centre of Excellence that sets the technical standard for every product and venture IOG builds next.
CTO Accountabilities
Work with the CEO to define the future engineering strategy for IOG.
Own enterprise technology and architectural direction.
Shape the developer ecosystem: the standards, culture, tooling, and working practices that determine how IOG builds software.
AI-first engineering: developing and embedding an agentic programming philosophy across IOG - establishing how engineers and AI agents work together to build and ship at pace in an agent-driven world.
Working closely with the COO and CPO to ensure the roadmap is technically sound, resourced appropriately, and delivered at velocity.
Venture viability: partnering with IO Labs and ventures to assess whether new ideas are technically feasible, advising on build approach, and ensuring promising concepts can move quickly from research to reality.
Respect the autonomy of advanced ventures, while ensuring they remain aligned with the wider ecosystem.
Technical direction and architecture: the technology thesis, the standards all teams follow, and the decisions that keep IOG’s platforms coherent, scalable, and secure.
The engineering bench: attracting and developing world-class engineers through a Centre of Excellence model - setting the technical standard and ensuring it propagates across product and venture teams.
Holds enterprise-level budget responsibility within the technology function, including infrastructure, tooling, AI compute, and strategic technology investments.
Collaborates with the CEO and COO on cross-functional and enterprise-wide financial decisions where technology investment intersects with broader business priorities.
Operates with executive-level autonomy to set policies, allocate technical resources, and shape strategic initiatives within the technology domain.
Internal Partnerships, working with
The CEO: a thought partner in shaping company-wide technology strategy and representing engineering at the highest level.
The Engineers: personally recruiting, mentoring, and serving as the technical authority the team trusts and aspires to.
The CPO: aligning roadmap ambition with engineering capability, assessing the technical feasibility of product requirements, and providing realistic delivery timelines. The CPO owns what is built; the CTO owns how it is built.
The COO: defining the boundary between technical standards and operational delivery. The CTO retains the engineering hiring bar and provides regular technical health metrics including technical debt levels, architectural risks, and engineering velocity blockers; the COO owns execution at scale.
IO Labs: translating research and strategic bets into working prototypes and products, providing an honest technical view on what is viable and how quickly IOG can move.
The CTO participates in Investment Committee, Venture Acceleration Boards, and acquisition discussions as the most senior technical voice, and provides venture-ready technical foundations to new ideas and proto-ideas.
External Partners
Serve as the primary external technical voice for IOG, including conferences, panels, investor forums, and key partnerships.
Maintain strong relationships with leading researchers, founders, and technical talent across the Web3 and wider technology ecosystem.
Translate IOG’s technical strategy into language that boards, investors, and non-technical executives can engage with.
Executive Leadership
Leads the technology function at enterprise level.
Owns the leadership bench for the technology domain, ensuring structure, capability, and succession.
Collaborates with C-suite peers to align leadership expectations across the company.
Champions diversity, culture, and leadership excellence within the technology function.
Shapes policies and initiatives across the organization where technology intersects, driving a performance culture by modeling high standards and collaborating with C-suite peers to ensure consistent expectations at scale.

jobs.title: Director, Engineering — Engineering Acceleration
jobs.text:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.
At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.
A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.
The platforms in our Engineering Acceleration org dictate how thousands of Roblox engineers ship, and how every backend service gets built, deployed, and kept reliable at scale. They sit on the critical path for production reliability, developer velocity, and security posture. Reporting to Andrew Swerdlow, you will rethink the entire engineering toolchain from the ground up to be agentic-native, creating a world where AI agents are first-class participants in software development and humans set direction and supervise. This is a unique opportunity to define what modern engineering infrastructure looks like at one of the largest platforms in the world.
You will:
Reimagine the engineering toolchain as agentic-native, designing the platforms, guardrails, and feedback loops that let AI agents safely drive migrations, validation, and routine operational work.
Set a bold technical direction for AI-driven quality, including agent-generated tests, automated coverage of untested paths, intelligent verification, and continuous-deployment workflows.
Make software quality and SEV prevention a measurable property of the platform by investing in safe-change mechanisms, automated verification, progressive rollout, and fast, reliable rollback.
Drive down operational toil through automation, transforming manual, repeat work like patching and large-scale migrations into self-serve or agent-driven workflows.
Own and drive the roadmap, aligning cross-pod plans and execution against company goals for safe rollouts.
You have:
Experience leading and growing engineering teams (including managing managers and/or senior ICs), with a strong people-development track record.
Strong technical depth in backend/distributed systems and cloud infrastructure, enabling you to engage credibly on system design and technical decisions.
A track record delivering internal developer platforms, CI/CD, or deployment systems at scale for many internal customers and services.
A strong point of view on how AI/agentic tooling changes engineering workflows, coupled with hands-on familiarity with the modern AI engineering stack, AI coding tools, eval design, and open-weight models.
Demonstrated cross-organizational collaboration and excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate ambiguous, multi-system problems into concrete, executable plans.
(Preferred) Backend proficiency in C# and/or Go, and familiarity with Kubernetes/Nomad (Hashistack), Temporal, and AWS.
(Preferred) Hands-on experience applying AI/agents to engineering workflows, with a background in safe/staged rollouts (canary, feature flags) and incident prevention/automated verification.
For roles that are based at our headquarters in San Mateo, CA: The starting base pay for this position is as shown below. The actual base pay is dependent upon a variety of job-related factors such as professional background, training, work experience, location, business needs and market demand. Therefore, in some circumstances, the actual salary could fall outside of this expected range. This pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. All full-time employees are also eligible for equity compensation and for benefits as described on this page.
Annual Salary Range
$399,420—$457,970 USD
Roles that are based in an office are onsite Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday, with optional presence on Monday and Friday (unless otherwise noted).
Roblox provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. Roblox also provides reasonable accommodations to candidates with qualifying disabilities or religious beliefs during the recruiting process.
For US based roles only, please note the Company may not be able to employ candidates for this role who have United States work authorization related to certain U.S. visa categories, or support future H-1B sponsorship at this time.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering, Security Factory
jobs.text:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.
The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.
*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.
An overview of this role
As Director of Engineering, Security Factory, you will lead the engineering organization responsible for GitLab’s customer-facing security capabilities across our AI-powered DevSecOps platform. You’ll help shape how customers detect, prioritize, and remediate vulnerabilities across modern software workflows by guiding teams that build proprietary scanners, AI-driven detection engines, agentic remediation flows, and supporting security foundations. Reporting to the VP of Engineering, Sec section, you’ll set the engineering vision and roadmap for a distributed group of nine teams, including engineering managers, and create the conditions for strong delivery, sound technical direction, and healthy team growth.
Some examples of our projects:
Advanced proprietary scanners for Static Application Security Testing, Software Composition Analysis, Secret Detection, and related AI and machine learning detection engines
Agentic security flows for autofix and guided remediation, plus research that strengthens AI security, threat intelligence, vulnerability management, and security foundations
What you’ll do
Set the engineering vision and multi-quarter roadmap across teams working on proprietary scanners, AI-driven security workflows, research functions, vulnerability management, and security foundations.
Lead a distributed engineering organization of managers and individual contributors, with a focus on team performance, engagement, and career development.
Drive architectural decisions for AI and machine learning detection engines, agentic remediation flows, and scalable scanning infrastructure.
Partner with product management to define priorities, shape requirements, and deliver security capabilities for customers in regulated and security-conscious environments.
Own the engineering delivery of GitLab’s proprietary application security scanners, agentic remediation workflows, and AI Security Research efforts.
Represent the Security Factory stage in cross-functional planning, executive reviews, security disclosures, and customer conversations.
Establish engineering standards for delivery, observability, incident response, scanner quality, and code quality.
Contribute to GitLab’s transparent, async-first way of working through issues, merge requests, and the GitLab handbook.
What you’ll bring
Experience leading engineering organizations with multiple teams and managers in a distributed environment.
Strong understanding of application security fundamentals, including Static Application Security Testing, Software Composition Analysis, secret detection, vulnerability management workflows, and software supply chain security.
Experience building detection, analysis, or scanning systems in a software as a service or DevSecOps environment, including trade-offs across precision, recall, latency, and scale.
Direct experience shipping a customer-facing AI or machine learning product feature tied to detection or remediation quality outcomes.
Ability to partner closely with product management on roadmap planning, prioritization, and requirements in a product-led context.
Strong written communication skills and comfort leading through clear documentation in a remote, async-first organization.
Collaborative leadership style that supports teams, gives direct feedback, and aligns with GitLab’s values.
Familiarity with agentic AI systems, AI agent orchestration, threat intelligence research, or open source security tooling is useful, and we welcome candidates with adjacent or transferable experience.
About the team
The Security Factory group builds the customer-facing security capabilities of GitLab’s AI-powered DevSecOps platform. The organization includes nine teams working across proprietary scanners, AI-driven detection, agentic remediation, research, vulnerability management, and security foundations, and it collaborates asynchronously across regions with product management and other cross-functional partners. The team is focused on improving detection quality, scaling security workflows for enterprise use, and strengthening how GitLab helps customers secure the software supply chain. For more on how this team works, see the Sec Engineering Handbook page.
How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees
Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
Flexible Paid Time Off
Team Member Resource Groups
Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
Growth and Development Fund
Parental Leave
Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.
Country Hiring Guidelines: GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.
Privacy Policy: Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us.
GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also GitLab’s EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know during the recruiting process.

jobs.text:
OPSWAT, a global leader in IT, OT, and ICS critical infrastructure cybersecurity, delivers an end-to-end platform that gives public and private sector organizations and enterprises the critical advantage needed to protect their complex networks, secure their devices, and ensure compliance. Over the last 20 years our commitment to innovative technology has earned the trust of more than 1,700 organizations, governments, and institutions globally, solidifying our role in protecting the world’s critical infrastructure and securing our way of life.
Director of Engineering — MetaDefender Email Security
Reports to: VP, Products
Protecting the World’s Critical Infrastructure
OPSWAT, a global leader in IT, OT, and ICS critical infrastructure cybersecurity, delivers an end-to-end platform that gives public and private sector organizations and enterprises the critical advantage they need to protect their complex networks, secure their devices, and ensure compliance. Trusted by more than 1,700 organizations, governments, and institutions worldwide — including many of the world’s largest governments, utilities, financial institutions, and defense contractors — OPSWAT protects the systems that keep society running.
The Product: MetaDefender Email Security
MetaDefender Email Security is OPSWAT’s email threat prevention portfolio, trusted by governments and critical infrastructure operators to stop file-borne and email-borne threats before they reach the inbox. It comprises two complementary products designed for different environments and customer profiles — MetaDefender Email Gateway Security, deployed on-premises in front of existing mail servers, and MetaDefender Cloud Email Security, which augments Microsoft 365 — each embedding OPSWAT’s threat prevention technology, including Deep CDR, Metascan Multiscanning, Proactive DLP, and Predictive Alin AI, directly into the mail flow.
This role owns the engineering for the products across both deployment models — the on-premises gateway and the cloud-native Microsoft 365 service — each with its own security, assurance, and operational demands, and all built to scale.
About This Role
We are looking for a Director of Engineering who leads from the front. This is a hands-on, technically-centric leadership role — not a pure people-management position — with full accountability for the engineering of the MetaDefender Email Security: architecture, delivery, quality, and the teams that build it. You will lead engineering across multiple deployment form factors — from air-gapped high security environments to native-cloud deployments — operating with the rigor of a principal engineer and the clarity of an executive.
You are an AI-native engineering leader. You have personally orchestrated fleets of AI agents to architect, build, test, and ship production systems, and you have launched and released real products through a full AI-powered software development lifecycle (SDLC) — from specification and code generation to automated testing, review, and deployment. Product Management defines what to ship; you define how to build it. You own the end-to-end delivery of the roadmap Product Management sets, hold the delivery bar, and build a high-performance culture the rest of OPSWAT’s engineering portfolio will look to as a model for AI-native development. You report to the VP, Products and lead a distributed team across Romania and Hungary, while the role itself can be based anywhere — with a preference for the UK, USA, or near an OPSWAT-operated location.
What You Will Be Doing
Lead as an AI-first effort: make AI agents a first-class part of how the team works — orchestrating agents to create specs, generate code and tests, verify results, and run reviews — while ensuring humans own and validate every line that ships. Treat automation and intelligence as the default, not the exception.
Stay hands-on: remain directly in the codebase — setting architecture patterns, writing and reviewing critical code, prototyping, and unblocking hard technical problems. You lead by doing, not only by delegating.
Own end-to-end delivery of the roadmap: take full ownership of delivering the product roadmap set by Product Management — turning the “what to ship” into the “how to build,” and owning execution sequencing, technical risk, quality, security, and release across every deployment form factor.
Set technical direction (the “how”): drive the architecture and technology choices that underpin a product serving high-assurance environments at scale. Hold a strong engineering point of view and be willing to defend it.
Build and lead a high-performance team: recruit, develop, and retain top engineers and their leads across Romania and Hungary; create clear career paths and norms for code quality and review; and build a culture where strong engineers want to stay and grow.
Drive performance-based management: set clear, measurable expectations and run a rigorous, fair performance culture — recognizing and accelerating top performers, raising the bar continuously, and addressing underperformance decisively by coaching where there is a path and upgrading or exiting the role where there is not.
Hold a security-first quality bar: champion code review with a security lens for both human-written and AI-generated code, catching injection risks, insecure defaults, missing validation, and privilege-escalation vectors in file-handling and authentication paths before they ship.
Raise engineering velocity: continuously improve how the team works — CI/CD pipelines, AI-assisted development workflows, incident response, and operational maturity — so the team ships faster and more reliably over time.
Codify AI-native practices for the portfolio: establish the playbooks, AI context files, coding harnesses, test frameworks, and review norms developed on this product so other OPSWAT product teams can adopt them.
Partner cross-functionally: work shoulder-to-shoulder with the VP, Products, plus Product Management, Design, and security leaders — turning the product roadmap (the what) into engineering execution (the how), committing to scope and timelines, and pushing back clearly when trade-offs require it.
What We Need From You
Full agentic development experience (required): You have personally run a full agentic, AI-powered SDLC end-to-end — and have done so in B2B and high-security enterprise environments where compliance, data sensitivity, and assurance requirements are non-negotiable. You can show real work (PRs, commit history, shipped products, or a portfolio) where agentic workflows drove delivery — not slideware about AI.
A product launched via a full AI-powered SDLC: demonstrable experience taking a product from spec to release using an end-to-end AI-assisted lifecycle (spec generation, code/test generation, automated verification, AI-assisted review, and CI/CD), with you accountable for the outcome.
Proven engineering leadership: 8+ years of software engineering experience and 3+ years leading engineering teams (including managing managers/leads) through complex product delivery at scale. You can point to the decisions you made and why.
Performance-based leadership: a track record of building high-performing teams through rigorous, fair performance management — promoting excellence, making timely talent decisions, and reducing or replacing low performers when needed.
Deep technical excellence: strong, current software engineering fundamentals — solid command of design patterns, SOLID principles, and modern architecture. You can evaluate AI-assisted code with the same rigor as human-authored code. AI tools amplify strong fundamentals; they do not replace them.
Scalable systems experience: a proven history building scalable, distributed solutions — including relational/document databases, cloud-native services, and modern CI/CD systems.
Quality and test discipline: a high bar for tested, maintainable code; you use AI to accelerate test scaffolding, then validate that coverage is real and meaningful.
Distributed-team leadership: demonstrated ability to lead and align engineers across countries and time zones, building trust, clarity, and accountability in a remote/hybrid, multi-country setup.
Talent magnet and clear communicator: you identify strong engineers, make a compelling case for why they should join, and create an environment where they do their best work — and you communicate technical decisions to non-technical stakeholders without oversimplifying.
Security-conscious by default: operating in critical infrastructure markets means security is never an afterthought; you hold the team to a security-first bar on design, code review, and incident response.
It Would Be Nice If You Had
Domain familiarity: understanding of email as a communication channel and the underlying technology and protocols. Appreciation of the different deployment methods for email security and their characteristics.
Cloud services familiarity: experience of integrating products with M365 and/or Google Workspace and their associated API ecosystems
.NET / C# ecosystem: hands-on or managerial experience with .NET Core / C# — enough to evaluate architectural decisions, review PRs credibly, and hire well for the stack.
Cloud-native and containers: experience leading the design or operation of cloud-native SaaS platforms — Docker, Kubernetes, and AWS/Azure/GCP — including using AI agents to script infrastructure and deployment automation.
AI context-file authoring: experience writing AI context files (e.g., CLAUDE.md, .cursorrules, or equivalent) that encode architecture decisions and forbidden patterns for consistent, safe AI output across a team.
AI in CI/CD pipelines: familiarity running AI agents inside pipelines — auto-fixing lint, generating missing tests, or running safe migrations as pipeline steps — not as experiments, but as how the team actually works.
International team experience: a track record of building and maintaining engineering culture and delivery quality across multiple countries and time zones.
Async and high-throughput systems: experience validating concurrency and thread-safety in high-throughput services.
Why You’ll Love Working Here
Lead a product trusted by critical infrastructure customers across air-gapped, cross-domain, internet-connected, and native-cloud deployments — the architecture and culture decisions you make now will shape it for years.
Influence beyond this product: the AI-native patterns you establish will propagate across OPSWAT’s engineering portfolio.
Work from anywhere — a worldwide, remote-friendly role with a preference for the UK, USA, or a location near an OPSWAT-operated country.
Stable, growing international company with an exceptional customer base across 50+ countries.
A mandate to build AI-native engineering practices — and the latitude to do it your way.
Attractive compensation with regular performance assessments and flexibility for the right candidate.

blocks.text: OPSWAT, a global leader in IT, OT, and ICS critical infrastructure cybersecurity, delivers an end-to-end platform that gives public and private sector organizations and enterprises the critical advantage needed to protect their complex networks, secure their devices, and ensure compliance. Over the last 20 years our commitment to innovative technology has earned the trust of more than 1,700 organizations, governments, and institutions globally, solidifying our role in protecting the world’s critical infrastructure and securing our way of life.
Director of Engineering — Meta Defender Managed File Transfer
Reports to: VP, Products
Protecting the World’s Critical Infrastructure

OPSWAT, a global leader in IT, OT, and ICS critical infrastructure cybersecurity, delivers an end-to-end platform that gives public and private sector organizations and enterprises the critical advantage they need to protect their complex networks, secure their devices, and ensure compliance. Trusted by more than 1,700 organizations, governments, and institutions worldwide — including many of the world’s largest governments, utilities, financial institutions, and defense contractors — OPSWAT protects the systems that keep society running.
The Product: MetaDefender Managed File Transfer

MetaDefender Managed File Transfer is OPSWAT’s secure managed file transfer solution, trusted by governments and critical infrastructure operators to move sensitive files safely across enterprise networks and partner boundaries. It embeds OPSWAT’s threat prevention technology — multiscanning, Deep CDR, and DLP — directly into every file flow.

This role owns the engineering for the product across its full range of deployment form factors — air-gapped, cross-domain, internet-connected, and native-cloud environments — each with its own security, assurance, and operational demands, and all built to scale.
About This Role

We are looking for a Director of Engineering who leads from the front. This is a hands-on, technically-centric leadership role — not a pure people-management position — with full accountability for the engineering of MetaDefender Managed File Transfer: architecture, delivery, quality, and the teams that build it. You will lead engineering across multiple deployment form factors — from air-gapped and cross-domain environments to internet-connected and native-cloud deployments — operating with the rigor of a principal engineer and the clarity of an executive.

You are an AI-native engineering leader. You have personally orchestrated fleets of AI agents to architect, build, test, and ship production systems, and you have launched and released real products through a full AI-powered software development lifecycle (SDLC) — from specification and code generation to automated testing, review, and deployment. Product Management defines what to ship; you define how to build it. You own the end-to-end delivery of the roadmap Product Management sets, hold the delivery bar, and build a high-performance culture that the rest of OPSWAT’s engineering portfolio will look to as a model for AI-native development. You report to the VP, Products, and lead a distributed team across Romania, Vietnam, and Hungary, while the role itself can be based anywhere, with a preference for the UK, USA, or near an OPSWAT-operated location.
What You Will Be Doing

items: Lead as an AI-first effort: make AI agents a first-class part of how the team works — orchestrating agents to create specs, generate code and tests, verify results, and run reviews — while ensuring humans own and validate every line that ships. Treat automation and intelligence as the default, not the exception.

Stay hands-on: remain directly in the codebase — setting architecture patterns, writing and reviewing critical code, prototyping, and unblocking hard technical problems. You lead by doing, not only by delegating.

Own end-to-end delivery of the roadmap: take full ownership of delivering the product roadmap set by Product Management — turning the “what to ship” into the “how to build,” and owning execution sequencing, technical risk, quality, security, and release across every deployment form factor.

Set technical direction (the “how”): drive the architecture and technology choices that underpin a product serving high-assurance environments at scale. Hold a strong engineering point of view and be willing to defend it.

Build and lead a high-performance team: recruit, develop, and retain top engineers and their leads across Romania, Vietnam, and Hungary; create clear career paths and norms for code quality and review; and build a culture where strong engineers want to stay and grow.

Drive performance-based management: set clear, measurable expectations and run a rigorous, fair performance culture — recognizing and accelerating top performers, raising the bar continuously, and addressing underperformance decisively by coaching where there is a path and upgrading or exiting the role where there is not.

Hold a security-first quality bar: champion code review with a security lens for both human-written and AI-generated code, catching injection risks, insecure defaults, missing validation, and privilege-escalation vectors in file-handling and authentication paths before they ship.

Raise engineering velocity: continuously improve how the team works — CI/CD pipelines, AI-assisted development workflows, incident response, and operational maturity — so the team ships faster and more reliably over time.

Codify AI-native practices for the portfolio: establish the playbooks, AI context files, coding harnesses, test frameworks, and review norms developed on this product so other OPSWAT product teams can adopt them.

Partner cross-functionally: work shoulder-to-shoulder with the VP, Products, plus Product Management, Design, and security leaders — turning the product roadmap (the what) into engineering execution (the how), committing to scope and timelines, and pushing back clearly when trade-offs require it.

You can show real work (PRs, commit history, shipped products, or a portfolio) where agentic workflows drove delivery — not slideware about AI.

A product launched via a full AI-powered SDLC: demonstrable experience taking a product from spec to release using an end-to-end AI-assisted lifecycle (spec generation, code/test generation, automated verification, AI-assisted review, and CI/CD), with you accountable for the outcome.

jobs.title: Global Director, People Technology (all genders)
jobs.text:
About the role: What's in the Box
We are looking for an experienced Director, People Technology to lead HelloFresh's People Technology function globally. This role owns the strategy, operating model, and end-to-end delivery of our People technology landscape, with Workday as the core platform. Your scope spans functional development, integrations, programme delivery, and business-critical workforce technology including Time Tracking, Absence, and time clocking devices across our distribution centres.
This role carries a clear AI mandate: you will define how People Technology uses AI to improve productivity, service quality, and decision-making, while governing and deploying AI-enabled solutions for People function customers at scale. You will partner closely with People, Technology, and Operations leaders to translate business needs into an executable technology roadmap, balancing transformation, platform health, operational reliability, and user experience.
What you’ll do: The Recipe
Strategy and roadmap: Own the People Technology strategy, roadmap and operating model across Operations, Functional Development, Integrations and Programme Management, aligned to People, Technology and Operations priorities.
Platform performance: Ensure Workday and related platforms are stable, scalable and fit for purpose, including business-critical workforce processes such as Time Tracking, Absence and Time Clocking across distribution centres.
Operational technology delivery: Partner with Operations stakeholders to ensure workforce technology supports reliable execution in frontline and distribution-centre environments.
AI strategy and governance: Define and drive the People Technology AI strategy, establishing appropriate governance across risk, data protection, adoption and measurement, while partnering with People leaders to deliver responsible, scalable AI-enabled solutions.
Delivery prioritisation: Set priorities for major initiatives, balancing transformation ambition, operational risk and platform health, serving as the senior escalation point for complex delivery or system-risk issues.
Senior stakeholder partnership: Partner with Technology leadership on architecture, security and integrations; represent People Technology in senior leadership forums and cross-functional decision-making.
What you’ll bring: The Ingredients
People Technology leadership: Significant experience in People Technology, HR systems or enterprise SaaS leadership, with deep familiarity with Workday-centric landscapes across implementation, optimisation and operational support.
Multi-disciplinary team leadership: Proven experience leading teams across operations, delivery, integrations and specialist domains in global, complex organisations with senior cross-functional stakeholders.
Frontline environment experience: Experience supporting technology used in operational or distribution-centre environments where reliability and execution quality are critical.
AI and automation deployment: Practical experience identifying and deploying AI or automation opportunities in an enterprise function, including responsible adoption governance across risk, data, change management and measurable business value.
Strategic translation: Ability to convert People, Technology and Operations priorities into clear, executable plans, balancing transformation ambition with operational reliability.
Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. There are many different ways of developing skills, and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.
What we offer: The Toppings
Enjoy a discount on HelloFresh meal kits, delivered straight to your door.
Build for the long-term with our company pension scheme (not available for interns/working students).
Benefit from discounted memberships with Urban Sports Club and John Reed, yoga classes, and access to Headspace and Spill.
Balance your work and life with flexible hours, Work From Home/Abroad options, and a home office setup budget.
Receive childcare support (not available for interns/working students).
Get a monthly allowance for the Deutschlandticket to support sustainable commuting.
Embrace "Learning Never Stops" with access to internal trainings and a central L&D budget (remove for interns).
Work from a modern, comfortable office in Berlin-Kreuzberg and enjoy social events like team outings, Friday beers, and company runs.
Are you the missing ingredient? If this sounds like a tasty opportunity, we’d be excited to hear from you. We aim to review your profile and respond within 5 business days.

jobs.title: Engineering Director, Mobile Infrastructure
jobs.text:
OKX will be prioritising applicants who have a current right to work in Singapore, and do not require OKX's sponsorship of a visa.
Who We Are
At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.
OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.
Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.
OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.
About The Opportunity
We are looking for an experienced engineering leader to join our Mobile Infrastructure team and drive the technical foundation that powers OKX's app for millions of daily active users. In this role, you will lead and grow a team of mobile infrastructure engineers, set the technical direction for our platform layer, and work closely with product engineering teams to ensure the OKX app is fast, reliable, and built to scale.
This is not a feature delivery role. You will own the engineering systems, tooling, and frameworks that enable the broader mobile organisation to ship with speed and confidence. We are actively embedding AI into how our teams build and operate — and we're looking for a leader who embraces that shift and brings others along with them.
What You'll Be Doing
Lead, mentor, and develop a mobile infrastructure engineering team, driving ownership and accountability across platform milestones.
Set the technical direction for mobile infrastructure — including tooling, shared frameworks, performance systems, and developer experience toolchain.
Champion the adoption of AI tools and workflows across the team — from code generation and review to testing and incident analysis — to raise the quality and velocity of delivery.
Drive architecture decisions and engineering standards across the mobile platform, ensuring scalability, reliability, and maintainability at scale.
Partner with product engineering teams to deliver infrastructure solutions, unblock development, and raise the bar on engineering quality across the organisation.
Own performance engineering across the platform — memory, package size, startup time, and UI rendering — in production environments serving millions of users.
Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders including product, design, backend, and security teams to align on platform goals and execute effectively.
Serve as the go-to technical expert for complex infrastructure challenges, maintaining the robustness and scalability of the mobile platform.
What We Look For In You
8+ years of mobile engineering experience, with at least 3 years in a team lead or management role focused on infrastructure, platform, or architecture.
Proven ability to lead and grow engineering teams, with strong technical judgement and a high level of drive.
Deep expertise in iOS or Android development, with a strong understanding of the mobile platform layer — performance, toolchain, architecture, and developer experience.
Actively uses AI tools in your engineering workflow — you don't just know about them, you've integrated them into how you and your team work.
Strong communicator who can align cross-functional teams and work effectively across stakeholders at different levels.
Comfortable navigating ambiguity and making sound technical decisions in a fast-paced environment.
Nice to Haves
Hands-on experience leading a dedicated mobile architecture or infrastructure team with deep platform specialisation.
Track record of driving performance optimisation at scale — memory, package size, startup time, and rendering performance.
Experience shipping AI-powered features or integrating AI tooling into engineering workflows at team or org level.
Familiarity with cross-platform frameworks such as React Native or Flutter.
Experience in fintech, crypto, or other high-scale consumer app environments.
Perks & Benefits
Competitive total compensation package
L&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development
Various team building programs and company events
Wellness and meal allowances
Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
More that we love to tell you along the process!

jobs.title: Senior Director, Product & Technology Finance
jobs.text:
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com.
Reddit is seeking a solid, analytical, strategic, creative, knowledgeable, and visionary finance leader to join our Finance team as a Senior Director, Product and Technology Finance . In this role, you will provide strategic and value-added financial leadership in partnership with our Engineering organization. You will partner with the Engineering teams to drive alignment and resourcing planning decisions, helping to align the needs of the business to the financial plan for the company. This person will be a thought partner, owning and driving the agenda in their area of responsibility, by driving financially responsible opportunities, and improving accuracy of reporting/insights. Additionally, you will be involved in continuing to stand up a financial process for evaluating and tracking Global Technology decisions, including working cross-functionally with other organizations within Reddit to ensure decisions are well-thought through (tax, legal, accounting, audit, etc.).
If you are someone who is passionate about growing with a rising business, values efficiency and creative problem-solving using financial/quantitative metrics, and thrives in a fast-paced, open and fast-growing environment, then this is a great role for you!
Responsibilities
Develop and Build a Product Finance Function - Spearhead the development and evolution of the Product Finance function, establishing robust processes that align financial rigor with product velocity. This includes designing and implementing a strategic framework for evaluating investments with ambiguous or long-term returns, enabling leadership to make data-informed decisions even in the face of uncertainty.
Support Reddit’s Engineering Organization - Partner with Engineering leadership to provide financial modeling assistance for key business decisions including prioritizing resources and investments to get the best ROI. Develop understanding of Engineering related issues and priorities; reconcile those matters with long term forecasts.
Strong Thought Leadership - Bring insights from industry knowledge and your business acumen to show a capability of influencing business leadership to drive results. You will have a passion for improving existing processes and be able to work across teams to achieve results.
Deliver engineering P&Ls - Own financial forecasts, annual operating plan, budget tracking, and long range plan by partnering with various stakeholders. Establishing and communicating information about financial targets on a quarterly and annual basis; identifying and reporting risk and opportunity levels determined for the overall financial plan; providing actionable insights (e.g. productivity analysis, ROI, contractor spend optimization, capex management, etc).
Cloud Reporting - Work closely with our team to track and report our KPIs against our most strategic Cloud Hosting agreements. Continue to optimize costs by working with engineers to balance workloads across our dual cloud environment. Run strategic projects in partnership with program management and engineering leaders to drive efficiencies and accountability for promised returns.
Business Development and Corp Dev related to Tech and Product Initiatives - Partner closely with the business development and corporate development teams to drive growth initiatives, assess M&A and evaluate post deal results.
