jobs.title: Senior Director of Manufacturing Engineering
jobs.text:
Step into a career with ASM, where cutting edge technology meets collaborative culture. ​
For over 55 years ASM has been ahead of what’s next, at the forefront of innovation and what’s technologically possible. With more than 4,500 ASMers representing 70 nationalities, our people and our advanced semiconductor devices are playing a crucial role in trends such as 5G, cloud computing, AI, and autonomous driving. But we’re more than just a tech company. We value diversity, inclusion and sustainability as we strive to make a positive impact on the world. Our development programs help support your growth, shaping your future and pushing the boundaries of innovation to unleash potential.
We are the world’s leader in one of the fastest growing segments in the industry, Thermal Atomic Layer Deposition systems. We are also recognized as the technology leader in the fast growth Epitaxial Si deposition market and have far exceeded the growth of any of our competitors in this space.
In this role, you will lead ASM’s Asia Manufacturing Engineering team based in ASM’s state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities in Singapore and Korea, Dongtan. This team further structures the Bill of Materials for sourcing and purchasing, makes detailed assembly and test procedures and criteria, and ensures successful delivery to our customers, while helping to enable the high-volume manufacturing teams within ASM and into our contract manufacturing base transition products into high volumes with high quality standards.
Key Responsibilities:
Collaborate with the Business Units Design Engineering and Global NPI (New Product Introduction) Engineering teams to develop build and test procedures to ensure tool’s functionality standards are met.
Responsible for establishing priorities and plans to manage business unit-focused manufacturing engineering teams with the primary responsibility to Engineer Manufacturing Processes necessary to ensure Safe, Quality deliveries of systems, spares and retrofit kits in Singapore operations sites.
Establish engineering strategic project plans for and leads the implementation of key programs and activities in accordance with ASM Global Operations strategic goals.
Establish a change management process to roll out proposed changes in manufacturing.
Drive solutions to problems/ opportunities within the Internal Factory and at Contract Manufacturing Outsource Partners.
Responsible to identify, commit & implement process and system needed to achieve MFG safety improvements, quality improvements, labor hours reduction and cycle time reduction.
Responsible for the shipped quality of products through continuous improvement using Lean six sigma tools like PFMEA, DMAIC, DOE, SPC and data analytics.
Manage timely execution of Engineering Change Orders (ECO). Influence peer group to make the Engineering change beneficial for effective and productive outcome.
Manage tooling and test equipment requirements. Innovation and automation in implementing tooling and test equipment to manufacturing efficiency and customer quality
Lead the innovative process in implementing changes in the business process to deliver excellence and value-add from the Engineering team
Be the key driver for continuous improvement within the Internal Factory and at Contract Manufacturing Outsource Partners
Responsible for generating and maintaining employee development and training to build an effective and future ready team
Lead the NPI engineering team in providing technical support for new product builds in pilot sites or high-volume manufacturing sites.
Functional Knowledge:
A strong understanding of quality processes and best practices.
Experience with Team Center, SAP and/or major ERP/MRP systems and processes.
Demonstrated/ proven knowledge in creating and implementing manufacturing processes in a highly complex assembled systems business.
Experience in improving existing business processes for a smooth transition from New Product to High Volume Manufacturing at a very rapid pace.
Experience with Assembly and Test automation execution.
Experience in enabling internal manufacturing teams and contract manufacturers to ramp to high volumes.
Exceptional communication and relationship building skills.
Semiconductor industry experiences with deep knowledge of Equipment Manufacturing Engineering are a plus.
Minimum Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree/ Masters in relevant Engineering discipline.
Lean Six sigma green belt.
Effective management of a highly technical, global team.
Competency development within the team.
Strong communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively from the working level to the executive levels across many functions.
Proficiency in identifying project risks and influencing the direction of projects to mitigate those risks.
Preferred Qualifications
Lean Six sigma black belt/ master black belt.
Experience with manufacturing of high complexity Capital Equipment.
Vacuum system and high-power systems experience i.e. DC (controlling digital signals and modules), as well as 220vAC, and 480vAC (providing distribution to various functional blocks).
Experience with complex Bill of Materials (BOM) with high level modules highly preferred.
Experience with high level modules should reflect an understanding from a BOM perspective, of functional blocks such as Wafer processing chambers, factory interfaces, gas delivery solutions, power distribution and control units, vacuum systems, and software.
Experience with modular design of BOMs thereby enabling better control and management of the configuration and allowing global operations to better deploy manufacturing and supply chain strategies.
Solid knowledge of SAP S/4HANA Advanced Variant Configuration.
Experience engaging in early design stages to influence direction on DfX.
Apply today to be part of what’s next.
We make the tech that enables the chips in devices which improve lives around the world. We do this with an eye to the future, pushing the boundaries of what’s possible through cutting-edge innovation, and driving the next wave of technological breakthroughs that shape how we live, work, and connect.
To learn more about ASM, find us at asm.com and on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube.
ASM is an equal opportunity employer and considers qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, nationality, social or ethnic origin, sexual orientation, gender, gender identify or expression, marital status, pregnancy, political affiliation, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Director Technology - Data Platforms
jobs.text:
Director Technology - Data Platforms
London, UK
We are looking for a senior data leader to join Simple Machines in London as part of our Global Data Practice leadership team.
This is a strategic and hands-on leadership role focused on helping shape the future direction of our data platform capability across the UK and Europe. The individual will play a key role in defining our propositions, strengthening our technical capability, and helping clients modernise their data ecosystems for an AI-native future.
The role requires someone equally comfortable operating at executive, architectural, commercial, and delivery levels. We are looking for a leader who understands where enterprise data platforms are heading over the next five years, not where they were five years ago.
Key Responsibilities:
- Part of the Global Data Practice leadership team
- Helping define and evolve Simple Machines’ data platform propositions, technical direction, and strategic positioning
- Advising enterprise clients on modern data platform strategy, architecture, operating models, and AI readiness
- Supporting organisations as they evolve from traditional centralised data platforms toward AI-native, real-time, and data product-oriented operating models
- Working closely with Engagement Managers and senior leadership across major strategic initiatives
- Leading architecture and technical direction for complex enterprise data platform and transformation programs
- Acting as a senior technical counterpart across strategic client engagements and partner relationships
- Pre-sales, proposal development, technical solution shaping, and executive stakeholder engagement
- Building trusted relationships with strategic technology partners and staying current with emerging platform capabilities and market direction
- Supporting recruitment, mentoring, capability uplift, and practice development across the broader engineering organisation
- Leading major client initiatives across data engineering, platform modernisation, AI enablement, and operational data systems
- Contributing to thought leadership, market positioning, and growth initiatives across
the UK and Europe

the Head of engineering has both a strategic and a technical role inside the company. The strategic aspect includes setting goals for the team, hiring engineers, and prioritizing projects. Before they can get this position, the head of engineering should have extensive experience as an engineer, they should have managed complex tech projects and know how to build products and features from scratch.

jobs.title: Salesforce Field CTO
jobs.text:
About the Role
We're hiring a Field CTO to be the most trusted technical voice in our company, the leader our customers call when the stakes are highest and the executive our field rallies behind when complex deals demand vision. This role blends strategic technical leadership with hands-on customer impact, spanning the full lifecycle from first conversation through enterprise-wide adoption.
If you've ever wanted a mandate to shape how customers architect, govern, and scale on the Salesforce platform, while influencing product direction and elevating the technical bar across an entire go-to-market organization, this is that role.
What You'll Own
Serve as the senior-most technical authority in the field, partnering with CIOs, CTOs, VPs of Engineering, and Salesforce Centers of Excellence at Fortune 500 customers.
Shape and execute our technical field strategy across discovery, architecture, validation, and executive alignment.
Drive adoption and time-to-value across the customer lifecycle, ensuring every deployment translates into measurable business outcomes.
Lead executive business reviews, governance frameworks, and technical roadmap conversations that turn customers into long-term champions.
Influence renewal and expansion outcomes by identifying adoption gaps, removing friction, and architecting paths to enterprise-wide rollout.
Build repeatable technical playbooks for discovery, validation, enablement, and value realization.
Act as the loudest voice of the customer with Product and Engineering, translating field insight into roadmap influence.
Represent the company externally through keynotes, analyst briefings, Dreamforce sessions, executive roundtables, and thought leadership.
Mentor and elevate technical talent across the organization, raising the bar for craft, customer empathy, and commercial acumen.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Security Engineering
jobs.text:
At Ripple, we’re building a world where value moves like information does today. It’s big, it’s bold, and we’re already doing it. Through our crypto solutions for financial institutions, businesses, governments and developers, we are improving the global financial system and creating greater economic fairness and opportunity for more people, in more places around the world. And we get to do the best work of our career and grow our skills surrounded by colleagues who have our backs.
If you’re ready to see your impact and unlock incredible career growth opportunities, join us, and build real world value.
THE WORK:
As the Senior Director of Security Engineering, you will be responsible for building and leading a dedicated, humble, and paranoid team of Security Engineers to secure Ripple's products, infrastructure, and corporate IT systems. You will play a substantial role in defining the security strategy and encouraging a culture of security across the entire company. Your leadership will be crucial in protecting our business and our customers by embedding security into every layer of our technology stack.
This is a hands-on role and requires a deep understanding of technology. AI is fundamentally reshaping how we build software and how our tools and systems operate, and this role sits at the center of that challenge. You will ensure our use of AI tooling and agentic workflows is secure, controlled, and auditable.
WHAT YOU'LL DO:
Set the strategic vision and roadmap for the Security Engineering team, focusing on product security, infrastructure security, and IT security, with a particular focus on AI security, including agentic guardrails and AI-assisted development risk.
Serve as a security domain expert, providing guidance and communicating security risks and concepts to senior leadership, engineering teams, and other partners.
Define guardrails around AI agents and tools operating within Ripple's environment, including scope boundaries, blast radius limits, and rollback mechanisms.
Implement and enforce agentic SDLC guardrails, testing gates, and human oversight of AI-assisted development workflows.
Lead, mentor, and strengthen a team of security engineers, cultivating an atmosphere that values technical excellence, continual learning, and innovation.
Drive the implementation of security guidelines across the engineering organization, ensuring security is integrated into day-to-day development processes.
Lead security architecture reviews for new products, infrastructure changes, and major engineering initiatives, serving as a formal checkpoint before systems go to production.
Own the vulnerability management program, including coordinating penetration testing, prioritizing remediation, and partnering with engineering teams to close risk at pace.
Collaborate with engineering, product, and IT leadership to ensure alignment on security priorities and to champion security outcomes on behalf of our customers.
WHAT YOU'LL BRING:
15+ years of experience in security engineering, with at least 5+ years in a leadership or management role, preferably in the crypto, blockchain, or FinTech space.
Hands-on expertise in AI security: a clear understanding of the risk surface introduced by LLMs, AI agents, and AI-assisted development workflows, and how to build guardrails around them.
Expert-level knowledge of security architecture, including cloud environments (AWS, GCP, Azure), modern application stacks, and network security.
Strong understanding of cryptographic principles, secure coding practices, and common web and blockchain vulnerabilities (e.g., OWASP Top 10).
Experience with authentication and authorization standards (OAuth, SAML, OIDC) and their security implications.
Demonstrated expertise in IT security, including endpoint protection, network security, identity and access management (IAM), and corporate security policy enforcement.
Hands-on experience with threat modeling methodologies and risk identification techniques.
Ability to communicate complex technical concepts and security risks to both technical and non-technical audiences.
A track record of fostering a positive security culture within an organization and proven experience leading and building a high-performing security team.
Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to effectively and creatively manage complex security challenges.
For positions that will be based in CA, the annual salary range for this position is below. Actual salaries may vary based on numerous factors including, among other things, an individual applicant’s experience and qualifications for the position. This range does not include equity or additional compensation, such as bonuses or commissions.
CA Annual Base Salary Range
$308,000—$385,000 USD
WHO WE ARE:
Do Your Best Work
The opportunity to build in a fast-paced start-up environment with experienced industry leaders
A learning environment where you can dive deep into the latest technologies and make an impact. A professional development budget to support other modes of learning.
Thrive in an environment where no matter what race, ethnicity, gender, origin, or culture they identify with, every employee is a respected, valued, and empowered part of the team.
In-office collaboration for moments that matter is important to our culture, and we give managers and teams the flexibility to decide which 10+ days a month they come in.
Bi-weekly all-company meeting - business updates and ask me anything style discussion with our Leadership Team
We come together for moments that matter which include team offsites, team bonding activities, happy hours and more!
Take Control of Your Finances
Competitive salary, bonuses, and equity
Competitive benefits that cover physical and mental healthcare, retirement, family forming, and family support
Employee giving match
Mobile phone stipend
Take Care of Yourself
R&R days so you can rest and recharge
Generous wellness reimbursement and weekly onsite & virtual programming
Generous vacation policy - work with your manager to take time off when you need it
Industry-leading parental leave policies. Family planning benefits.
Catered lunches, fully-stocked kitchens with premium snacks/beverages, and plenty of fun events
Benefits listed above are for full-time employees.
Ripple is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We do not discriminate against qualified employees or applicants because of race, color, religion, gender identity, sex, sexual identity, pregnancy, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, marital status, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, military status, or any other characteristic protected by local law or ordinance.
Please find our UK/EU Applicant Privacy Notice and our California Applicant Privacy Notice for reference.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering
jobs.text:
At Zeta Global, we are building the next generation of AI-powered marketing ecosystems. The “Prospect Audiences” team within the data layer powers ingestion of behavioral, demographic & geographic identity signals and enables generation of smart audiences from the Zeta Data Cloud. These audiences are the cornerstone for improved audience targeting by Zeta’s customers and higher marketing ROI.
As Director, Engineering, your immediate responsibility will be to own the Third-Party Audiences product from an engineering, architecture & technology purview, guide the team to deliver on immediate roadmap work items and work with product and business stakeholders to shape the product itself. Over time, the role could evolve into broader participation in the complete data layer (consisting of 6 other teams) and additional ownership.
Key Responsibilities:
Lead the Prospect Audiences team, consisting of ~10 engineers, fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and operational excellence.
Guide the team to deliver roadmap work items on time, of high quality, within the boundaries of the organization processes and guidelines.
Collaborate with product and business teams to shape the future and long-range roadmap for the team
Collaborate with DevEx & AI Enablement teams to drive adoption of AI-native SDLC in the agentic software development paradigm, as applicable to the technologies used by the team.
Partner with architects to build a world-class data ingestion and processing architecture & be at the forefront of technological innovation and continue to challenge yourself to deliver better outcomes for the customers.
Recruit, mentor, and develop top talent within your team and the data layer in general.
Own the system end to end, including production deployments, monitoring, distributed tracing, defining SLOs and thresholds for alerting, and managing on-call support for production incidents.
Monitor cost profile of the owned systems, participate in cost optimization initiatives, and execute cost optimization projects to keep the overall cost footprint as lean as possible.
Own how the team ensures reliable, testable pipelines and datasets - quality checks, lineage/observability of critical tables, and clear contracts/SLAs (or handshakes) between data producers and downstream consumers (including when things break).
Qualifications:
10+ years of software engineering experience, including significant time leading large-scale data systems and teams.
Deep domain expertise in batch & real-time data processing systems.
Understand applicability, pros & cons & effectiveness of data engineering design patterns & concepts such as Data Lakehouse, Data Table Format, Zero-Copy Data Sharing, Cleanroom, Real-Time vs Batch Data Processing, High throughput distributed system APIs
Possess experience working on data technologies equivalent to:
Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery
Iceberg, Hudi, Delta
EMR, Airflow, Spark
Aerospike, Scylla, DynamoDB
Strong understanding of cloud data architectures (AWS, Snowflake, etc.).
Track record of innovation and driving measurable outcomes, including AI-driven or data-driven product capabilities.
Exceptional communication skills
WHO WE ARE
Zeta Global (NYSE: ZETA) is the AI-Powered Marketing Cloud that leverages advanced artificial intelligence (AI) and trillions of consumer signals to make it easier for marketers to acquire, grow, and retain customers more efficiently. Through the Zeta Marketing Platform (ZMP), our vision is to make sophisticated marketing simple by unifying identity, intelligence, and omnichannel activation into a single platform – powered by one of the industry’s largest proprietary databases and AI. Our enterprise customers across multiple verticals are empowered to personalize experiences with consumers at an individual level across every channel, delivering better results for marketing programs. Zeta was founded in 2007 by David A. Steinberg and John Sculley and is headquartered in New York City with offices around the world. To learn more, go to www.zetaglobal.com.
PEOPLE & CULTURE AT ZETA
Zeta considers applicants for employment without regard to, and does not discriminate on the basis of an individual’s sex, race, color, religion, age, disability, status as a veteran, or national or ethnic origin; nor does Zeta discriminate on the basis of sexual orientation, gender identity or expression.
We’re committed to building a workplace culture of trust and belonging, so everyone feels invited to bring their whole selves to work. We provide a forum for employees to celebrate, support and advocate for one another. Learn more about our commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion here: https://zetaglobal.com/blog/a-look-into-zetas-ergs/
ZETA IN THE NEWS!
https://zetaglobal.com/press/?cat=press-releases
Zeta Global Recognized in Enterprise Marketing Software and Cross-Channel Campaign Management Reports by Independent Research Firm
We invite you to explore this opportunity to be a part of the Zeta family……
Should you need any assistance or require further information, please do not hesitate to contact us.

jobs.title: Vice President - Telecommunication, Media and Technology
jobs.text:
About AlixPartners
Expertise, execution excellence, and accountability – AlixPartners stands for delivering measurable results “when it really matters.” As a global consulting firm, we help our clients respond quickly and decisively to their most critical challenges. Our experienced consultants specialize in creating, protecting, and restoring enterprise value. In 2023, AlixPartners was recognized as the consulting firm with the strongest execution capabilities by “manager magazin” and the Scientific Association for Management and Consulting (WGMB). For more than 40 years, AlixPartners has supported clients worldwide, with approximately 4,000 employees across 27 offices globally.
TMT
Disruption and exponential growth, M&A, carve-outs and private equity investors, SaaS and cloud transformation, as well as challenges across the entire supply chain — these are just some of the forces shaping the TMT industry. Winners in this highly competitive environment aggressively adapt their business models, organizational structures, capabilities, and cost bases to evolving market conditions in order to capitalize on growth opportunities.
Our global team combines deep industry expertise with extensive transformation experience and a broad range of methodologies specifically tailored to the TMT and technology sectors. We have a proven track record of increasing enterprise value through a clear focus on profitability and growth.
As a member of our TMT team, you will work across all three sectors — Technology, Media, and Telecommunications — supporting both large corporations and private equity firms as well as their portfolio companies.
What We Offer
Impactful, hands-on, and pragmatic: at AlixPartners, your passion drives your career through high performance, initiative, and results. Working alongside highly experienced team members in small teams, you will collaborate directly with owners, board members, and senior management. Together, you will deliver actionable solutions to urgent business challenges, often in critical, high-stakes situations where rapid execution matters most.
Through our One-Firm approach, we offer cross-border opportunities for learning, as well as personal and professional development.
In addition, you can expect an attractive compensation package with comprehensive benefits and numerous initiatives through our Employee Resource Groups — feel free to ask us more about them.
Your Profile
Our goal is to deliver sustainable value creation for our clients. To achieve this, we are looking for top talent in the market:
7–15 years of relevant professional and consulting experience
Sector: TMT sector (telecommunications, media, high-tech & electronics, software and semiconductors)
Ideally, experience in large-scale, enterprise-wide transformation programs, performance improvement across the value chain, growth and margin optimization, M&A (Due diligence, ost-merger integration, carve-outs), AI transformation, as well as growth initiatives
Strong financial and analytical capabilities
Proven track record of delivering implementation-oriented, high-quality solutions across multiple workstreams, with the ability to take full ownership of different areas
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
Strong analytical, problem-solving and hands-on mindset
Strong academic background; Master’s degree, PhD, or equivalent
Fluency in French and English; additional languages are a plus
Readiness to travel within a hybrid working model (remote, office, client site)
Valid passport, citizenship, and/or work authorization for France, with the ability to travel and work across the EU

jobs.title: Executive Director - Development (Del 1)
jobs.text:
Qiddiya Investment Company is seeking a highly skilled and visionary Executive Director - Development, with significant Theme Parks development experience. This leadership role is central to realizing our ambition to create world-class theme park experiences that captivate visitors and contribute to the overall vision of Qiddiya.
As the Executive Director Development, you will oversee the full project lifecycle from concept through design, construction, and launch. You will collaborate closely with multidisciplinary teams, vendors, and stakeholders to ensure that each theme park development adheres to the highest standards of innovation, quality, safety, and guest experience.
Key Responsibilities
Develop and implement comprehensive strategies for the successful delivery of theme park projects aligned with Qiddiya’s vision and goals.
Lead multidisciplinary teams in the planning, design, construction, and commissioning phases of theme park developments.
Manage project budgets, timelines, and resources, ensuring that projects are delivered on time and within budget.
Collaborate with master planners, architects, engineers, and creative teams to develop innovative and immersive theme park concepts.
Ensure adherence to safety standards, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices throughout all phases of development.
Engage with key stakeholders, including government entities, partners, and community representatives, to foster collaboration and support.
Drive continuous improvement efforts in project delivery methodologies, sustainability practices, and guest experience standards.
Provide regular updates and reports to senior leadership on project status, risks, and mitigation strategies.
Mentor and develop high-performing teams, fostering a culture of excellence and innovation.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering
jobs.text:
Build the Future of Carbon Conversion & Renewable Energy
Location: Franklin, TN (On-Site)
Type: Full-Time
Seniority: Director / Leadership
Join Enexor BioEnergy
Enexor is a venture-backed, early-stage climate tech company just outside of Nashville, TN, developing distributed systems that turn organic and plastic waste into clean energy and high-purity CO₂. We are reimagining how the world addresses emissions, waste, and energy access—one modular system at a time.
We’re not just solving problems. We’re redefining what’s possible at the intersection of engineering, energy, and sustainability.
Why This Role Matters
We’re seeking a Director of Engineering to lead and scale our multidisciplinary engineering team as we develop, build, and deploy the next generation of our waste-to-energy and carbon capture systems. You’ll be both strategist and builder—setting the engineering vision, managing execution, and rolling up your sleeves to help solve complex hardware challenges.
This is a critical leadership role reporting directly to the CEO. You will own the engineering organization while collaborating across product development, fabrication, and field deployment to take ideas from whiteboard to world-changing systems.
What You’ll Do
Lead and grow a world-class mechanical, electrical, and controls engineering team.
Drive end-to-end product development—from concept to CAD, DFM, fabrication, commissioning, and continuous improvement.
Build scalable engineering processes that support rapid prototyping and high-reliability deployment.
Own technical architecture decisions and cross-functional integration across subsystems (combustion, thermal, gas separation, pressure, controls).
Guide engineering trade-offs with strong first-principles thinking and cost-performance analysis.
Partner with the CEO and executive team on strategic initiatives, resource planning, and technical hiring.
Instill a culture of ownership, urgency, and innovation in everything you build.

jobs.title: Managing Director - Flagship Vertical Market Software Business
jobs.text:
Lead the Next Chapter of a Market-Leading Business
At Aspire Software, we acquire and build mission-critical software businesses for the long term. We are seeking a Managing Director to lead one of our flagship vertical market software businesses—a company with a strong market position, loyal customer base, and a long track record of success within the Aspire portfolio. This business is a cornerstone asset with meaningful scale and reputation in its market. It now stands at an exciting point in its evolution, with clear opportunities to expand its reach, enhance its product offering, and accelerate growth. This is a rare opportunity to take an already successful company and shape its next phase of expansion and innovation.
An Agentic MD
A truly agentic MD in the modern era is a leader who goes beyond adopting AI tools to fundamentally redesign how the business operates, competes, and creates value. This means building an organization where intelligent systems and human teams work together—automating routine decisions, augmenting complex ones, and enabling faster, data-driven execution across every function. An agentic MD embeds AI into the core of the product, leverages it to transform sales and marketing effectiveness, and drives operational efficiency through automation at scale. Just as importantly, they cultivate a culture of experimentation, accountability, and continuous learning—ensuring the organization is not only using AI but evolving with it. The outcome is a more adaptive, scalable, and intelligent business that can outperform traditional SaaS models.
The Role: Operator, Builder, Growth Leader
This is a full P&L MD role with end-to-end ownership of the business. You will define and lead the company’s next chapter, building on a strong foundation while unlocking new avenues for growth, innovation, and value creation. You will operate with high autonomy, supported by Aspire’s long-term investment model, operational expertise, and global network.
What You’ll Lead
Drive the Next Phase of Growth: Expand and scale repeatable, high-quality revenue streams, identify new opportunities across markets, segments, and channels, and strengthen and evolve the go-to-market strategy.
Shape the Future of the Product: Define and execute a compelling product vision and roadmap, enhance the platform through innovation, integrations, and AI-driven capabilities, and ensure continued alignment with evolving customer needs and industry trends.
Deepen Customer Value: Build on a strong customer foundation to further improve retention, satisfaction, and lifetime value, and strengthen the company’s position as a mission-critical partner to its clients.
Lead and Evolve the Organization: Partner with an established leadership team to drive alignment, performance, and execution, assess organizational strengths and identify opportunities to further elevate capabilities where needed, foster a culture of ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement, and attract and develop talent to support the company’s next phase of growth.
Own Performance and Outcomes: Lead the business with full accountability for revenue, EBITDA, and cash flow, drive operational excellence, scalability, and efficiency, and allocate resources effectively to support long-term growth.
Expand Strategic Opportunities: Evaluate and pursue M&A, partnerships, and adjacent growth opportunities, and position the business for continued leadership within its vertical.
Why This Opportunity Stands Out
A Flagship Asset: This is a high-quality, established business with scale, reputation, and a strong foundation—one of Aspire’s core platforms.
A Platform for Growth: With the fundamentals in place, the focus is on expansion, innovation, and acceleration—building on success, not starting from scratch.
True Ownership: You will run the business with full autonomy and accountability, empowered to make decisions and drive outcomes.
Long-Term Backing: Aspire’s buy-and-hold model means you can focus on building enduring value, not managing toward an exit.
A Proven Operating Model: You’ll have access to Aspire’s playbooks, capital, and network of experienced operators while maintaining independence in execution.
What Success Looks Like
Accelerated, sustainable revenue growth, continued strengthening of market leadership, a differentiated and forward-looking product strategy, high customer retention and satisfaction, a strong, aligned, and high-performing leadership team, and consistent expansion of profitability and enterprise value.
What You Bring
Experience as a CEO, Managing Director, or General Manager with full P&L ownership, a track record of scaling and growing established software or technology businesses, strong commercial instinct across sales, pricing, and go-to-market strategy, ability to lead across product, operations, and finance, a hands-on, ownership-driven leadership style, and comfort operating in a high-autonomy, performance-driven environment.
Why Aspire
Lead a flagship business with real scale and impact, operate with true ownership and autonomy, be backed by a company that builds for the long term, access a global ecosystem of software leaders and best practices, and shape the future of a business that already matters in its market.
#AspireSoftware

jobs.title: Field Chief Technology Officer (Field CTO)
jobs.text:
MinIO is the data and memory foundation for enterprise AI. Built for the speed, scale, and economics that AI and analytics demand, AIStor and MemKV unify every layer of the data stack, from agentic and inference context memory to tables and objects across core, edge, and cloud. Trusted by 77% of the Fortune 100, MinIO is redefining how AI factories, intelligent applications, and autonomous agents secure, persist, and unlock the full value of their data.
We are seeking a highly technical, visionary, and customer-centric Field CTO to act as our premier technical ambassador. In this role, you will bridge the gap between MinIO’s engineering innovation and the strategic business needs of our largest, most complex enterprise customers.
As a Field CTO, you will engage in peer-to-peer conversations with enterprise C-suites (CIOs, CTOs, CDOs) and lead architectural discussions with principal engineers. A deep, hands-on understanding of modern AI architectures (LLMs, RAG, deep learning pipelines) and modern analytics data systems (Iceberg, Delta Lake, Trino, Spark) is mandatory. You will not only evangelize MinIO’s capabilities but also act as a trusted advisor, helping organizations architect their data infrastructure to support next-generation workloads. This role is Bay Area, CA based
What You Will Do
Executive Advisory & Evangelism: Act as a trusted technical advisor to C-level executives at Fortune 500 companies. Articulate the strategic value of high-performance object storage in the context of AI readiness and data democratization.
Architectural Leadership: Design and validate complex, large-scale architectures for enterprise customers. Guide them in integrating MinIO seamlessly into their AI/ML pipelines and modern data lakehouse ecosystems.
Industry Thought Leadership: Represent MinIO at major industry conferences, webinars, and meetups. Write technical whitepapers, reference architectures, and blog posts focusing on the intersection of object storage, generative AI, and modern analytics.
Pre-Sales & Post-Sales Strategic Support: Partner closely with enterprise sales and customer success teams on high-stakes deals. Unblock technical objections and provide strategic guidance during Proof of Concepts (PoCs) and large-scale deployments.
Product Strategy Feedback Loop: Serve as the "voice of the customer" to MinIO’s product and engineering teams. Distill market trends, customer pain points, and emerging AI/Analytics patterns into actionable product requirements.
Required Qualifications
10+ years of experience in technical leadership roles (e.g., Enterprise Architect, Chief Architect, VP of Engineering, or previous Field CTO).
Demonstrated experience in a customer-facing or evangelist capacity, successfully presenting to both highly technical audiences and C-level business executives.
AI & Machine Learning Architectures:
Deep architectural understanding of Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs), including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) workflows and vector databases (e.g., Milvus, Qdrant, Pinecone).
Strong knowledge of AI/ML data pipelines and frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, Ray, Hugging Face).
Understanding of hardware bottlenecks in AI, specifically the challenge of feeding data to GPUs (GPU data starvation) and how high-throughput storage solves this.
Modern Analytics & Data Systems:
Expertise in Open Table Formats (Apache Iceberg, Apache Hudi, Delta Lake) and their integration with object storage.
Proficiency with modern query engines and compute frameworks (Trino, Presto, Apache Spark, Flink, StarRocks).
Solid grasp of the evolution from traditional data warehouses to modern Data Lakehouse architectures.
Infrastructure & Cloud-Native Tech:
Strong command of Kubernetes, containerization, and cloud-native orchestration.
Deep understanding of the AWS S3 API, RESTful APIs, and distributed systems design.
What We Offer
Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)
401K with 3% Contribution
Pre-IPO Stock Options
At least 12 Public Holidays
Flexible Time Off
Equal Opportunity Policy (EEO)
MinIO is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We review applications for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, veteran status, genetic information, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering, Logistics
jobs.text:
About the Team
DoorDash is seeking a seasoned Engineering Director to lead our Logistics Org. You’ll lead a multi-disciplinary organization of 100+ engineers (Backend, Mobile, Machine Learning, and Operations Research) to architect the intelligent, real-time systems that comprise the "brain" of our fulfillment engine. This organization builds the optimization engines and high-throughput AI platforms that guide millions of Dashers and deploy tens of millions of dollars in real-time. This team sits at the heart of DoorDash’s fulfillment ecosystem, powering the delivery and courier data that drives our logistics engine. We build the foundational models and workflows that enable our customer teams (Order, Shopping, and beyond) to build extensible solutions on top of the platform.
About the Role
DoorDash is seeking a Director of Engineering with a deep background in Large-Scale Systems, Machine Learning, and Mathematical Optimization to lead our Logistics team in San Francisco. In this role, you are the architect of our three-sided marketplace. You will oversee the development of the core fulfillment platforms responsible for real-time dispatching, dynamic pricing task-allocation, ETAs and supply-demand balancing. This is a unique opportunity to marry complex algorithmic research with "five-nines" platform reliability. We are also looking for a leader who is deeply bought into the transformative potential of AI; someone who sees large language models, foundation models, and world model architectures not as adjacent curiosities but as core primitives for reimagining how logistics systems learn, plan, and adapt at scale.
You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…
Define the AI & Platform Vision: Drive the engineering strategy, transitioning bespoke algorithmic solutions into a unified, scalable AI/Optimization platform.
Architect Real-Time Decision Engines: Lead the development of systems that solve complex combinatorial problems (VRP, assignment, pricing) in milliseconds at massive scale.
Build "Production-Grade" ML: Ensure that our machine learning models aren't just accurate in a notebook, but are backed by robust feature stores, low-latency serving infrastructure, and rigorous backtesting frameworks.
Scale High-Throughput Infrastructure: Evolve the underlying distributed systems to handle exponential growth, ensuring the platform remains stable under the load of millions of concurrent requests.
Cross-Functional Leadership: Partner with Business, Product, and Data Science to turn high-level marketplace objectives into technical roadmaps that balance long-term platform health with immediate business impact.
Champion Engineering Excellence: Scale the organization by mentoring high-growth leaders and attracting world-class talent in the fields of Distributed Systems and Applied AI.
We’re excited about you because you have…
A B.S., M.S., or Ph.D. in Computer Science or equivalent.
An AI-native leadership mindset. You are deeply convicted about the role of AI - including foundation models and world model approaches - in transforming logistics. You've thought seriously about how these technologies can move logistics beyond hand-tuned rules toward systems that learn, adapt, and generalize, and you know how to rally an engineering org around that vision without losing sight of production reliability and business impact.
12+ years of software engineering experience, including 7+ years leading engineering managers and multiple teams.
Experience building and scaling high-performing engineering organizations. You've led multiple teams through hypergrowth, re-orgs, developed managers into leaders, and created leverage through systems and strategy.
A strategic mindset that shapes technical direction. You define multi-quarter roadmaps, make high-stakes architectural decisions at scale, and translate ambiguous business problems into clear technical strategies.
The ability to operate at the intersection of engineering, product, and business. You partner with cross-functional leaders to align on priorities, rally teams around shared goals, and use strong product instincts to drive business-critical outcomes.
Deep experience developing talent and building culture. You hire, coach, and promote strong engineering leaders while raising the bar on engineering excellence.
Compensation
The successful candidate’s starting pay will fall within the pay range listed below and is determined based on job-related factors including, but not limited to, skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. Base salary is localized according to an employee’s work location. Ranges are market-dependent and may be modified in the future.
In addition to base salary, the compensation for this role includes opportunities for equity grants. Talk to your recruiter for more information.
DoorDash cares about you and your overall well-being. That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits package to all regular employees, which includes a 401(k) plan with employer matching, 16 weeks of paid parental leave, wellness benefits, commuter benefits match, paid time off and paid sick leave in compliance with applicable laws (e.g. Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act). DoorDash also offers medical, dental, and vision benefits, 11 paid holidays, disability and basic life insurance, family-forming assistance, and a mental health program, among others.
To learn more about our benefits, visit our careers page here.
See below for paid time off details:
For salaried roles: flexible paid time off/vacation, plus 80 hours of paid sick time per year.
For hourly roles: vacation accrued at about 1 hour for every 25.97 hours worked (e.g. about 6.7 hours/month if working 40 hours/week; about 3.4 hours/month if working 20 hours/week), and paid sick time accrued at 1 hour for every 30 hours worked (e.g. about 5.8 hours/month if working 40 hours/week; about 2.9 hours/month if working 20 hours/week).
The national base pay range for this position within the United States, including Illinois and Colorado.
$268,600—$395,000 USD
About DoorDash
At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.
DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees’ happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more.
Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion
We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.
Statement of Non-Discrimination: In keeping with our beliefs and goals, no employee or applicant will face discrimination or harassment based on: race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, age, gender, marital/domestic partner status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability status, or veteran status. Above and beyond discrimination and harassment based on “protected categories,” we also strive to prevent other subtler forms of inappropriate behavior (i.e., stereotyping) from ever gaining a foothold in our office. Whether blatant or hidden, barriers to success have no place at DoorDash. We value a diverse workforce – people who identify as women, non-binary or gender non-conforming, LGBTQIA+, American Indian or Native Alaskan, Black or African American, Hispanic or Latinx, Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander, differently-abled, caretakers and parents, and veterans are strongly encouraged to apply. Thank you to the Level Playing Field Institute for this statement of non-discrimination.
Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, and any other state or local hiring regulations, we will consider for employment any qualified applicant, including those with arrest and conviction records, in a manner consistent with the applicable regulation.
If you need any accommodations, please inform your recruiting contact upon initial connection.
Notice to Applicants for Jobs Located in NYC or Remote Jobs Associated With Office in NYC Only
We used Covey as part of our hiring and/or promotional process for jobs in NYC and certain features may qualify it as an AEDT in NYC. As part of the hiring and/or promotion process, we provided Covey with job requirements and candidate submitted applications. Champion Engineering Excellence: Scale the organization by mentoring high-growth leaders and attracting world-class talent in the fields of Distributed Systems and Applied AI.

blocks.text: We’re excited about you because you have…

items: A B.S., M.S., or Ph.D. in Computer Science or equivalent.

An AI-native leadership mindset. You are deeply convicted about the role of AI - including foundation models and world model approaches - in transforming logistics. You've thought seriously about how these technologies can move logistics beyond hand-tuned rules toward systems that learn, adapt, and generalize, and you know how to rally an engineering org around that vision without losing sight of production reliability and business impact.
12+ years of software engineering experience, including 7+ years leading engineering managers and multiple teams.

Experience building and scaling high-performing engineering organizations. You've led multiple teams through hypergrowth, re-orgs, developed managers into leaders, and created leverage through systems and strategy.

A strategic mindset that shapes technical direction. You define multi-quarter roadmaps, make high-stakes architectural decisions at scale, and translate ambiguous business problems into clear technical strategies.

The ability to operate at the intersection of engineering, product, and business. You partner with cross-functional leaders to align on priorities, rally teams around shared goals, and use strong product instincts to drive business-critical outcomes.
Deep experience developing talent and building culture. You hire, coach, and promote strong engineering leaders while raising the bar on engineering excellence.

About DoorDash

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees’ happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more.

jobs.title: Director of Software Engineering (Canada)
jobs.text:
At Flosum, we are building the world's best software for the modern enterprise. Our team is passionate about crafting elegant, high-performance products that delight our customers and set a new bar for engineering excellence. We combine deep expertise in cloud-native development with a relentless focus on quality, speed, and innovation. Every line of code we ship is built to scale, built to last, and built to make a real difference for the businesses that rely on us.
We are a company where technologists lead, ideas win on merit, and shipping great software fast is a core value—not a slogan. If you believe world-class engineering teams are the ones that move quickly and build things right, you'll feel at home here.
About the Role
We are hiring a Director of Software Development to lead a team of 10 engineers building and scaling our Node.js and Salesforce-integrated products. This is a hands-on leadership role for a technical architect at heart who can compress delivery schedules, drive developer velocity, and own the performance of the overall solution. You will be the single point of accountability for turning our roadmap into shipped software—on time, at quality, and at scale.
What You'll Own
Lead, coach, and grow a team of 10 full-stack developers across Node.js services and Salesforce customizations.
Drive measurable improvements in developer velocity using DORA metrics: lead time, deployment frequency, change failure rate, and MTTR.
Compress delivery schedules by breaking epics into small, independently shippable slices and challenging inflated estimates with data.
Architect end-to-end solutions spanning Node.js microservices, APIs, event-driven patterns, and Salesforce (Apex, Lightning, integrations).
Own solution performance: latency, throughput, scalability, and cost—set SLOs and hold the team accountable to them.
Establish estimation, sprint, and release discipline; remove blockers; enforce accountability without burning the team out.
Partner with Product, QA, and Infrastructure to align roadmap, capacity, and dependencies.
Recruit, onboard, and performance-manage engineers; build a culture of ownership and speed.

This is a hands-on leadership role for a technical architect at heart who can compress delivery schedules, drive developer velocity, and own the performance of the overall solution. You will be the single point of accountability for turning our roadmap into shipped software—on time, at quality, and at scale.
What You'll Own

items: Lead, coach, and grow a team of 10 full-stack developers across Node.js services and Salesforce customizations.
Drive measurable improvements in developer velocity using DORA metrics: lead time, deployment frequency, change failure rate, and MTTR.
Compress delivery schedules by breaking epics into small, independently shippable slices and challenging inflated estimates with data.
Architect end-to-end solutions spanning Node.js microservices, APIs, event-driven patterns, and Salesforce (Apex, Lightning, integrations).
Own solution performance: latency, throughput, scalability, and cost—set SLOs and hold the team accountable to them.
Establish estimation, sprint, and release discipline; remove blockers; enforce accountability without burning the team out.
Partner with Product, QA, and Infrastructure to align roadmap, capacity, and dependencies.
Recruit, onboard, and performance-manage engineers; build a culture of ownership and speed.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering, Developer Infrastructure
jobs.text:
About Fullscript
We’re an industry-leading health technology company on a mission to help people get better. We started in 2011 with one simple idea. Make it easier for practitioners to access the products they trust so they can deliver better care.
That simple idea grew into a platform that powers every part of care. Today, more than 125,000 practitioners use Fullscript for clinical insights, lab interpretations, patient analytics, education, and access to high-quality supplements. Over 10 million patients rely on Fullscript to stay connected to their care plans and follow through on treatment.
We build tools that make care smarter and more human. Tools that save time, simplify decisions, and help practitioners stay closely connected to the people they care for. When everything they need is in one place, they can focus on what matters most: helping people get better.
This is your invitation.
Bring your ideas, your grit, and your care for people.
Join us and shape the future of care.
The Role
We’re looking for a Director of Engineering to lead high-impact engineering teams and shape the future of Fullscript’s platform. You’ll drive technical vision, scalability, and innovation, ensuring our technology empowers practitioners to provide better patient care.
As a strategic and hands-on leader, you’ll guide engineering teams, managers, and cross-functional partners to deliver exceptional products and infrastructure. Your role is to enable teams to move quickly, solve complex technical challenges, and ensure our systems scale to meet growing demand.
This role bridges the gap between infrastructure teams and product engineering, focusing on developer productivity, system reliability, and scalability

jobs.title: CTO / Co-Founder - Hardware & Climate Technology (AWH)
jobs.text:
We are a climate-tech company building an integrated ecosystem of water solutions that generate, conserve, and optimize water for agriculture, industry, and environmental restoration in water-scarce regions. At the core of this ecosystem is our Atmospheric Water Harvesting (AWH) technology, which serves as the foundational platform enabling decentralized, energy-efficient water harvesting.
Our approach combines advanced engineering, thermodynamics, materials science, and system-level design to move beyond single products and toward scalable infrastructure solutions. As we expand the ecosystem over time, AWH remains the core technology, and the CTO / Co-Founder will lead its development from early-stage R&D through commercialization and real-world deployment.
Role Overview
As CTO / Co-Founder, you will own the technical vision, system architecture, and product development of our AWH technology from concept through prototype, pilot, and commercialization. You will work closely with the founders to define the technology roadmap, build and test systems, and lead R&D with a strong bias toward execution.
This is a hands-on role. You will be designing, building, testing, and iterating not delegating everything from day one.
Key Responsibilities
· Define and lead the technical vision and architecture of AWH systems
· Design and develop mechanical and thermal systems
· Take products from idea → prototype → pilot → commercial deployment
· Lead hands-on R&D, experimentation, testing, and performance optimization
· Drive system efficiency, reliability, and scalability
· Oversee prototyping, validation, and field testing
· Contribute to IP strategy, patent drafting, and technical documentation
· Build and later lead a technical team (engineers, researchers, technicians)
· Collaborate with partners, suppliers, and research institutions
· Support fundraising and investor discussions with deep technical insight

jobs.title: CTO / Head of Engineering
jobs.text:
About Huzzle
At Huzzle, we connect exceptional talent with top opportunities at leading companies across the UK, US, Canada, Europe, and Australia. Our clients include high-growth startups, venture-backed tech companies, and innovative platforms across SaaS, FinTech, AI, and Web3.
Unlike traditional outsourcing agencies, we place you directly with a client—where you’re hired in-house as a core team member, with real ownership and long-term upside.
About the Company
Our client is an early-stage, venture-backed startup building a category-defining platform designed to reshape how businesses operate in a digital-first world. Backed by experienced founders and strong early traction, the company is now hiring a founding technical leader at the C-level to define and scale its technology vision.
Job Summary
We’re seeking a Chief Technology Officer (CTO) / Founding Engineer to lead the company’s technical strategy, architecture, and execution from zero to scale. This is a rare opportunity to join at the ground floor and shape not only the product, but the entire engineering organization, culture, and long-term technical vision.
You will operate as both a hands-on builder and strategic leader, working closely with the founding team, investors, and future hires to drive product innovation and company growth.
Key Responsibilities
Define and execute the company’s technical vision, architecture, and roadmap
Lead full-stack product development from MVP to scalable platform
Make high-impact decisions on tech stack, infrastructure, and system design
Build and scale the engineering team, including hiring and mentoring top talent
Establish engineering processes, best practices, and performance standards
Collaborate with founders on company strategy, fundraising, and product-market fit
Ensure scalability, security, and reliability of all systems
Represent the technical function at the executive level with stakeholders and investors
Tech Stack
Languages: TypeScript, JavaScript, Python (bonus)
Frontend: React
Backend: Node.js, Wasp (easy to pick up)
Infra: Cloudflare Workers/R2, PostgreSQL, Docker
AI & APIs: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google AI, Bedrock, Openrouter
Dev Tools: Cursor, Augment, Git, Linear
A Day in the Life
Jump into a fast, focused standup to align on goals
Prototype generative features that combine UX, backend, and AI orchestration
Share demos via Loom, jam with founders in Slack, and rapidly ship to prod
Ideate new user flows, sketch mockups, or dive deep into technical tradeoffs
End the day knowing you shipped real value—and helped shape the future of design
Tech Stack (Ideal Experience)
Frontend: React, Next.js, TypeScript
Backend: Node.js (NestJS/Express) or Python (FastAPI/Django)
Database: PostgreSQL, Redis
Infrastructure: AWS / GCP, Docker, CI/CD pipelines
Other: API design (REST/GraphQL), system architecture, DevOps best practices

jobs.title: People Business Partner Director, Engineering
jobs.text:
Why join us
Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.
Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.
People at Brex
The People Team at Brex keeps our company and culture growing. We’re curious, optimistic, and pragmatic, and we work across all parts of Brex to solve organizational challenges for years to come. We focus on bringing great people to the company and providing the tools and resources to empower individual and team success. Above all, we help build an authentic, inclusive environment where our team members can grow and make an impact.
What you’ll do
As the People Business Partner Director supporting Engineering, you will serve as a trusted partner to our CTO and Engineering leadership team, shaping the organization, leadership, and talent strategy that enables Brex to scale its technical capabilities. You will operate as a mini CPO for your client group, ensuring we are building a high-performing, durable engineering organization as we scale.
Where you’ll work
This role will be based in our San Francisco or New York Office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!
Responsibilities
Serve as a thought partner and advisor to the CTO and Engineering Managers, helping shape long-term organizational design and health
Translate business and technical strategy into clear people and org implications, proactively identifying risks and opportunities
Coach leaders on building high-performing teams, including hiring profiles, succession planning, and internal mobility
Lead org design efforts including defining structure, driving communication plans, and owning execution through rollout
Drive clarity around roles, scope, and leveling, ensuring consistency and rigor across Engineering
Act as a connector across functions to drive alignment and execution at scale
Proactively scope and drive programs in partnership with Comp, Talent Management, and other functions, ensuring Engineering's context and input shapes the right decisions and that leaders stay informed of changes that affect them
Actively experiment with and champion AI-powered approaches to people processes, helping Brex pioneer more effective and efficient ways of working across the HR function
Requirements
8+ years of experience across People Business Partnering or related functions, with significant experience supporting Engineering or technical organizations
Proven experience partnering with C-level or senior executives (CTO, VP Eng, or equivalent)
Demonstrated ability to lead org design and transformation efforts in high-growth or complex environments
Strong track record of influencing senior leaders and driving change in ambiguous and high-stakes situations
Deep understanding of what great looks like in engineering organizations (structure, talent, leadership, and scaling challenges)
Exceptional judgment, business acumen, and ability to connect people strategy to business outcomes
Clear, concise communicator who can simplify complex topics and drive alignment across stakeholders
Active interest in and experimentation with AI tools in HR contexts; ability to identify where AI can meaningfully improve people processes
Bonus points
Experience supporting rapidly scaling fintech or product-led organizations
Familiarity with technical org design challenges (platform vs. product teams, infra scaling, global engineering footprints)
Experience operating through major company inflection points (hypergrowth, restructuring, M&A, or public company transition)
Track record of deploying AI or automation in people workflows at scale
What success looks like
Engineering has a clear, scalable org structure aligned to company priorities
Leaders are operating at a higher bar, making better decisions faster and with greater accountability
Talent density improves, with stronger hiring, clearer expectations, and proactive talent management
The CTO and leadership team view you as a trusted advisor
You influence not just Engineering, but how Brex thinks about building and scaling high-performing organizations overall
Compensation
The expected salary range for this role is $247,470 –$309,338. However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.
Brex LLC is a wholly owned subsidiary of Capital One, N.A.
Please be aware, job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by malicious actors looking for personal data. Brex recruiters will only reach out via LinkedIn or email with a brex.com domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Brex via other sources should be ignored.

jobs.title: Director - City Technology Governance & PMO
jobs.text:
Qiddiya Investment Company is seeking an experienced and strategic Director for City Technology Governance & PMO to lead and enhance the technology governance framework across the Qiddiya city development. The successful candidate will oversee the Project Management Office (PMO) related to technology initiatives, ensuring alignment with the company’s overall vision and strategic goals. This leadership role involves driving best practices in technology governance, risk management, and compliance while facilitating cross-functional collaboration among multiple stakeholders.
The Director will be responsible for establishing and strengthening IT governance policies, standards, and procedures; driving technology project delivery excellence; and managing the portfolio of technology projects with an emphasis on quality, timelines, and budgets. Operating at the intersection of technology and city planning, this role demands a visionary leader who can effectively manage complex technology programs and influence decision-making at senior levels to support the successful deployment of innovative technology solutions in line with Qiddiya’s unique vision.
Key Responsibilities
Develop, implement, and maintain robust technology governance frameworks tailored to city-scale smart infrastructure and digital services.
Lead the Technology PMO, overseeing project planning, execution, resource allocation, risk management, and performance tracking for all technology initiatives.
Ensure compliance with internal policies, industry standards, and regulatory requirements concerning technology deployments.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams including IT, engineering, operations, and external partners to align technology projects with the broader city development objectives.
Advise senior leadership on governance and project management best practices, providing clear reports and recommendations for decision-making.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives to optimize project delivery processes and governance mechanisms.
Manage stakeholder communication and expectations to facilitate transparency and accountability throughout the project lifecycle.
Champion innovation by identifying emerging technologies and governance trends applicable to smart city environments.

jobs.title: Technology Modernization Director (Performance)
jobs.text:
At AlixPartners, we solve the most complex and critical challenges by moving quickly from analysis to action when it really matters; creating value that has a lasting impact on companies, their people, and the communities they serve. By understanding, respecting, and honoring the needs of our employees, clients, and communities, AlixPartners actively promotes an inclusive environment. We strongly believe in the value that diversity brings to our experiences and are committed to the perpetual enhancements of initiatives, policies, and practices. We hold ourselves accountable by providing the space for authenticity, growth, and equity for everyone.
AlixPartners has embraced a hybrid work model to provide flexibility and support our employees’ work-life integration. Our hybrid model combines a mix of in-person (at client site or AlixPartners office) and remote working. Travel is part of this position, but the frequency may vary based on client, team, and individual circumstances.
What you’ll do
We are seeking a Director with technical credibility, strong commercial instincts, and a track record of delivering transformation across Retail or Financial Services sectors. This role is ideal for individuals who blend industry and consulting experience, who can influence stakeholders at all levels, and build long-lasting trusted client relationships.
You will drive high‑impact engagements that sit at the intersection of business value, technology strategy, and execution – providing independent, senior-level expertise that enables executives to drive value from Technology and as a result to improve business performance. The depth of our colleagues’ experience enables us to exert a rapid and sustainable impact across:
Digital and Technology strategy development, operating model, capability and governance design.
Technology and Product strategy and innovation, assisting our clients with the strategy and execution.
Technology investment roadmaps and value creation plans.
Technology cost reduction, outsourcing and end to end Transformation.
Technology assessments leading to possible re-platforming, rationalization and consolidation activities.
Technology due diligence, carve-out, and merger integration planning and execution.
IT crisis management and project turnaround.
You will lead and/or co-lead our small, focused teams in delivering projects. They work closely with PMDs to ensure the successful delivery of all elements of client engagements and often collaboratively with the Directors across other areas of AlixPartners. They will sometimes work across a small number of projects at any given time bringing a flexible and adaptable approach to the following:

jobs.title: VP of Automation Engineering
jobs.text:
About Huzzle
At Huzzle, we connect high-performing professionals with global companies across the UK, US, Canada, Europe, and Australia. Our clients include startups, digital agencies, and tech platforms in industries like SaaS, MarTech, FinTech, and EdTech. We match top talent to full-time remote roles where they’re hired directly into client teams and provided ongoing support by Huzzle.
About the Company
Our client is an operator-led, AI-powered revenue systems company building next-generation go-to-market (GTM) infrastructure for scaling businesses. They design automation-first revenue engines that transform real-time market signals into predictable pipeline growth.
With a deeply AI-native stack—including workflow automation, LLM-powered systems, and custom-built internal products—they support companies scaling from $1M to $100M+ ARR. Engineering is not a support function here—it is the company’s competitive advantage.
Role Type: Full-time
Engagement: Independent Contractor
Job Summary
We are hiring a VP of Automation Engineering to act as the foundational technical leader and strategic partner to the CEO. This is a hands-on executive role where you will architect and scale automation systems, build internal products, and lead a high-performing engineering team.
You will operate in an AI-first environment, where tools like Claude Code are part of daily development workflows—not optional add-ons.
Key Responsibilities
Automation Architecture & Infrastructure
Own and scale end-to-end automation systems using n8n and API integrations
Architect orchestration layers for complex, multi-client environments
Build resilient systems with monitoring, alerting, and self-healing capabilities
Integrate tools like Clay, CRMs, and outbound platforms into a unified infrastructure
Product Development
Build internal and client-facing products using Node.js, TypeScript, and modern frameworks
Own the full product lifecycle—from architecture to deployment
Develop scalable automation products and operational dashboards
Establish engineering standards, CI/CD pipelines, and documentation
AI Systems & Intelligence Layer
Design and deploy production-grade AI/LLM systems (Claude, OpenAI, etc.)
Use Claude Code as a core development accelerator across the team
Build intelligent pipelines for classification, enrichment, and decision-making
Optimize prompt engineering, evaluation systems, and reliability at scale
Leadership & Technical Strategy
Build, manage, and mentor a high-performing engineering team
Define and execute the technical roadmap aligned with company growth
Partner directly with the CEO on product and engineering strategy
Lead sprint planning, prioritization, and delivery execution

jobs.title: Director, Electrical Engineering Mission-Critical & Data Centres
jobs.text:
Director, Electrical Engineering (Mission-Critical & Data Centres)
Location:
- Singapore (Southeast Asia Gateway)
Reporting to:
- Senior Leadership
Company Type:
- Global Engineering Design Consultancy (Founding Team)
The Opportunity:
A globally recognized engineering consultancy, consistently ranked as a leader in critical facilities and data centres, is establishing its Singapore office as a strategic hub for Southeast Asia. We are seeking a Director, Electrical Engineering to join our founding team. This is a rare, high-impact role for a registered Professional Engineer (PE) who aspires to lead complex technical designs while shaping a new regional practice from the ground up.
Key Responsibilities:
Engineering Design Delivery
- Lead the end-to-end design of electrical building services, including LV/HV power distribution, UPS systems, standby generators, and lightning protection.
- Prepare and review advanced electrical engineering calculations, short circuit and coordination studies, and technical specifications.
- Act as the Qualified Person (QP) for electrical submissions, signing and stamping drawings as a PEB-registered Professional Engineer.
- Manage all statutory submissions to EMA, BCA, SCDF, and SP Group.
- Lead technical coordination and quality assurance across multi-disciplinary project teams to ensure global standards are met.
Practice & Team Leadership
- Mentor junior engineers and play a pivotal role in recruiting and developing the future electrical engineering team in Singapore.
- Contribute to the creation of internal engineering standards, design guidelines, and QA frameworks for the regional office.
Project & Client Engagement
- Serve as the lead technical advisor for clients, architects, and regulatory authorities on complex electrical engineering matters.
Requirements:
Professional Qualification
- Registered Professional Engineer (Electrical) with the Professional Engineers Board (PEB), Singapore is mandatory at the point of hire.
Consultancy Experience
- Minimum 10-15 years of experience exclusively within M&E design consultancies (e.g., Arup, AECOM, WSP, Meinhardt, RED Engineering, Jacobs, Beca, etc.).
Design Focused
- Strong emphasis on hands-on design and engineering consultancy.
- Candidates with a primary background in installations, facility management, or maintenance will not be considered.
Sector Expertise
- Proven track record in Data Centre or Mission-Critical electrical design, including redundancy configurations (N+1, 2N) and high-reliability systems.
Technical Tools
- Proficiency in Revit MEP (highly preferred), AutoCAD, and analysis tools such as ETAP or DIALux.
Standards
- Deep knowledge of SS 638 and Singapore regulatory requirements (EMA/SCDF/BCA).
Why Join Us:
- Be part of the core team establishing a global firm’s presence in Southeast Asia.
- Work on the world’s most complex data centre and mission-critical projects.
- Hybrid working arrangement and a compensation package aligned with senior-level expertise.
